r: AUM DftarAzwra uvAca . Darmakzetre kurukzetre samavetA yuyutsavaH . mAmakAH pARqavAScEva kimakurvata saYjaya .. 1 ..

tr.gu: ધૃતરાષ્ટ્ર બોલ્યા-- ધર્મભૂમિ કુરુક્ષેત્રે યુદ્ધાર્થે એકઠા થઈ, મારા ને પાંડુના પુત્રો વર્ત્યા શી રીત, સંજય?
tr.en: Dhritarâshtra said: On the holy plain, on the field of Kuru, gathered together, eager for battle, what did they, O Sanjaya, my people and the Pândavas?

r: saYjaya uvAca . dfzwvA tu pARqavAnIkaM vyUQaM duryoDanastadA . AcAryamupasaNgamya rAjA vacanamabravIt .. 2 ..

tr.gu: સંજય બોલ્યા-- દેખી પાંડવની સેના ઊભેલી વ્યૂહને રચી, દ્રોણાચાર્ય કને પોં’ચી રાજા દુર્યોધને કહ્યું
tr.en: Sanjaya said: Having seen arrayed the army of the Pândavas, the Prince Duryodhana approached his teacher, and spake these words:

r: paSyEtAM pARquputrARAmAcArya mahatIM camUm . vyUQAM drupadaputreRa tava SizyeRa DImatA .. 3 ..

tr.gu: દુર્યોધન બોલ્યા-- જુઓ, આચાર્ય ! આ મોટી સેનાઓ પાંડવો તણી, જે તમ બુદ્ધિમાન્ શિષ્ય દ્રૌપદે વ્યૂહમાં રચી.
tr.en: "Behold this mighty host of the sons of Pându, O teacher, arrayed by the son of Drupada, thy wise disciple.

r: atra SUrA mahezvAsA BImArjunasamA yuDi . yuyuDAno virAwaSca drupadaSca mahAraTaH .. 4 ..

tr.gu: અહીં શૂરા ધનુર્ધારી ભીમ-અર્જુન શા રણે; યુયુધાન, વિરાટેય, દ્રુપદેય મહારથી;
tr.en: Heroes are these, mighty bowmen, to Bhîma and Arjuna equal in battle: Yuyudhâna, Virâta, and Drupada of the great car.

r: DfzwaketuScekitAnaH kASirAjaSca vIryavAn . purujitkuntiBojaSca SEbyaSca narapuNgavaH .. 5 ..

tr.gu: કાશી ને શિબિના શૂરા નરેન્દ્રો, ધૃષ્ટકેતુયે, ચેકિતાન તથા રાજા પુરુજિત કુંતિભોજનો
tr.en: ​ Drishtaketu, Chekitâna and the valiant King of Kâshi, Purujit and Kuntibhoja, and Shaivya, bull among men;

r: yuDAmanyuSca vikrAnta uttamOjASca vIryavAn . sOBadro drOpadeyASca sarva eva mahAraTAH .. 6 ..

tr.gu: પરાક્રમી યુધામન્યુ, ઉત્તમૌજા પ્રતાપવાન્, સૌભદ્ર, દ્રૌપદીપુત્રો, બધાયે જે મહારથી.
tr.en: Yudhâmanyu the strong, and Uttamaujas the brave; Saubhadra and the Draupadeyas, all of great cars.

r: asmAkaM tu viSizwA ye tAnniboDa dvijottama . nAyakA mama sEnyasya saMjYArTaM tAnbravImi te .. 7 ..

tr.gu: આપણા પક્ષના મુખ્ય, તેય, આચાર્ય ઓળખો; જાણવા યોગ્ય જે મારા સેનાના નાયકો કહું:
tr.en: Know further all those who are our chiefs, O best of the twice-born, the leaders of my army; these I name to thee for thy information:

r: BavAnBIzmaSca karRaSca kfpaSca samitiYjayaH . aSvatTAmA vikarRaSca sOmadattistaTEva ca .. 8 ..

tr.gu: આપ, ભીષ્મ તથા કર્ણ, સંગ્રામવિજયી કૃપ, અશ્વત્થામા, વિકર્ણેય, સોમદત્ત તણો સુત.
tr.en: ​ Thou, Lord, and Bhîshma, and Karna and Kripa, conquering in battle; Ashvatthâmâ, Vikarna, and Saumadatti also;

r: anye ca bahavaH SUrA madarTe tyaktajIvitAH . nAnASastrapraharaRAH sarve yudDaviSAradAH .. 9 ..

tr.gu: બીજાયે બહુ છે શૂરા, હું-કાજે જીવ જે ત્યજે; સર્વે યુદ્ધકળાપૂર્ણ, અસ્ત્રશસ્ત્રો વડે સજ્યા.
tr.en: And many others, heroes, for my sake renouncing their lives, with divers weapons and missiles, and all well-skilled in war.

r: aparyAptaM tadasmAkaM balaM BIzmABirakzitam . paryAptaM tvidametezAM balaM BImABirakzitam .. 10 ..

tr.gu: અગણ્ય આપણી સેના, જેના રક્ષક ભીષ્મ છે; ગ્ણ્ય છે એમની સેના, જેના રક્ષક ભીમ છે.
tr.en: Yet insufficient seems this army of ours, though marshalled by Bhîshma, while that army of theirs seems sufficient, though marshalled by Bhîma;

r: ayanezu ca sarvezu yaTABAgamavasTitAH . BIzmamevABirakzantu BavantaH sarva eva hi .. .. 11 ..

tr.gu: જેને જે ભાગમાં રાખ્યા, તે તે સૌ મોરચે રહી, ભીષ્મની સર્વ બાજુથી રક્ષા સૌ કરજો ભલી.
tr.en: Therefore in the rank and file let all, standing firmly in their respective divisions, guard Bhîshma, even all ye generals.

r: tasya saYjanayanharzaM kuruvfdDaH pitAmahaH . siMhanAdaM vinadyoccEH SaNKaM daDmO pratApavAn .. 12 ..

tr.gu: સંજય બોલ્યા— તેનો વધારવા હર્ષ, કરીને સિંહનાદ ત્યાં પ્રતાપી વૃદ્ધ દાદાએ બજાવ્યો શંખ જોરથી.
tr.en: To enhearten him, the Ancient of the Kurus, the Grandsire, the glorious, blew his conch, sounding on high a lion's roar.

r: tataH SaNKASca BeryaSca paRavAnakagomuKAH . sahasEvAByahanyanta sa Sabdastumulo'Bavat .. 13 ..

tr.gu: પછી તો શંખ, ભેરી ને નગારાં, રણશિંગડાં વાગ્યાં સૌ સામટાં એનો પ્રચંડ ધ્વનિ ઊપજ્યો.
tr.en: Then conches and kettledrums, tabors and drums and cowhorns, suddenly blared forth, and the sound was tumultuous.

r: tataH SvetErhayEryukte mahati syandane sTitO . mADavaH pARqavaScEva divyO SaNKO pradaDmatuH .. 14 ..

tr.gu: તે પછી શ્વેત અશ્વોથી જોડાયેલા મહારથે બેઠેલા માધવે-પાર્થે વગાડ્યા દિવ્ય શંખ બે.
tr.en: Then, stationed in their great war-chariot, yoked to white horses, Mâdhava and the son of Pându blew their divine conches.

r: pAYcajanyaM hfzIkeSo devadattaM DanaYjayaH . pORqraM daDmO mahASaNKaM BImakarmA vfkodaraH .. 15 ..

tr.gu: પાંચજન્ય હૃષીકેશે, દેવદત્ત ધનંજયે, વાયો પૌંડ્ર મહાશંખ ભીમકર્મા વૃકોદરે;
tr.en: Pânchajanya by Hrishîkesha, and Devadatta by Dhananjaya. Vrikodara of terrible deeds blew his mighty conch, Paundra;

r: anantavijayaM rAjA kuntIputro yuDizWiraH . nakulaH sahadevaSca suGozamaRipuzpakO .. 16 ..

tr.gu: અનંતજયને રાજા કુંતીપુત્ર યુધિષ્ઠિરે, નકુલે—સહદેવેયે, સુઘોષ-મણિપુષ્પક;
tr.en: ​ The King Yudhishthira, the son of Kuntî, blew Anantavijaya; Nakula and Sahadeva, Sughosha and Manipushpaka.

r: kASyaSca paramezvAsaH SiKaRqI ca mahAraTaH . Dfzwadyumno virAwaSca sAtyakiScAparAjitaH .. 17 ..

tr.gu: કાશીરાજા મહાધંવા ને શિખંડી મહારથી, ધૃષ્ટદ્યુમ્ન, વિરાટેય, અપરાજિત સાત્યકિ;
tr.en: And Kâshya, of the great bow and Shikhandî, the mighty car-warrior, Drishtadyumna and Virâta and Sâtyaki, the unconquered.

r: drupado drOpadeyASca sarvaSaH pfTivIpate . sOBadraSca mahAbAhuH SaNKAndaDmuH pfTakpfTak .. 18 ..

tr.gu: દ્રુપદ, દ્રૌપદીપુત્રો, અભિમન્યુ મહાભુજા, સહુએ સર્વ બાજુથી શંખો ફૂંક્યા જુદા જુદા.
tr.en: Drupada and the Draupadeyas, O Lord of earth, and Saubhadra, the mighty-armed, on all sides their several conches blew.

r: sa Gozo DArtarAzwrARAM hfdayAni vyadArayat . naBaSca pfTivIM cEva tumulo vyanunAdayan .. 19 ..

tr.gu: તે ઘોષે કૌરવો કેરી છાતીના કટકા કર્યા, અને આકાશ ને પૃથ્વી ભર્યાં ગર્જી ભયંકર.
tr.en: ​ That tumultuous uproar rent the hearts of the sons of Dhritarâshtra, filling the earth and sky with sound.

r: aTa vyavasTitAndfzwvA DArtarAzwrAnkapiDvajaH . pravftte SastrasampAte Danurudyamya pARqavaH .. 20 ..

tr.gu: ત્યાં શસ્ત્ર ચાલવા ટાણે કૌરવોને કપિધ્વજે વ્યવસ્થાથી ખડા ભાળી ઉઠાવ્યું સ્વધનુષ્યને,
tr.en: Then, beholding the sons of Dhritarâshtra standing arrayed, and flight of missiles about to begin, he whose crest is an ape, the son of Pându, took up his bow,

r: hfzIkeSaM tadA vAkyamidamAha mahIpate . arjuna uvAca . senayoruBayormaDye raTaM sTApaya me'cyuta .. 21 ..

tr.gu: ને હૃશીકેશને આવું કહ્યું વેણ, મહીપતે ! અર્જુન બોલ્યા- બન્ને આ સૈન્યની મધ્યે લો મારો રથ, અચ્યુત !
tr.en: And spake this word to Hrishîkesha, O Lord of Earth: Arjuna said: In the midst, between the two armies, stay my chariot, O Achyuta,

r: yAvadetAnnirIkze'haM yod‌DukAmAnavasTitAn . kErmayA saha yodDavyamasminraRasamudyame .. 22 ..

tr.gu: જ્યાં સુધી નીરખું કોણ ઊભા આ યુદ્ધ ઇચ્છતા, ને કોણ મુજ સાથે આ રણસંગ્રામ ખેલશે.
tr.en: That I may behold these standing, longing for battle, with whom I must strive in this outbreaking war,

r: yotsyamAnAnavekze'haM ya ete'tra samAgatAH . DArtarAzwrasya durbudDeryudDe priyacikIrzavaH .. 23 ..

tr.gu: અહીં ટોળે વળેલા આ યોદ્ધાઓ જોઉં તો જરા, પ્રિય જે ઇચ્છતા યુદ્ધે દુર્યોધન કુબુદ્ધિનું.
tr.en: And gaze on those here gathered together ready to fight, desirous of pleasing in battle the evil-minded son of Dhritarâshtra.

r: saYjaya uvAca . evamukto hfzIkeSo guqAkeSena BArata . senayoruBayormaDye sTApayitvA raTottamam .. 24 ..

tr.gu: સંજય બોલ્યા— ગુડાકેશ તણા આવા વેણને માધવે સુણી બે સૈન્ય વચમાં ઊભો કીધો તે ઉત્તમ રથ;
tr.en: Sanjaya said: Thus addressed by Gudâkesha, Hrishîkesha, O Bhârata, having stayed that best of chariots in the midst, between the two armies,

r: BIzmadroRapramuKataH sarvezAM ca mahIkzitAm . uvAca pArTa paSyEtAnsamavetAnkurUniti .. 25 ..

tr.gu: ભીષ્મ ને દ્રોણની સામે, ને સૌ રાજા ભણી ફરી, બોલ્યા માધવ, “જો, પાર્થ ! કૌરવોના સમૂહ આ.”
tr.en: Over against Bhîshma, Drona and all the rulers of the world, said: "O Pârtha, behold these Kurus gathered together."

r: tatrApaSyatsTitAnpArTaH pitFnaTa pitAmahAn . AcAryAnmAtulAnBrAtFnputrAnpOtrAnsaKIMstaTA .. 26 ..

tr.gu: ત્યાં દીઠા અર્જુન ઊભા બન્નેયે સૈન્યને વિષે-- ગુરુઓ, બાપ, ને દાદા, મામાઓ, ભાઈઓ, સખા,
tr.en: Then saw Pârtha standing there, uncles and grandfathers, teachers, mother's brothers, cousins, sons and grandsons, comrades,

r: SvaSurAnsuhfdaScEva senayoruBayorapi . tAnsamIkzya sa kOnteyaH sarvAnbanDUnavasTitAn .. 27 ..

tr.gu: સસરા, દીકરા, પોતા, સુહ્રદો, સ્વજનો ઘણા: આવા સર્વે સગાવ્હાલા ઊભેલા જોઈ, અર્જુન
tr.en: Fathers-in-law and benefactors also in both armies; seeing all these kinsmen thus standing arrayed, Kaunteya,

r: kfpayA parayA''vizwo vizIdannidamabravIt . arjuna uvAca . dfzwvemaM svajanaM kfzRa yuyutsuM samupasTitam .. 28 ..

tr.gu: અત્યંત રાંક ભાવે શું, બોલ્યો ગળગળો થઈ: અર્જુન બોલ્યા-- દેખો આ સ્વજનો સામે ઊભેલા યુદ્ધ ઇચ્છતા,
tr.en: Deeply moved to pity, thus uttered in sadness: Arjuna said: Seeing these my kinsmen, O Krishna, arrayed, eager to fight,

r: sIdanti mama gAtrARi muKaM ca pariSuzyati . vepaTuSca SarIre me romaharzaSca jAyate .. 29 ..

tr.gu: ગાત્રો ઢીલાં પડે મારાં , મોઢામાં શોષ ઊપજે; કંપારી દેહમાં ઊઠે(છૂટે?), રુવાડાં થાય છે ખડાં;
tr.en: My limbs fail and my mouth is parched, my body quivers, and my hair stands on end,

r: gARqIvaM sraMsate hastAttvakcEva paridahyate . na ca SaknomyavasTAtuM BramatIva ca me manaH .. 30 ..

tr.gu: ગાંડીવ હાથથી છૂટે, વ્યાપે દાહ ત્વચા વિશે; રહેવાય નહીં ઊભા, જાણે મારું ભમે મન.
tr.en: Gândîva slips from my hand, and my skin burns all over, I am not able to stand, my mind is whirling,

r: nimittAni ca paSyAmi viparItAni keSava . na ca Sreyo'nupaSyAmi hatvA svajanamAhave .. 31 ..

tr.gu: ચિહ્ નોયે અવળાં સર્વે, મ’ને દેખાય, કેશવ; જોઉં નહીં કંઈ શ્રેય હણીને સ્વજનો રણે.
tr.en: ​ And I see adverse omens, O Keshava. Nor do I foresee any advantage from slaying kinsmen in battle.

r: na kANkze vijayaM kfzRa na ca rAjyaM suKAni ca . kiM no rAjyena govinda kiM BogErjIvitena vA .. 32 ..

tr.gu: નથી હું ઇચ્છતો જીત, નહીં રાજ્ય, નહીં સુખો; રાજ કે ભોગ કે જીવ્યું, અમારે કામનું કશું?
tr.en: For I desire not victory, O Krishna, nor kingdom, nor pleasures; what is kingdom to us, O Govinda, what enjoyment or even life?

r: yezAmarTe kANkzitaM no rAjyaM BogAH suKAni ca . ta ime'vasTitA yudDe prARAMstyaktvA DanAni ca .. 33 ..

tr.gu: ઇચ્છીએ જેમને કાજે રાજ્ય કે ભોગ કે સુખો, તે આ ઊભા રણે આવી ત્યજીને પ્રાણ-વૈભવો.
tr.en: Those for whose sake we desire kingdom, enjoyments and pleasures, they stand here in battle, abandoning life and riches—

r: AcAryAH pitaraH putrAstaTEva ca pitAmahAH . mAtulAH SvaSurAH pOtrAH SyAlAH sambanDinastaTA .. 34 ..

tr.gu: ગુરુઓ, બાપ ને બેટા, દાદા—પોતા વળી ઘણા, મામાઓ, સસરા, સાળા, સંબંધી, સ્વજનો બધા.
tr.en: Teachers, fathers, sons, as well as grandfathers, ​ mother's brothers, fathers-in-law, grandsons, brothers-in-law, and other relatives.

r: etAnna hantumicCAmi Gnato'pi maDusUdana . api trElokyarAjyasya hetoH kiM nu mahIkfte .. 35 ..

tr.gu: ન ઇચ્છું હણવા આ સૌ, ભલે જાતે હણાઉં હું; ત્રિલોક-રાજ્ય કાજેયે, પૃથ્વી કારણ કેમ તો?
tr.en: These I do not wish to kill, though myself slain, O Madhusûdana, even for the sake of the kingship of the three worlds; how then for earth?

r: nihatya DArtarAzwrAnnaH kA prItiH syAjjanArdana . pApamevASrayedasmAnhatvEtAnAtatAyinaH .. 36 ..

tr.gu: હણીને કૌરવો સર્વે અમારું પ્રિય શું થશે? એમને આતતાયીને હણ્યાનું પાપ કેવળ !
tr.en: Slaying these sons of Dhritarâshtra, what pleasure can be ours, O Janârdana? Killing these desperadoes, sin will but take hold of us.

r: tasmAnnArhA vayaM hantuM DArtarAzwrAnsvabAnDavAn . svajanaM hi kaTaM hatvA suKinaH syAma mADava .. 37 ..

tr.gu: માટે ન હણવા યોગ્ય કૌરવો, અમ બંધુઓ; સ્વજનોને હણી કેમ પામીએ સુખને અમે?
tr.en: ​ Therefore we should not kill the sons of Dhritarâshtra, our relatives; for how, killing our kinsmen, may we be happy, O Mâdhava?

r: yadyapyete na paSyanti loBopahatacetasaH . kulakzayakftaM dozaM mitradrohe ca pAtakam .. 38 ..

tr.gu: લોભથી વણસી બુદ્ધિ તેથી તે પેખતા નથી, કુળક્ષયે થતો દોષ મિત્રદ્રોહેય પાપ જે.
tr.en: Although these, with intelligence overpowered by greed, see no guilt in the destruction of a family, no crime in hostility to friends,

r: kaTaM na jYeyamasmABiH pApAdasmAnnivartitum . kulakzayakftaM dozaM prapaSyadBirjanArdana .. 39 ..

tr.gu: વળવા પાપથી આવા અમે કાં ન વિચારવું,-- કુળક્ષયે થતો દોષ દેખતા સ્પષ્ટ જો અમે?
tr.en: Why should not we learn to turn away from such a sin, O Janârdana, who see the evils in the destruction of a family?

r: kulakzaye praRaSyanti kulaDarmAH sanAtanAH . Darme nazwe kulaM kftsnamaDarmo'BiBavatyuta .. 40 ..

tr.gu: કુળક્ષયે થતા નાશ કુળધર્મો સનાતન; ધર્મનાશે કુળે આખે વર્તે આણ અધર્મની.
tr.en: In the destruction of a family the immemorial ​ family traditions perish; in the perishing of tradition, lawlessness overcomes the whole family;

r: aDarmABiBavAtkfzRa praduzyanti kulastriyaH . strIzu duzwAsu vArzReya jAyate varRasaNkaraH .. 41 ..

tr.gu: અધર્મ વ્યાપતાં લાજ લૂંટાય કુળનારની; કુળસ્ત્રીઓ થયે ભ્રષ્ટ વર્ણસંકર નીપજે.
tr.en: Owing to predominance of lawlessness, O Krishna, the women of the family become corrupt; women corrupted, O Vârshneya, there ariseth caste confusion;

r: saNkaro narakAyEva kulaGnAnAM kulasya ca . patanti pitaro hyezAM luptapiRqodakakriyAH .. 42 ..

tr.gu: નરકે જ પડે તેથી કુળ ન કુળઘાતકો; પિતરોયે પડે હેઠા નમળ્યે પિંડતર્પણ.
tr.en: This confusion draggeth to hell the slayers of the family, and the family; for their ancestors fall, deprived of rice-balls and libations.

r: dozEretEH kulaGnAnAM varRasaNkarakArakEH . utsAdyante jAtiDarmAH kulaDarmASca SASvatAH .. 43 ..

tr.gu: કુળઘાતકના આવા દોષે સંકરકારક ઊખડે જાતિધર્મોને કુળધર્મો સનાતન.
tr.en: By these caste-confusing misdeeds of the slayers of the family, the everlasting caste customs and family customs are abolished.

r: utsannakulaDarmARAM manuzyARAM janArdana . narake niyataM vAso BavatItyanuSuSruma .. 44 ..

tr.gu: ઊખડે જે મનુષ્યોના કુળના ધર્મ, તેમનો સદાયે નરકે વાસ—આવું છે સાંભળ્યું અમે !
tr.en: The abode of the men whose family customs are extinguished, O Janârdana, is everlastingly in hell. Thus have we heard.

r: aho bata mahatpApaM kartuM vyavasitA vayam . yadrAjyasuKaloBena hantuM svajanamudyatAH .. 45 ..

tr.gu: અહો ! કેવું મહાપાપ માંડ્યું આદરવા અમે ! કે રાજ્યસુખના લોભે નીકળ્યા હણવા સગા !
tr.en: Alas! in committing a great sin are we engaged, we who are endeavouring to kill our kindred from greed of the pleasures of kingship.

r: yadi mAmapratIkAramaSastraM SastrapARayaH . DArtarAzwrA raRe hanyustanme kzemataraM Bavet .. 46 ..

tr.gu: ન કરતાં પ્રતીકાર મ’ને નિ:શસ્ત્રને હણે રણમાં કૌરવો શસ્ત્રે, તેમાં ક્ષેમ મ’ને વધુ.
tr.en: ​ If the sons of Dhritarâshtra, weapon in hand, should slay me, unresisting, unarmed, in the battle, that would for me be the better.

r: saYjaya uvAca . evamuktvA'rjunaH saNKye raTopasTa upAviSat . visfjya saSaraM cApaM SokasaMvignamAnasaH .. 47 ..

tr.gu: સંજય બોલ્યા-- આમ બોલી રણે પાર્થ ગયો બેસી રથાસને, ધનુષ્યબાણને છોડી, શોકૌદ્વેગથી ભર્યો.
tr.en: Sanjaya said: Having thus spoken on the battle-field, Arjuna sank down on the seat of the chariot, casting away his bow and arrow, his mind overborne by grief.

r: saYjaya uvAca . taM taTA kfpayA''vizwamaSrupUrRAkulekzaRam . vizIdantamidaM vAkyamuvAca maDusUdanaH .. 1 ..

tr.en: Sanjaya said: To him thus with pity overcome, with smarting brimming eyes, despondent, Madhusûdana spake these words:

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . kutastvA kaSmalamidaM vizame samupasTitam . anAryajuzwamasvargyamakIrtikaramarjuna .. 2 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: Whence hath this dejection befallen thee in this perilous strait, ignoble , heaven-closing , infamous, O Arjuna?

r: klEvyaM mA sma gamaH pArTa nEtattvayyupapadyate . kzudraM hfdayadOrbalyaM tyaktvottizwa parantapa .. 3 ..

tr.en: Yield not to impotence, O Partha! it doth not befit thee. Shake off this paltry faint-heartedness! Stand up, Parantapa!

r: arjuna uvAca . kaTaM BIzmamahaM saNKye droRaM ca maDusUdana . izuBiH pratiyotsyAmi pUjArhAvarisUdana .. 4 ..

tr.en: Arjuna said: How, O Madhusûdana, shall I attack Bhîshma and Drona with arrows in battle, they who are worthy of reverence, O slayer of foes?

r: gurUnahatvA hi mahAnuBAvAn Sreyo BoktuM BEkzyamapIha loke . hatvA'rTakAmAMstu gurUnihEva BuYjIya BogAnruDirapradigDAn .. 5 ..

tr.en: ​ Better in this world to eat even the beggar's crust than to slay these most noble Gurus. Slaying these Gurus, our well-wishers, I should taste of blood-besprinkled feasts.

r: na cEtadvidmaH kataranno garIyo yadvA jayema yadi vA no jayeyuH . yAneva hatvA na jijIvizAma: te'vasTitAH pramuKe DArtarAzwrAH .. 6 ..

tr.gu: સંજય બોલ્યા— આમ તે રાંકભાવે ને આંસુએ વ્યગ્ર દૃષ્ટિથી શોચતા પાર્થને આવાં વચનો માધવે કહ્યાં ૧ શ્રી ભગવાન બોલ્યા— ક્યાંથી મોહ તને આવો ઊપજ્યો વસમી પળે નહીં જે આર્યને શોભે, સ્વર્ગ ને યશ જે હરે? ૨ મા તું કાયર થા, પાર્થ, તને આ ઘટતું (શોભતું ) નથી; હૈયાના દૂબળા ભાવ છોડી ઊઠ, પરંતપ. ૩ અર્જુન બોલ્યા-- મારે જે પૂજવા યોગ્ય ભીષ્મ ને દ્રોણ, તે પ્રતિ કેમ હું રણસંગ્રામે બાણોથી યુદ્ધ આદરું? ૪ વિના હણીને ગુરુઓ મહાત્મા ભિક્ષા વડે જીવવું તેય સારું; હણી અમે તો ગુરુ અર્થવાંછુ લોહીભર્યાં માણશું ભોગ લોકે ! ૫ થાયે અમારો જય તેમનો વા-- શામાં અમારું હિત તે ન સૂઝે; જેને હણીને જીવવુંતે ગમે ના, સામા ખડા તે ધૃતરાષ્ટ્ર—પુત્રો.
tr.en: Nor know I which for us be the better, that we conquer them or they conquer us—these, whom having slain we should not care to live, even these arrayed against us, the sons of Dhritarâshtra.

r: kArpaRyadozopahatasvaBAvaH pfcCAmi tvAM DarmasammUQacetAH . yacCreyaH syAnniScitaM brUhi tanme Sizyaste'haM SADi mAM tvAM prapannam .. 7 ..

tr.gu: સ્વભાવ મેટ્યો મુજ રાંકભાવે, ન ધર્મ સૂઝે, તમને હું પૂછું; બોધો મ’ને નિશ્ચિત શ્રેય જેમાં, છું શિષ્ય, આવ્યો શરણે તમારે.
tr.en: My heart is weighed down with the vice of faintness; my mind is confused as to duty. I ask thee which may be the better—that tell me decisively. I am thy disciple, suppliant to Thee; teach me.

r: na hi prapaSyAmi mamApanudyAdyacCokamucCozaRamindriyARAm . avApya BUmAvasapatnamfdDaM rAjyaM surARAmapi cADipatyam .. 8 ..

tr.gu: સમૃદ્ધ ને શત્રુ વિનાનું રાજ્ય મળે જગે કે સુરલોકમાંયે; તોયે ન દેખું કંઈ શોક ટાળે મારી બધી ઇંન્દ્રિય તાવનારો.
tr.en: For I see not that it would drive away this anguish that withers up my senses, if I should attain unrivalled monarchy on earth, or even the sovereignty of the Shining Ones.

r: saYjaya uvAca . evamuktvA hfzIkeSaM guqAkeSaH parantapaH . na yotsya iti govindamuktvA tUzRIM baBUva ha .. 9 ..

tr.gu: સંજય બોલ્યા— પરંતપ, ગુડાકેશે આમ ગોવિંદને કહી, “હું તો નહીં લડું” એવું બોલી મૌન ધર્યું પછી.
tr.en: Sanjaya said: Gudâkesha, conqueror of his foes, having thus addressed Hrishîkesha and said to Govinda, "I will not fight!", became silent.

r: tamuvAca hfzIkeSaH prahasanniva BArata . senayoruBayormaDye vizIdantamidaM vacaH .. 10 ..

tr.gu: આમ બે સૈન્યની વચ્ચે ખેદે વ્યાપેલ પાર્થને હસતાં –શું હ્રષીકેશે આવાં ત્યાં વચનો કહ્યાં --
tr.en: Then Hrishîkesha, smiling, as it were, O Bhârata, spake these words to him, despondent, in the midst of the two armies:

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . aSocyAnanvaSocastvaM prajYAvAdAMSca BAzase . gatAsUnagatAsUMSca nAnuSocanti paRqitAH .. 11 ..

tr.gu: શ્રી ભગવાન બોલ્યા— ન ઘટે ત્યાં કરે શોક, ને વાતો જ્ઞાનની વદે ! પ્રાણો ગયા—રહ્યા તેનો જ્ઞાનીઓ શોક ના કરે.
tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: Thou grievest for those that should not be griev ​ ed for, yet speakest words of wisdom. The wise grieve neither for the living nor for the dead.

r: na tvevAhaM jAtu nAsaM na tvaM neme janADipAH . na cEva na BavizyAmaH sarve vayamataH param .. 12 ..

tr.en: Nor at any time verily was I not, nor thou, nor these princes of men, nor verily shall we ever cease to be, hereafter.

r: dehino'sminyaTA dehe kOmAraM yOvanaM jarA . taTA dehAntaraprAptirDIrastatra na muhyati .. 13 ..

tr.en: As the dweller in the body experienceth in the body childhood, youth, old age, so passeth he on to another body; the steadfast one grieveth not thereat.

r: mAtrAsparSAstu kOnteya SItozRasuKaduHKadAH . AgamApAyino'nityAstAMstitikzasva BArata .. 14 ..

tr.en: ​ The contacts of matter, O son of Kuntî, giving cold and heat, pleasure and pain, they come and go, impermanent; endure them bravely, O Bhârata.

r: yaM hi na vyaTayantyete puruzaM puruzarzaBa . samaduHKasuKaM DIraM so'mftatvAya kalpate .. 15 ..

tr.en: The man whom these torment not, O chief of men, balanced in pain and pleasure, steadfast, he is fitted for immortality.

r: nAsato vidyate BAvo nABAvo vidyate sataH . uBayorapi dfzwo'ntastvanayostattvadarSiBiH .. 16 ..

tr.en: The unreal hath no being; the real never ceaseth to be; the truth about both hath been perceived by the seers of the essence of things.

r: avinASi tu tadvidDi yena sarvamidaM tatam . vinASamavyayasyAsya na kaScitkartumarhati .. 17 ..

tr.en: ​ Know That to be indestructible by whom all this is pervaded. Nor can any work the destruction of that imperishable One.

r: antavanta ime dehA nityasyoktAH SarIriRaH . anASino'prameyasya tasmAdyuDyasva BArata .. 18 ..

tr.en: These bodies of the embodied One, who is eternal, indestructible and immeasurable, are known as finite. Therefore fight, O Bhârata.

r: ya enaM vetti hantAraM yaScEnaM manyate hatam . uBO tO na vijAnIto nAyaM hanti na hanyate .. 19 ..

tr.en: He who regardeth this as a slayer, and he who thinketh he is slain, both of them are ignorant. He slayeth not, nor is he slain.

r: na jAyate mriyate vA kadAcinnAyaM BUtvA BavitA vA na BUyaH . ajo nityaH SASvato'yaM purARo na hanyate hanyamAne SarIre .. 20 ..

tr.en: ​ He is not born, nor doth he die; nor having been, ceaseth he any more to be; unborn, perpetual, eternal and ancient, he is not slain when the body is slaughtered.

r: vedA'vinASinaM nityaM ya enamajamavyayam . kaTaM sa puruzaH pArTa kaM GAtayati hanti kam .. 21 ..

tr.en: Who knoweth him indestructible, perpetual, unborn, undiminishing, how can that man slay, O Pârtha, or cause to be slain?

r: vAsAMsi jIrRAni yaTA vihAya navAni gfhRAti naro'parARi . taTA SarIrARi vihAya jIrRAnyanyAni saMyAti navAni dehI .. 22 ..

tr.en: As a man, casting off worn-out garments, taketh new ones, so the dweller in the body, casting off worn-out bodies, entereth into others that are new.

r: nEnaM Cindanti SastrARi nEnaM dahati pAvakaH . na cEnaM kledayantyApo na Sozayati mArutaH .. 23 ..

tr.en: Weapons cleave him not, nor fire burneth him, nor waters wet him, nor wind drieth him away.

r: acCedyo'yamadAhyo'yamakledyo'Sozya eva ca . nityaH sarvagataH sTARuracalo'yaM sanAtanaH .. 24 ..

tr.en: Uncleavable he, incombustible he, and indeed neither to be wetted nor dried away; perpetual, all-pervasive, stable, immovable, ancient.

r: avyakto'yamacintyo'yamavikAryo'yamucyate . tasmAdevaM viditvEnaM nAnuSocitumarhasi .. 25 ..

tr.en: Unmanifest, unthinkable, immutable, he is called; therefore knowing him as such, thou shouldst not grieve.

r: aTa cEnaM nityajAtaM nityaM vA manyase mftam . taTApi tvaM mahAbAho nEnaM Socitumarhasi .. 26 ..

tr.en: Or if thou thinkest of him as being constantly ​ born and constantly dying, even then, O mighty-armed, thou shouldst not grieve.

r: jAtasya hi Druvo mftyurDruvaM janma mftasya ca . tasmAdaparihArye'rTe na tvaM Socitumarhasi .. 27 ..

tr.en: For certain is death for the born, and certain is birth for the dead; therefore over the inevitable thou shouldst not grieve.

r: avyaktAdIni BUtAni vyaktamaDyAni BArata . avyaktaniDanAnyeva tatra kA paridevanA .. 28 ..

tr.en: Beings are unmanifest in their origin, manifest in their midmost state, O Bhârata, unmanifest likewise are they in dissolution. What room then for lamentation?

r: AScaryavatpaSyati kaScidenamAScaryavadvadati taTEva cAnyaH . AScaryavaccEnamanyaH SfRoti SrutvA'pyenaM veda na cEva kaScit .. 29 ..

tr.en: ​ As marvellous one regardeth him; as marvellous another speaketh thereof; as marvellous another heareth thereof; yet having heard none indeed understandeth.

r: dehI nityamavaDyo'yaM dehe sarvasya BArata . tasmAtsarvARi BUtAni na tvaM Socitumarhasi .. 30 ..

tr.en: This dweller in the body of everyone is ever invulnerable, O Bhârata; therefore thou shouldst not grieve for any creature.

r: svaDarmamapi cAvekzya na vikampitumarhasi . DarmyAdDi yudDAcCreyo'nyatkzatriyasya na vidyate .. 31 ..

tr.en: Further, looking to thine own duty thou shouldst not tremble; for there is nothing more welcome to a Kshattriya than righteous war.

r: yadfcCayA copapannaM svargadvAramapAvftam . suKinaH kzatriyAH pArTa laBante yudDamIdfSam .. 32 ..

tr.en: ​ Happy the Kshattriyas, O Pârtha, who obtain such a fight, offered unsought as an open door to heaven.

r: aTa cettvamimaM DarmyaM saNgrAmaM na karizyasi . tataH svaDarmaM kIrtiM ca hitvA pApamavApsyasi .. 33 ..

tr.en: But if thou wilt not carry on this righteous warfare, then casting away thine own duty and thine honour, thou wilt incur sin.

r: akIrtiM cApi BUtAni kaTayizyanti te'vyayAm . samBAvitasya cAkIrtirmaraRAdatiricyate .. 34 ..

tr.en: Men will recount thy perpetual dishonour, and, to one highly esteemed, dishonour exceedeth death.

r: BayAdraRAduparataM maMsyante tvAM mahAraTAH . yezAM ca tvaM bahumato BUtvA yAsyasi lAGavam .. 35 ..

tr.en: The great car-warriors will think thee fled from ​ the battle from fear, and thou, that wast highly thought of by them, wilt be lightly held.

r: avAcyavAdAMSca bahUnvadizyanti tavAhitAH . nindantastava sAmarTyaM tato duHKataraM nu kim .. 36 ..

tr.en: Many unseemly words will be spoken by thine enemies, slandering thy strength; what more painful than that?

r: hato vA prApsyasi svargaM jitvA vA Bokzyase mahIm . tasmAduttizWa kOnteya yudDAya kftaniScayaH .. 37 ..

tr.en: Slain, thou wilt obtain heaven; victorious, thou wilt enjoy the earth; therefore stand up, O son of Kuntî, resolute to fight.

r: suKaduHKe same kftvA lABAlABO jayAjayO . tato yudDAya yujyasva nEvaM pApamavApsyasi .. 38 ..

tr.en: Taking as equal pleasure and pain, gain and loss, victory and defeat, gird thee for the battle; thus thou shalt not incur sin.

r: ezA te'BihitA sANKye budDiryoge tvimAM SfRu . budDyA yukto yayA pArTa karmabanDaM prahAsyasi .. 39 ..

tr.en: This teaching set forth to thee is in accordance with the Sâñkhya ; hear it now according to the Yoga , imbued with which teaching, O Pârtha, thou shalt cast away the bonds of action.

r: nehABikramanASo'sti pratyavAyo na vidyate . svalpamapyasya Darmasya trAyate mahato BayAt .. 40 ..

tr.en: In this there is no loss of effort, nor is there transgression. Even a little of this knowledge protects from great fear.

r: vyayasAyAtmikA budDirekeha kurunandana . bahuSAKA hyanantASca budDayo'vyavasAyinAm .. 41 ..

tr.en: The determinate Reason is but one-pointed, ​ O joy of the Kurus; many-branched and endless are the thoughts of the irresolute.

r: yAmimAM puzpitAM vAcaM pravadantyavipaScitaH . vedavAdaratAH pArTa nAnyadastIti vAdinaH .. 42 ..

tr.en: Flowery speech is uttered by the foolish, rejoicing in the letter of the Vedas, O Pârtha, saying: "There is naught but this";

r: kAmAtmAnaH svargaparA janmakarmaPalapradAm . kriyAviSezabahulAM BogESvaryagatiM prati .. 43 ..

tr.en: With desire for self , with heaven for goal, they offer birth as the fruit of action, and prescribe many and various ceremonies for the attainment of pleasure and lordship.

r: BogESvaryaprasaktAnAM tayA'pahftacetasAm . vyavasAyAtmikA budDiH samADO na viDIyate .. 44 ..

tr.en: ​ For them who cling to pleasure and lordship, whose minds are captivated by such teaching, is not designed this determinate Reason, on contemplation steadily bent.

r: trEguRyavizayA vedA nistrEguRyo BavArjuna . nirdvandvo nityasattvasTo niryogakzema AtmavAn .. 45 ..

tr.en: The Vedas deal with the three attributes ; be ​ thou above these three attributes, O Arjuna; beyond the pairs of opposites, ever steadfast in purity, careless of possessions, full of the Self .

r: yAvAnarTa udapAne sarvataH samplutodake . tAvAnsarvezu vedezu brAhmaRasya vijAnataH .. 46 ..

tr.en: All the Vedas are as useful to an enlightened Brâhmana as is a tank in a place covered all over with water.

r: karmaRyevADikAraste mA Palezu kadAcana . mA karmaPalaheturBUrmA te saNgo'stvakarmaRi .. 47 ..

tr.en: Thy business is with the action only, never with its fruits; so let not the fruit of action be thy motive, nor be thou to inaction attached.

r: yogasTaH kuru karmARi saNgaM tyaktvA DanaYjaya . sidDyasidDyoH samo BUtvA samatvaM yoga ucyate .. 48 ..

tr.en: ​ Perform action, O Dhananjaya, dwelling in union with the divine, renouncing attachments and balanced evenly in success and failure: equilibrium is called yoga.

r: dUreRa hyavaraM karma budDiyogAdDanaYjaya . budDO SaraRamanvicCa kfpaRAH PalahetavaH .. 49 ..

tr.en: Far lower than the Yoga of Discrimination is action, O Dhananjaya. Take thou refuge in the Pure Reason ; pitiable are they who work for fruit.

r: budDiyukto jahAtIha uBe sukftaduzkfte . tasmAdyogAya yujyasva yogaH karmasu kOSalam .. 50 ..

tr.en: United to the Pure Reason one abandoneth here both good and evil deeds; therefore cleave thou to yoga; yoga is skill in action.

r: karmajaM budDiyuktA hi PalaM tyaktvA manIziRaH . janmabanDavinirmuktAH padaM gacCantyanAmayam .. 51 ..

tr.en: The Sages, united to the Pure Reason , ​ renounce the fruit which action yieldeth, and, liberated from the bonds of birth, they go to the blissful seat.

r: yadA te mohakalilaM budDirvyatitarizyati . tadA gantAsi nirvedaM Srotavyasya Srutasya ca .. 52 ..

tr.en: When thy mind shall escape from this tangle of delusion, then thou shalt rise to indifference as to what has been heard and shall be heard.

r: SrutivipratipannA te yadA sTAsyati niScalA . samADAvacalA budDistadA yogamavApsyasi .. 53 ..

tr.en: When thy mind , bewildered by the Scriptures , shall stand immovable, fixed in contemplation, then shalt thou attain unto yoga .

r: arjuna uvAca . sTitaprajYasya kA BAzA samADisTasya keSava . sTitaDIH kiM praBAzeta kimAsIta vrajeta kim .. 54 ..

tr.en: Arjuna said: What the mark, of him who is stable of mind, steadfast in contemplation, O Keshava? How doth the stable-minded talk, how doth he sit, how walk?

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . prajahAti yadA kAmAnsarvAnpArTa manogatAn . AtmanyevAtmanA tuzwaH sTitaprajYastadocyate .. 55 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: When a man abandoneth, O Pârtha, all the desires of the heart , and is satisfied in the Self by the Self , then is he called stable in mind .

r: duHKezvanudvignamanAH suKezu vigataspfhaH . vItarAgaBayakroDaH sTitaDIrmunirucyate .. 56 ..

tr.en: He whose mind is free from anxiety amid pains, indifferent amid pleasures, loosed from ​ passion, fear and anger, is called a sage of stable mind.

r: yaH sarvatrAnaBisnehastattatprApya SuBASuBam . nABinandati na dvezwi tasya prajYA pratizWitA .. 57 ..

tr.en: He who on every side is without attachments, whatever hap of fair and foul, who neither likes nor dislikes, of such a one the understanding is well poised.

r: yadA saMharate cAyaM kUrmo'NgAnIva sarvaSaH . indriyARIndriyArTeByastasya prajYA pratizWitA .. 58 ..

tr.en: When, again, as a tortoise draws in on all sides its limbs, he withdraws his senses from the objects of sense, then is his understanding well poised.

r: vizayA vinivartante nirAhArasya dehinaH . rasavarjaM raso'pyasya paraM dfzwvA nivartate .. 59 ..

tr.en: ​ The objects of sense, but not the relish for them, turn away from an abstemious dweller in the body; and even relish turneth away from him after the Supreme is seen.

r: yatato hyapi kOnteya puruzasya vipaScitaH . indriyARi pramATIni haranti prasaBaM manaH .. 60 ..

tr.en: O son of Kuntî, the excited senses of even a wise man, though he be striving, impetuously carry away his mind .

r: tAni sarvARi saMyamya yukta AsIta matparaH . vaSe hi yasyendriyARi tasya prajYA pratizWitA .. 61 ..

tr.en: Having restrained them all, he should sit harmonised, I his supreme goal; for, whose senses are mastered, of him the understanding is well poised.

r: DyAyato vizayAnpuMsaH saNgastezUpajAyate . saNgAtsaYjAyate kAmaH kAmAtkroDo'BijAyate .. 62 ..

tr.en: Man, musing on the objects of sense, conceiveth an attachment to these; from attachment ariseth desire; from desire anger cometh forth;

r: kroDAdBavati sammohaH sammohAtsmftiviBramaH . smftiBraMSAdbudDinASo budDinASAtpraRaSyati .. 63 ..

tr.en: From anger proceedeth delusion; from delusion confused memory; from confused memory the destruction of Reason ; from destruction of Reason he perishes.

r: rAgadvezaviyuktEstuM vizayAnindriyEScaran . AtmavaSyErviDeyAtmA prasAdamaDigacCati .. 64 ..

tr.en: But the disciplined self, moving among sense-objects with senses free from attraction and repulsion, mastered by the Self, goeth to peace.

r: prasAde sarvaduHKAnAM hAnirasyopajAyate . prasannacetaso hyASu budDiH paryavatizWate .. 65 ..

tr.en: In that Peace the extinction of all pains ariseth for him, for of him whose heart is peaceful the Reason soon attaineth equilibrium.

r: nAsti budDirayuktasya na cAyuktasya BAvanA . na cABAvayataH SAntiraSAntasya kutaH suKam .. 66 ..

tr.en: There is no Pure Reason for the non-harmonised, nor for the non-harmonised is there concentration ; for him without concentration there is no peace, and for the unpeaceful how can there be happiness?

r: indriyARAM hi caratAM yanmano'nu viDIyate . tadasya harati prajYAM vAyurnAvamivAmBasi .. 67 ..

tr.en: Such of the roving senses as the mind yieldeth to, that hurries away the understanding , just ​ as the gale hurries away a ship upon the waters.

r: tasmAdyasya mahAbAho nigfhItAni sarvaSaH . indriyARIndriyArTeByastasya prajYA pratizWitA .. 68 ..

tr.en: Therefore, O mighty-armed, whose senses are all completely restrained from the objects of sense, of him the understanding is well poised.

r: yA niSA sarvaBUtAnAM tasyAM jAgarti saMyamI . yasyAM jAgrati BUtAni sA niSA paSyato muneH .. 69 ..

tr.en: That which is the night of all beings, for the disciplined man is the time of waking; when other beings are waking, then is it night for the sage who seeth .

r: ApUryamARamacalapratizWaM samudramApaH praviSanti yadvat . tadvatkAmA yaM praviSanti sarve sa SAntimApnoti na kAmakAmI .. 70 ..

tr.en: He attaineth Peace, into whom all desires flow as rivers flow into the ocean, which is filled with water, but remaineth unmoved—not he who desireth desires.

r: vihAya kAmAnyaH sarvAnpumAMScarati niHspfhaH . nirmamo nirahaNkAraH sa SAntimaDigacCati .. 71 ..

tr.en: Whoso forsaketh all desires and goeth onwards free from yearnings, selfless and without egoism—he goeth to Peace.

r: ezA brAhmI sTitiH pArTa nEnAM prApya vimuhyati . sTitvA'syAmantakAle'pi brahma nirvARamfcCati .. 72 ..

tr.en: This is the Eternal state, O son of Prithâ. Having attained thereto, none is bewildered. Who, even at the death-hour, is established therein, he goeth to the Nirvâna of the Eternal .

r: arjuna uvAca . jyAyasI cetkarmaRaste matA budDirjanArdana . tatkiM karmaRi Gore mAM niyojayasi keSava .. 1 ..

tr.en: Arjuna said: If it be thought by Thee that knowledge is superior to action, O Janârdana, why dost Thou, O Keshava, enjoin on me this terrible action?

r: vyAmiSreReva vAkyena budDiM mohayasIva me . tadekaM vada niScitya yena Sreyo'hamApnuyAm .. 2 ..

tr.en: With these perplexing words Thou only confusest my understanding ; therefore tell me with certainty the one way by which I may reach bliss.

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . loke'smindviviDA nizWA purA proktA mayA'naGa . jYAnayogena sANKyAnAM karmayogena yoginAm .. 3 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: In this world there is a twofold path, as I before said, O sinless one: that of yoga by knowledge, of the Sâñkhyas; and that of yoga by action, of the Yogis.

r: na karmaRAmanAramBAnnEzkarmyaM puruzo'Snute . na ca saMnyasanAdeva sidDiM samaDigacCati .. 4 ..

tr.en: Man winneth not freedom from action by abstaining from activity, nor by mere renunciation doth he rise to perfection.

r: na hi kaScitkzaRamapi jAtu tizWatyakarmakft . kAryate hyavaSaH karma sarvaH prakftijErguREH .. 5 ..

tr.en: Nor can anyone, even for an instant, remain really actionless; for helplessly is everyone driven to action by the qualities born of nature .

r: karmendriyARi saMyamya ya Aste manasA smaran . indriyArTAnvimUQAtmA miTyAcAraH sa ucyate .. 6 ..

tr.en: ​ Who sitteth, controlling the organs of action, but dwelling in his mind on the objects of the senses, that bewildered man is called a hypocrite.

r: yastvindriyARi manasA niyamyAraBate'rjuna . karmendriyEH karmayogamasaktaH sa viSizyate .. 7 ..

tr.en: But who, controlling the senses by the mind , O Arjuna, with the organs of action without attachment, performeth yoga by action , he is worthy.

r: niyataM kuru karma tvaM karma jyAyo hyakarmaRaH . SarIrayAtrA'pi ca te na prasiDyedakarmaRaH .. 8 ..

tr.en: Perform thou right action, for, action is superior to inaction, and, inactive, even the maintenance of thy body would not be possible.

r: yajYArTAtkarmaRo'nyatra loko'yaM karmabanDanaH . tadarTaM karma kOnteya muktasaNgaH samAcara .. 9 ..

tr.en: The world is bound by action, unless performed for the sake of sacrifice; for that sake, free from attachment, O son of Kuntî, perform thou action.

r: sahayajYAH prajAH sfzwvA purovAca prajApatiH . anena prasavizyaDvameza vo'stvizwakAmaDuk .. 10 ..

tr.en: Having in ancient times emanated mankind together with sacrifice, the Lord of emanation said: "By this shall ye propagate; be this to you the giver of desire ;

r: devAnBAvayatAnena te devA BAvayantu vaH . parasparaM BAvayantaH SreyaH paramavApsyaTa .. 11 ..

tr.en: "With this nourish ye the Shining Ones, and ​ may the Shining Ones nourish you; thus nourishing one another ye shall reap the supremest good.

r: izwAnBogAnhi vo devA dAsyante yajYaBAvitAH . tErdattAnapradAyEByo yo BuNkte stena eva saH .. 12 ..

tr.en: "For, nourished by sacrifice, the Shining Ones shall bestow on you the enjoyments you desire." A thief verily is he who enjoyeth what is given by Them without returning Them aught.

r: yajYaSizwASinaH santo mucyante sarvakilbizEH . BuYjate te tvaGaM pApA ye pacantyAtmakAraRAt .. 13 ..

tr.en: The righteous, who eat the remains of the sacrifice, are freed from all sins; but the impious, who dress food for their own sakes, they verily eat sin.

r: annAdBavanti BUtAni parjanyAdannasaMBavaH . yajYAdBavati parjanyo yajYaH karmasamudBavaH .. 14 ..

tr.en: From food creatures become; from rain is the ​ production of food; rain proceedeth from sacrifice; sacrifice ariseth out of action.

r: karma brahmodBavaM vidDi brahmA'kzarasamudBavam . tasmAtsarvagataM brahma nityaM yajYe pratizWitam .. 15 ..

tr.en: Know thou that from Brahma action groweth, and Brahma from the Imperishable cometh. Therefore the Eternal , the all-permeating, is ever present in sacrifice.

r: evaM pravartitaM cakraM nAnuvartayatIha yaH . aGAyurindriyArAmo moGaM pArTa sa jIvati .. 16 ..

tr.en: He who on earth doth not follow the wheel thus revolving, sinful of life and rejoicing in the senses, he, O son of Pritha, liveth in vain.

r: yastvAtmaratireva syAdAtmatfptaSca mAnavaH . Atmanyeva ca santuzwastasya kAryaM na vidyate .. 17 ..

tr.en: But the man who rejoiceth in the Self , with ​ the Self is satisfied, and is content in the Self , for him verily there is nothing to do;

r: nEva tasya kftenArTo nAkfteneha kaScana . na cAsya sarvaBUtezu kaScidarTavyapASrayaH .. 18 ..

tr.en: For him there is no interest in things done, in this world, nor any in things not done, nor doth any object of his depend on any being.

r: tasmAdasaktaH satataM kAryaM karma samAcara . asakto hyAcarankarma paramApnoti pUruzaH .. 19 ..

tr.en: Therefore, without attachment, constantly perform action which is duty, for, by performing action without attachment, man verily reacheth the Supreme.

r: karmaREva hi saMsidDimAsTitA janakAdayaH . lokasaNgrahamevApi sampaSyankartumarhasi .. 20 ..

tr.en: Janaka and others indeed attained to perfection by action: then having an eye to the welfare of he world also, thou shouldst perform action.

r: yadyadAcarati SrezWastattadevetaro janaH . sa yatpramARaM kurute lokastadanuvartate .. 21 ..

tr.en: Whatsoever a great man doeth, that other men also do; the standard he setteth up, by that the people go.

r: na me pArTAsti kartavyaM trizu lokezu kiYcana . nAnavAptamavAptavyaM varta eva ca karmaRi .. 22 ..

tr.en: There is nothing in the three worlds, O Pârtha, that should be done by Me, nor anything unattained that might be attained; yet I mingle in action.

r: yadi hyahaM na varteyaM jAtu karmaRyatandritaH . mama vartmAnuvartante manuzyAH pArTa sarvaSaH .. 23 ..

tr.en: For if I mingled not ever in action unwearied, men all around would follow My path, O son of Prithâ.

r: utsIdeyurime lokA na kuryAM karma cedaham . saNkarasya ca kartA syAmupahanyAmimAH prajAH .. 24 ..

tr.en: ​ These worlds would fall into ruin, if I did not perform action; I should be the author of confusion of castes, and should destroy these creatures.

r: saktAH karmaRyavidvAMso yaTA kurvanti BArata . kuryAdvidvAMstaTA'saktaScikIrzurlokasaNgraham .. 25 ..

tr.en: As the ignorant act from attachment to action, O Bhârata, so should the wise act without attachment, desiring the welfare of the world.

r: na budDiBedaM janayedajYAnAM karmasaNginAm . jozayetsarvakarmARi vidvAnyuktaH samAcaran .. 26 ..

tr.en: Let no wise man unsettle the mind of ignorant people attached to action; but acting in harmony with Me let him render all action attractive.

r: prakfteH kriyamARAni guREH karmARi sarvaSaH . ahaNkAravimUQAtmA kartA'hamiti manyate .. 27 ..

tr.en: All actions are wrought by the quali ​ ties of nature only. The self, deluded by egoism , thinketh: "I am the doer."

r: tattvavittu mahAbAho guRakarmaviBAgayoH . guRA guRezu vartanta iti matvA na sajjate .. 28 ..

tr.en: But he, O mighty-armed, who knoweth the essence of the divisions of the qualities and functions, holding that "the qualities move amid the qualities," is not attached.

r: prakfterguRasammUQAH sajjante guRakarmasu . tAnakftsnavido mandAnkftsnavinna vicAlayet .. 29 ..

tr.en: Those deluded by the qualities of nature are attached to the functions of the qualities. The man of perfect knowledge should not unsettle the foolish whose knowledge is imperfect.

r: mayi sarvARi karmARi saMnyasyA'DyAtmacetasA . nirASIrnirmamo BUtvA yuDyasva vigatajvaraH .. 30 ..

tr.en: Surrendering all actions to Me, with thy thoughts resting on the supreme Self , from hope and egoism freed, and of mental fever cured, engage in battle.

r: ye me matamidaM nityamanutizWanti mAnavAH . SradDAvanto'nasUyanto mucyante te'pi karmaBiH .. 31 ..

tr.en: Who abide ever in this teaching of Mine full of faith and free from caviling, they too are released from actions.

r: ye tvetadaByasUyanto nAnutizWanti me matam . sarvajYAnavimUQAMstAnvidDi nazwAnacetasaH .. 32 ..

tr.en: Who carp at My teaching and act not thereon, senseless, deluded in all knowledge, know thou these mindless ones as fated to be destroyed.

r: sadfSaM cezwate svasyAH prakfterjYAnavAnapi . prakftiM yAnti BUtAni nigrahaH kiM karizyati .. 33 ..

tr.en: ​ Even the man of knowledge behaves in conformity with his own nature; beings follow nature; what shall restraint avail?

r: indriyasyendriyasyArTe rAgadvezO vyavasTitO . tayorna vaSamAgacCettO hyasya paripanTinO .. 34 ..

tr.en: Affection and aversion for the objects of sense abide in the senses; let none come under the dominion of these two; they are obstructors of the path.

r: SreyAnsvaDarmo viguRaH paraDarmAtsvanuzWitAt . svaDarme niDanaM SreyaH paraDarmo BayAvahaH .. 35 ..

tr.en: Better one's own duty, though destitute of merit, than the duty of another, well discharged. Better death in the discharge of one's own duty; the duty of another is full of danger.

r: arjuna uvAca . aTa kena prayukto'yaM pApaM carati pUruzaH . anicCannapi vArzReya balAdiva niyojitaH .. 36 ..

tr.en: Arjuna said: But dragged on by what does a man commit ​ sin, reluctantly indeed, O Varshneya, as it were by force constrained?

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . kAma eza kroDa eza rajoguRasamudBavaH . mahASano mahApApmA vidDyenamiha vEriRam .. 37 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: It is desire, it is wrath, begotten by the quality of motion ; all-consuming, all-polluting, know thou this as our foe here on earth.

r: DUmenA'vriyate vahniryaTA''darSo malena ca . yaTolbenAvfto garBastaTA tenedamAvftam .. 38 ..

tr.en: As a flame is enveloped by smoke, as a mirror by dust, as an embryo is wrapped by the amnion, so This is enveloped by it.

r: AvftaM jYAnametena jYAnino nityavEriRA . kAmarUpeRa kOnteya duzpUreRAnalena ca .. 39 ..

tr.en: ​ Enveloped is wisdom by this constant enemy of the wise in the form of desire, which is insatiable as a flame.

r: indriyARi mano budDirasyADizWAnamucyate . etErvimohayatyeza jYAnamAvftya dehinam .. 40 ..

tr.en: The senses, the mind and the Reason are said to be its seat; by these enveloping wisdom, it bewilders the dweller in the body.

r: tasmAttvamindriyARyAdO niyamya BaratarzaBa . pApmAnaM prajahi hyenaM jYAnavijYAnanASanam .. 41 ..

tr.en: Therefore, O best of the Bhâratas, mastering first the senses, do thou slay this thing of sin, destructive of wisdom and knowledge.

r: indriyARi parARyAhurindriyeByaH paraM manaH . manasastu parA budDiryo budDeH paratastu saH .. 42 ..
evaM budDeH paraM buDvA saMstaByAtmAnamAtmanA . jahi SatruM mahAbAho kAmarUpaM durAsadam .. 43 ..

tr.en: Thus understanding Him as greater than the Reason, restraining the self by the Self , slay thou, O mighty-armed, the enemy in the form of desire, difficult to overcome.

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . imaM vivasvate yogaM proktavAnahamavyayam . vivasvAnmanave prAha manurikzvAkave'bravIt .. 1 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: This imperishable yoga I declared to Vivasvân; Vivasvân taught it to Manu; Manu to Ikshvâku told it.

r: evaM paramparAprAptamimaM rAjarzayo viduH . sa kAleneha mahatA yogo nazwaH parantapa .. 2 ..

tr.en: This, handed on down the line, the King-Sages knew. This yoga by great efflux of time decayed in the world, O Parantapa.

r: sa evA'yaM mayA te'dya yogaH proktaH purAtanaH . Bakto'si me saKA ceti rahasyaM hyetaduttamam .. 3 ..

tr.en: This same ancient yoga hath been to-day declared to thee by Me, for thou art My devotee and My friend; it is the supreme Secret.

r: arjuna uvAca . aparaM Bavato janma paraM janma vivasvataH . kaTametadvijAnIyAM tvamAdO proktavAniti .. 4 ..

tr.en: Arjuna said: Later was Thy birth, earlier the birth of Vivasvân; how then am I to understand that Thou declaredst it in the beginning?

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . bahUni me vyatItAni janmAni tava cArjuna . tAnyahaM veda sarvARi na tvaM vetTa parantapa .. 5 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: Many births have been left behind by Me and by thee, O Arjuna. I know them all, but thou knowest not thine, O Parantapa.

r: ajo'pi sannavyayAtmA BUtAnAmISvaro'pi san . prakftiM svAmaDizwAya samBavAmyAtmamAyayA .. 6 ..

tr.en: Though unborn, the imperishable Self , and also the Lord of all beings, brooding over nature ​ which is Mine own, yet I am born through My own Power.

r: yadA yadA hi Darmasya glAnirBavati BArata . aByutTAnamaDarmasya tadA''tmAnaM sfjAmyaham .. 7 ..

tr.en: Whenever there is decay of righteousness, O Bhârata, and there is exaltation of unrighteousness, then I Myself come forth;

r: paritrARAya sADUnAM vinASAya ca duzkftAm . DarmasaMsTApanArTAya samBavAmi yuge yuge .. 8 ..

tr.en: For the protection of the good, for the destruction of evil-doers, for the sake of firmly establishing righteousness, I am born from age to age.

r: janma karma ca me divyamevaM yo vetti tattvataH . tyaktvA dehaM punarjanma nEti mAmeti so'rjuna .. 9 ..

tr.en: He who thus knoweth My divine birth and action, in its essence, having abandoned the body, cometh not to birth again, but cometh unto Me, O Arjuna.

r: vItarAgaBayakroDA manmayA mAmupASritAH . bahavo jYAnatapasA pUtA madBAvamAgatAH .. 10 ..

tr.en: Freed from passion, fear and anger, filled with Me, taking refuge in Me, purified in the fire of wisdom, many have entered into My Being.

r: ye yaTA mAM prapadyante tAMstaTEva BajAmyaham . mama vartmAnuvartante manuzyAH pArTa sarvaSaH .. 11 ..

tr.en: However men approach Me, even so do I welcome them, for the path men take from every side is Mine, O Pârtha.

r: kANkzantaH karmaRAM sidDiM yajanta iha devatAH . kzipraM hi mAnuze loke sidDirBavati karmajA .. 12 ..

tr.en: They who long after success in action on earth worship the Shining Ones; for in brief space verily, in this world of men, success is born of action.

r: cAturvarRyaM mayA sfzwaM guRakarmaviBAgaSaH . tasya kartAramapi mAM vidDyakartAramavyayam .. 13 ..

tr.en: The four castes were emanated by Me, by the different distribution of qualities and actions; know Me to be the author of them, though the actionless and inexhaustible.

r: na mAM karmARi limpanti na me karmaPale spfhA . iti mAM yo'BijAnAti karmaBirna sa badDyate .. 14 ..

tr.en: Nor do actions affect Me, nor is the fruit of action desired by Me. He who thus knoweth Me is not bound by actions.

r: evaM jYAtvA kftaM karma pUrvErapi mumukzuBiH . kuru karmEva tasmAttvaM pUrvEH pUrvataraM kftam .. 15 ..

tr.en: Having thus known, our forefathers, ever seeking liberation, performed action; therefore do thou also perform action, as did our forefathers in the olden time.

r: kiM karma kimakarmeti kavayo'pyatra mohitAH . tatte karma pravakzyAmi yajjYAtvA mokzyase'SuBAt .. 16 ..

tr.en: "What is action, what inaction"? Even the wise are herein perplexed. Therefore I will declare to thee the action by knowing which thou shalt be loosed from evil.

r: karmaRo hyapi bodDavyaM bodDavyaM ca vikarmaRaH . akarmaRaSca bodDavyaM gahanA karmaRo gatiH .. 17 ..

tr.en: It is needful to discriminate action, to discriminate unlawful action, and to discriminate inaction; mysterious is the path of action.

r: karmaRyakarma yaH paSyedakarmaRi ca karma yaH . sa budDimAnmanuzyezu sa yuktaH kftsnakarmakft .. 18 ..

tr.en: He who seeth inaction in action, and action in inaction, he is wise among men, he is harmonious, even while performing all action.

r: yasya sarve samAramBAH kAmasaNkalpavarjitAH . jYAnAgnidagDakarmARaM tamAhuH paRqitaM buDAH .. 19 ..

tr.en: Whose works are all free from the moulding of desire, whose actions are burned up by the fire of wisdom, him the wise have called a Sage.

r: tyaktvA karmaPalAsaNgaM nityatfpto nirASrayaH . karmaRyaBipravftto'pi nEva kiYcitkaroti saH .. 20 ..

tr.en: Having abandoned attachment to the fruit of action, always content, nowhere seeking refuge, he is not doing anything, although doing actions.

r: nirASIryatacittAtmA tyaktasarvaparigrahaH . SArIraM kevalaM karma kurvannApnoti kilbizam .. 21 ..

tr.en: ​ Hoping for naught, his mind and self controlled, having abandoned all greed, performing action by the body alone, he doth not commit sin.

r: yadfcCAlABasantuzwo dvandvAtIto vimatsaraH . samaH sidDAvasidDO ca kftvA'pi na nibaDyate .. 22 ..

tr.en: Content with whatsoever he obtaineth without effort, free from the pairs of opposites, without envy, balanced in success and failure, though acting he is not bound.

r: gatasaNgasya muktasya jYAnAvasTitacetasaH . yajYAyAcarataH karma samagraM pravilIyate .. 23 ..

tr.en: Of one with attachment dead, harmonious, with his thoughts established in wisdom, his works sacrifices, all action melts away.

r: brahmArpaRaM brahma havirbrahmAgnO brahmaRA hutam . brahmEva tena gantavyaM brahmakarmasamADinA .. 24 ..

tr.en: The Eternal the oblation, the Eternal the clarified butter, are offered in the Eternal the ​ fire by the Eternal ; unto the Eternal verily shall he go who in his action meditateth wholly upon the Eternal .

r: dEvamevApare yajYaM yoginaH paryupAsate . brahmAgnAvapare yajYaM yajYenEvopajuhvati .. 25 ..

tr.en: Some Yogis offer up sacrifice to the Shining Ones ; others sacrifice only by pouring sacrifice into the fire of the Eternal ;

r: SrotrAdInIndriyARyanye saMyamAgnizu juhvati . SabdAdInvizayAnanya indriyAgnizu juhvati .. 26 ..

tr.en: Some pour as sacrifice hearing and the other senses into the fires of restraint; some pour sound and the other objects of sense into the fires of the senses as sacrifice;

r: sarvARIndriyakarmARi prARakarmARi cApare . AtmasaMyamayogAgnO juhvati jYAnadIpite .. 27 ..

tr.en: Others again into the wisdom-kindled fire of union attained by self-control, pour as sacrifice all the functions of the senses and the functions of life;

r: dravyayajYAstapoyajYA yogayajYAstaTA'pare . svADyAyajYAnayajYASca yatayaH saMSitavratAH .. 28 ..

tr.en: Yet others the sacrifice of wealth, the sacrifice of austerity, the sacrifice of yoga, the sacrifice of silent reading and wisdom, men concentrated and of effectual vows;

r: apAne juhvati prARaM prARe'pAnaM taTA'pare . prARApAnagatI ruDvA prARAyAmaparAyaRAH .. 29 ..

tr.en: Yet others pour as sacrifice the outgoing breath in the incoming, and the incoming in the outgoing, restraining the flow of the outgoing and ​ incoming breaths, solely absorbed in the control of breathing.

r: apare niyatAhArAH prARAnprARezu juhvati . sarve'pyete yajYavido yajYakzapitakalmazAH .. 30 ..

tr.en: Others regular in food, pour as sacrifice their life-breaths in life-breaths. All these are knowers of sacrifice, and by sacrifice have destroyed their sins.

r: yajYaSizwAmftaBujo yAnti brahma sanAtanam . nAyaM loko'styayajYasya kuto'nyaH kurusattama .. 31 ..

tr.en: The eaters of the life-giving remains of sacrifice go to the changeless Eternal . This world is not for the non-sacrificer, much less the other, O best of the Kurus.

r: evaM bahuviDA yajYA vitatA brahmaRo muKe . karmajAnvidDi tAnsarvAnevaM jYAtvA vimokzyase .. 32 ..

tr.en: Many and various sacrifices are thus spread out before the Eternal . Know thou that all these are born of action, and thus knowing thou shalt be free.

r: SreyAndravyamayAdyajYAjjYAnayajYaH parantapa . sarvaM karmAKilaM pArTa jYAne parisamApyate .. 33 ..

tr.en: Better than the sacrifice of any objects is the sacrifice of wisdom, O Parantapa. All actions in their entirety, O Pârtha, culminate in wisdom.

r: tadvidDi praRipAtena paripraSnena sevayA . upadekzyanti te jYAnaM jYAninastattvadarSinaH .. 34 ..

tr.en: Learn thou this by discipleship, by investiga ​ tion, and by service. The wise, the seers of the essence of things, will instruct thee in wisdom.

r: yajjYAtvA na punarmohamevaM yAsyasi pARqava . yena BUtAnyaSezeRa drakzyasyAtmanyaTo mayi .. 35 ..

tr.en: And having known this, thou shalt not again fall into this confusion, O Pândava; for by this thou wilt see all beings without exception in the Self , and thus in Me.

r: api cedasi pApeByaH sarveByaH pApakfttamaH . sarvaM jYAnaplavenEva vfjinaM santarizyasi .. 36 ..

tr.en: Even if thou art the most sinful of all sinners, yet shalt thou cross over all sin by the raft of wisdom.

r: yaTEDAMsi samidDo'gnirBasmasAtkurute'rjuna . jYAnAgniH sarvakarmARi BasmasAtkurute taTA .. 37 ..

tr.en: As the burning fire reduces fuel to ashes, O Arjuna, so doth the fire of wisdom reduce all actions to ashes.

r: na hi jYAnena sadfSaM pavitramiha vidyate . tatsvayaM yogasaMsidDaH kAlenAtmani vindati .. 38 ..

tr.en: Verily there is no purifier in this world like wisdom; he that is perfected in yoga finds it in the Self in due season.

r: SradDAvA~llaBate jYAnaM tatparaH saMyatendriyaH . jYAnaM labDvA parAM SAntimacireRADigacCati .. 39 ..

tr.en: The man who is full of faith obtaineth wisdom, and he also who hath mastery over his senses; and, having obtained wisdom, he goeth swiftly to the supreme Peace.

r: ajYaScASraddaDAnaSca saMSayAtmA vinaSyati . nAyaM loko'sti na paro na suKaM saMSayAtmanaH .. 40 ..

tr.en: But the ignorant, faithless, doubting self goeth to destruction; nor this world, nor that beyond, nor happiness, is there for the doubting self.

r: yogasaMnyastakarmARaM jYAnasaYCinnasaMSayam . AtmavantaM na karmARi nibaDnanti DanaYjaya .. 41 ..

tr.en: He who hath renounced actions by yoga, who hath cloven asunder doubt by wisdom, who is ruled by the Self , actions do not bind him, O Dhananjaya.

r: tasmAdajYAnasamBUtaM hftsTaM jYAnAsinA''tmanaH . CittvEnaM saMSayaM yogamAtizWottizWa BArata .. 42 ..

tr.en: Therefore, with the sword of the wisdom of the Self cleaving asunder this ignorance-born doubt dwelling in thy heart, be established in yoga. Stand up, O Bhârata.

r: arjuna uvAca . saMnyAsaM karmaRAM kfzRa punaryogaM ca SaMsasi . yacCreya etayorekaM tanme brUhi suniScitam .. 1 ..

tr.en: Arjuna said: Renunciation of actions Thou praisest, O Krishna, and then also yoga. Of the two which one is the better? That tell me conclusively.

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . saMnyAsaH karmayogaSca niHSreyasakarAvuBO . tayostu karmasaMnyAsAtkarmayogo viSizyate .. 2 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: Renunciation and yoga by action both lead to the highest bliss; of the two, yoga by action is verily better than renunciation of action.

r: jYeyaH sa nityasaMnyAsI yo na dvezwi na kANkzati . nirdvandvo hi mahAbAho suKaM banDAtpramucyate .. 3 ..

tr.en: ​ He should be known as a perpetual ascetic, who neither hateth nor desireth; free from the pairs of opposites, O mighty-armed, he is easily set free from bondage.

r: sANKyayogO pfTagbAlAH pravadanti na paRqitAH . ekamapyAsTitaH samyaguBayorvindate Palam .. 4 ..

tr.en: Children, not sages, speak of the Sânkhya and the Yoga as different; he who is duly established in one obtaineth the fruits of both.

r: yatsANKyEH prApyate sTAnaM tadyogErapi gamyate . ekaM sANKyaM ca yogaM ca yaH paSyati sa paSyati .. 5 ..

tr.en: That place which is gained by the Sânkhyas is reached by the Yogîs also. He seeth, who seeth that the Sânkhya and the Yoga are one.

r: saMnyAsastu mahAbAho duHKamAptumayogataH . yogayukto munirbrahma na cireRADigacCati .. 6 ..

tr.en: ​ But without yoga, O mighty-armed, renunciation is hard to attain to; the yoga-harmonised Muni swiftly goeth to the Eternal .

r: yogayukto viSudDAtmA vijitAtmA jitendriyaH . sarvaBUtAtmaBUtAtmA kurvannapi na lipyate .. 7 ..

tr.en: He who is harmonised by yoga, the self purified, Self -ruled, the senses subdued, whose Self is the Self of all beings, although acting he is not affected.

r: nEva kiYcitkaromIti yukto manyeta tattvavit . paSyanSfRvanspfSaYjiGrannaSnangacCanSvasansvapan .. 8 ..

tr.en: "I do not anything," should think the harmonised one, who knoweth the essence of things; seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, moving, sleeping, breathing.

r: pralapanvisfjangfhRannunmizannimizannapi . indriyARIndriyArTezu vartanta iti DArayan .. 9 ..

tr.en: Speaking, giving, grasping, opening and closing ​ the eyes, he holdeth: "The senses move among the objects of the senses."

r: brahmaRyADAya karmARi saNgaM tyaktvA karoti yaH . lipyate na sa pApena padmapatramivAmBasA .. 10 ..

tr.en: He who acteth, placing all actions in the Eternal , abandoning attachment, is unaffected by sin as a lotus leaf by the waters.

r: kAyena manasA budDyA kevalErindriyErapi . yoginaH karma kurvanti saNgaM tyaktvA''tmaSudDaye .. 11 ..

tr.en: Yogis , having abandoned attachment, perform action only by the body, by the mind , by the Reason , and even by the senses, for the purification of the self.

r: yuktaH karmaPalaM tyaktvA SAntimApnoti nEzWikIm . ayuktaH kAmakAreRa Pale sakto nibaDyate .. 12 ..

tr.en: The harmonised man, having abandoned the fruit of action, attaineth to the eternal Peace; ​ the non-harmonised, impelled by desire, attached to fruit, are bound.

r: sarvakarmARi manasA saMnyasyAste suKaM vaSI . navadvAre pure dehI nEva kurvanna kArayan .. 13 ..

tr.en: Mentally renouncing all actions, the sovereign dweller in the body resteth serenely in the nine-gated city, neither acting nor causing to act.

r: na kartftvaM na karmARi lokasya sfjati praBuH . na karmaPalasaMyogaM svaBAvastu pravartate .. 14 ..

tr.en: The Lord of the world produceth not the idea of agency, nor actions, nor the union together of action and its fruit; nature, however, manifesteth.

r: nAdatte kasyacitpApaM na cEva sukftaM viBuH . ajYAnenAvftaM jYAnaM tena muhyanti jantavaH .. 15 ..

tr.en: The Lord accepteth neither the evil-doing nor ​ yet the well-doing of any. Wisdom is enveloped by unwisdom; therewith mortals are deluded.

r: jYAnena tu tadajYAnaM yezAM nASitamAtmanaH . tezAmAdityavajjYAnaM prakASayati tatparam .. 16 ..

tr.en: Verily, in whom unwisdom is destroyed by the wisdom of the Self , in them wisdom, shining as the sun, reveals the Supreme.

r: tadbudDayastadAtmAnastannizWAstatparAyaRAH . gacCantyapunarAvfttiM jYAnanirDUtakalmazAH .. 17 ..

tr.en: Thinking on That , merged in That , established in That , solely devoted to That , they go whence there is no return, their sins dispelled by wisdom.

r: vidyAvinayasampanne brAhmaRe gavi hastini . Suni cEva SvapAke ca paRqitAH samadarSinaH .. 18 ..

tr.en: Sages look equally on a Brâhmana adorned ​ with learning and humility, a cow, an elephant, and even a dog and an outcaste.

r: ihEva tErjitaH sargo yezAM sAmye sTitaM manaH . nirdozaM hi samaM brahma tasmAdbrahmaRi te sTitAH .. 19 ..

tr.en: Even here on earth everything is overcome by those whose mind remains balanced; the Eternal is incorruptible and balanced; therefore they are established in the Eternal .

r: na prahfzyetpriyaM prApya nodvijetprApya cApriyam . sTirabudDirasaMmUQo brahmavidbrahmaRi sTitaH .. 20 ..

tr.en: With Reason firm, unperplexed, the knower of the Eternal established in the Eternal , neither rejoiceth on obtaining what is pleasant, nor sorroweth on obtaining what is unpleasant.

r: bAhyasparSezvasaktAtmA vindatyAtmani yatsuKam . sa brahmayogayuktAtmA suKamakzayamaSnute .. 21 ..

tr.en: ​ He, whose self is unattached to external contacts and findeth joy in the Self , having the self harmonised with the Eternal by yoga, enjoys imperishable bliss.

r: ye hi saMsparSajA BogA duHKayonaya eva te . AdyantavantaH kOnteya na tezu ramate buDaH .. 22 ..

tr.en: The delights that are contact-born, they are verily wombs of pain, for they have beginning and ending, O Kaunteya; not in them may rejoice the wise.

r: SaknotIhEva yaH soQuM prAk SarIravimokzaRAt . kAmakroDodBavaM vegaM sa yuktaH sa suKI naraH .. 23 ..

tr.en: He who is able to endure here on earth, ere he be liberated from the body, the force born from desire and passion, he is harmonised, he is a happy man.

r: yo'ntaHsuKo'ntarArAmastaTAntarjyotireva yaH . sa yogI brahmanirvARaM brahmaBUto'DigacCati .. 24 ..

tr.en: ​ He who is happy within, who rejoiceth within, who is illuminated within, that Yogî, becoming the Eternal , goeth to the Peace of the Eternal .

r: laBante brahmanirvARamfzayaH kzIRakalmazAH . CinnadvEDA yatAtmAnaH sarvaBUtahite ratAH .. 25 ..

tr.en: Rishis, their sins destroyed, their duality removed, their selves controlled, intent upon the welfare of all beings, obtain the Peace of the Eternal .

r: kAmakroDaviyuktAnAM yatInAM yatacetasAm . aBito brahmanirvARaM vartate viditAtmanAm .. 26 ..

tr.en: The Peace of the Eternal lies near to those who know themselves, who are disjoined from desire and passion, subdued in nature, of subdued thoughts.

r: sparSAnkftvA bahirbAhyAMScakzuScEvAntare BruvoH . prARApAnO samO kftvA nAsAByantaracAriRO .. 27 ..

tr.en: Having external contacts excluded, and with gaze fixed between the eyebrows; having made equal the outgoing and ingoing breaths moving within the nostrils;

r: yatendriyamanobudDirmunirmokzaparAyaRaH . vigatecCABayakroDo yaH sadA mukta eva saH .. 28 ..

tr.en: With senses, mind, and Reason ever controlled, solely pursuing liberation, the Sage, having for ever cast away desire, fear and passion, verily is liberated.

r: BoktAraM yajYatapasAM sarvalokamaheSvaram . suhfdaM sarvaBUtAnAM jYAtvA mAM SAntimfcCati .. 29 ..

tr.en: Having known Me, as the Enjoyer of sacrifice and of austerity, the mighty Ruler of all the ​ worlds, and the Lover of all beings, he goeth to Peace.

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . anASritaH karmaPalaM kAryaM karma karoti yaH . sa saMnyAsI ca yogI ca na niragnirna cAkriyaH .. 1 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: He that performeth such action as his duty, independently of the fruit of action, he is an ascetic, he is a Yogî, not he that is without fire, and without rites.

r: yaM saMnyAsamiti prAhuryogaM taM vidDi pARqava . na hyasaMnyastasaNkalpo yogI Bavati kaScana .. 2 ..

tr.en: That which is called renunciation, know thou that as yoga, O Pândava; nor doth any one become a Yogî with the formative will unrenounced.

r: ArurukzormuneryogaM karma kAraRamucyate . yogArUQasya tasyEva SamaH kAraRamucyate .. 3 ..

tr.en: For a Sage who is seeking Yoga, action is called the means; for the same Sage, when he is enthroned in yoga, serenity is called the means.

r: yadA hi nendriyArTezu na karmasvanuzajjate . sarvasaNkalpasaMnyAsI yogArUQastadocyate .. 4 ..

tr.en: When a man feeleth no attachment either for the objects of sense or for actions, renouncing the formative will, then, he is said to be enthroned in yoga.

r: udDaredAtmanA''tmAnaM nAtmAnamavasAdayet . AtmEva hyAtmano banDurAtmEva ripurAtmanaH .. 5 ..

tr.en: Let him raise the self by the Self and not let the self become depressed; for verily is the Self the friend of the self, and also the Self the self's enemy;

r: banDurAtmA''tmanastasya yenAtmEvAtmanA jitaH . anAtmanastu Satrutve vartetAtmEva Satruvat .. 6 ..

tr.en: The Self is the friend of the self of him in whom the self by the Self is vanquished; but to the unsubdued self the Self verily becometh hostile as an enemy.

r: jitAtmanaH praSAntasya paramAtmA samAhitaH . SItozRasuKaduHKezu taTA mAnApamAnayoH .. 7 ..

tr.en: The higher Self of him who is Self -controlled and peaceful is uniform in cold and heat, pleasure and pain, as well as in honour and dishonour.

r: jYAnavijYAnatfptAtmA kUwasTo vijitendriyaH . yukta ityucyate yogI samalozwASmakAYcanaH .. 8 ..

tr.en: The Yogî who is satisfied with wisdom and knowledge, unwavering, whose senses are sub ​ dued, to whom a lump of earth, a stone and gold are the same, is said to be harmonised.

r: suhfnmitrAryudAsInamaDyasTadvezyabanDuzu . sADuzvapi ca pApezu samabudDirviSizyate .. 9 ..

tr.en: He who regards impartially lovers, friends, and foes, strangers, neutrals, foreigners and relatives, also the righteous and unrighteous, he excelleth.

r: yogI yuYjIta satatamAtmAnaM rahasi sTitaH . ekAkI yatacittAtmA nirASIraparigrahaH .. 10 ..

tr.en: Let the Yogî constantly engage himself in yoga, remaining in a secret place by himself, with thought and self subdued, free from hope and greed.

r: SucO deSe pratizWApya sTiramAsanamAtmanaH . nAtyucCritaM nAtinIcaM celAjinakuSottaram .. 11 ..

tr.en: In a pure place, established on a fixed seat of his own, neither very much raised nor very low, ​ made of a cloth, a black antelope skin, and kusha grass, one over the other;

r: tatrEkAgraM manaH kftvA yatacittendriyakriyaH . upaviSyAsane yuYjyAdyogamAtmaviSudDaye .. 12 ..

tr.en: There, having made the mind one-pointed, with thought and the functions of the senses subdued, steady on his seat, he should practise yoga for the purification of the self.

r: samaM kAyaSirogrIvaM DArayannacalaM sTiraH . saMprekzya nAsikAgraM svaM diSaScAnavalokayan .. 13 ..

tr.en: Holding the body, head and neck erect, immovably steady, looking fixedly at the point of the nose, with unseeing gaze,

r: praSAntAtmA vigataBIrbrahmacArivrate sTitaH . manaH saMyamya maccitto yukta AsIta matparaH .. 14 ..

tr.en: The self serene, fearless, firm in the vow of the ​ Brahmachâri, the mind controlled, thinking on Me, harmonised, let him sit aspiring after Me.

r: yuYjannevaM sadA''tmAnaM yogI niyatamAnasaH . SAntiM nirvARaparamAM matsaMsTAmaDigacCati .. 15 ..

tr.en: The Yogî ever united thus with the Self , with the mind controlled, goeth to Peace, to the supreme Bliss that abideth in Me.

r: nAtyaSnatastu yogo'sti na cEkAntamanaSnataH . na cAtisvapnaSIlasya jAgrato nEva cArjuna .. 16 ..

tr.en: Verily yoga is not for him who eateth too much, nor who abstaineth to excess, nor who is too much addicted to sleep, nor even to wakefulness, O Arjuna.

r: yuktAhAravihArasya yuktacezwasya karmasu . yuktasvapnAvaboDasya yogo Bavati duHKahA .. 17 ..

tr.en: ​ Yoga killeth out all pain for him who is regulated in eating and amusement, regulated in performing actions, regulated in sleeping and waking.

r: yadA viniyataM cittamAtmanyevAvatizWate . niHspfhaH sarvakAmeByo yukta ityucyate tadA .. 18 ..

tr.en: When his subdued thought is fixed on the Self , free from longing after all desirable things, then it is said, "he is harmonised."

r: yaTA dIpo nivAtasTo neNgate sopamA smftA . yogino yatacittasya yuYjato yogamAtmanaH .. 19 ..

tr.en: As a lamp in a windless place flickereth not, to such is likened the Yogî of subdued thought, absorbed in the yoga of the Self .

r: yatroparamate cittaM nirudDaM yogasevayA . yatra cEvAtmanA''tmAnaM paSyannAtmani tuzyati .. 20 ..

tr.en: That in which the mind finds rest, quieted by the practice of yoga: that in which he, seeing the Self by the Self , in the Self is satisfied;

r: suKamAtyantikaM yattad budDigrAhyamatIndriyam . vetti yatra na cEvA'yaM sTitaScalati tattvataH .. 21 ..

tr.en: That in which he findeth the supreme delight which the Reason can grasp beyond the senses, wherein established he moveth not from the Reality;

r: yaM labDvA cAparaM lABaM manyate nADikaM tataH . yasminsTito na duHKena guruRA'pi vicAlyate .. 22 ..

tr.en: Which, having obtained, he thinketh there is no greater gain beyond it; wherein, established, he is not shaken even by heavy sorrow;

r: taM vidyAd‌ duHKasaMyogaviyogaM yogasaMjYitam . sa niScayena yoktavyo yogo'nirviRRacetasA .. 23 ..
saNkalpapraBAvAnkAmAMstyaktvA sarvAnaSezataH . manasEvendriyagrAmaM viniyamya samantataH .. 24 ..

tr.en: Abandoning without reserve all desires born of the imagination, by the mind curbing in the aggregate of the senses on every side,

r: SanEHSanEruparamed‌ budDyA DftigfhItayA . AtmasaMsTaM manaH kftvA na kiYcidapi cintayet .. 25 ..

tr.en: Little by little let him gain tranquillity, by means of Reason controlled by steadiness; having made the mind abide in the Self , let him not think of anything.

r: yato yato niScarati manaScaYcalamasTiram . tatastato niyamyEtadAtmanyeva vaSaM nayet .. 26 ..

tr.en: As often as the wavering and unsteady mind goeth forth, so often reining it in, let him bring it under the control of the Self .

r: praSAntamanasaM hyenaM yoginaM suKamuttamam . upEti SAntarajasaM brahmaBUtamakalmazam .. 27 ..

tr.en: Supreme joy is for this Yogi whose mind is ​ peaceful, whose passion-nature is calmed, who is sinless and of the nature of the Eternal .

r: yuYjannevaM sadA''tmAnaM yogI vigatakalmazaH . suKena brahmasaMsparSamatyantaM suKamaSnute .. 28 ..

tr.en: The Yogî who thus, ever harmonising the self, hath put away sin, he easily enjoyeth the infinite bliss of contact with the Eternal .

r: sarvaBUtasTamAtmAnaM sarvaBUtAni cAtmani . Ikzate yogayuktAtmA sarvatra samadarSanaH .. 29 ..

tr.en: The self, harmonised by yoga, seeth the Self abiding in all beings, all beings in the Self ; everywhere he seeth the same.

r: yo mAM paSyati sarvatra sarvaM ca mayi paSyati . tasyAhaM na praRaSyAmi sa ca me na praRaSyati .. 30 ..

tr.en: He who seeth Me everywhere, and seeth everything in Me, of him will I never lose hold, and he shall never lose hold of Me.

r: sarvaBUtasTitaM yo mAM BajatyekatvamAsTitaH . sarvaTA varttamAno'pi sa yogI mayi vartate .. 31 ..

tr.en: He who, established in unity, worshippeth Me abiding in all beings, that Yogi liveth in Me, whatever his mode of living.

r: AtmOpamyena sarvatra samaM paSyati yo'rjuna . suKaM vA yadi vA duHKaM sa yogI paramo mataH .. 32 ..

tr.en: He who, through the likeness of the Self , O Arjuna, seeth equality in everything, whether pleasant or painful, he is considered a perfect Yogî.

r: arjuna uvAca . yo'yaM yogastvayA proktaH sAmyena maDusUdana . etasyAhaM na paSyAmi caYcalatvAtsTitiM sTirAm .. 33 ..

tr.en: This yoga which Thou hast declared to be by equanimity, O Madhusûdana, I see not a stable foundation for it, owing to restlessness;

r: caYcalaM hi manaH kfzRa pramATi balavad‌ dfQam . tasyA'haM nigrahaM manye vAyoriva suduzkaram .. 34 ..

tr.en: For the mind is verily restless, O Krishna; it is impetuous, strong and difficult to bend. I deem it as hard to curb as the wind.

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . asaMSayaM mahAbAho mano durnigrahaM calam . aByAsena tu kOnteya vErAgyeRa ca gfhyate .. 35 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: Without doubt, O mighty-armed, the mind is hard to curb and restless; but it may be curbed by constant practice and by dispassion.

r: asaMyatAtmanA yogo duzprApa iti me matiH . vaSyAtmanA tu yatatA Sakyo'vAptumupAyataH .. 36 ..

tr.en: Yoga is hard to attain, methinks, by a self that is uncontrolled; but by the Self -controlled it is attainable by properly directed energy.

r: arjuna uvAca . ayatiH SradDayopeto yogAccalitamAnasaH . aprApya yogasaMsidDiM kAM gatiM kfzRa gacCati .. 37 ..

tr.en: Arjuna said: He who is unsubdued but who possesseth faith, with the mind wandering away from yoga, failing to attain perfection in yoga, what path doth he tread, O Krishna?

r: kaccinnoBayaviBrazwaSCinnABramiva naSyati . apratizWo mahAbAho vimUQo brahmaRaH paTi .. 38 ..

tr.en: Fallen from both, is he destroyed like a rent cloud, unsteadfast, O mighty-armed, deluded in the path of the Eternal ?

r: etaM me saMSayaM kfzRa CettumarhasyaSezataH . tvadanyaH saMSayasyAsya CettA nahyupapadyate .. 39 ..

tr.en: Deign, O Krishna, to completely dispel this ​ doubt of mine; for there is none to be found save Thyself able to destroy this doubt.

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . pArTa nEveha nAmutra vinASastasya vidyate . na hi kalyARakftkaScid‌durgatiM tAta gacCati .. 40 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: O son of Prithâ, neither in this world nor in the life to come is there destruction for him; never doth any who worketh righteousness, O beloved, tread the path of woe.

r: prApya puRyakftAM lokAnuzitvA SASvatIH samAH . SucInAM SrImatAM gehe yogaBrazwo'BijAyate .. 41 ..

tr.en: Having attained to the worlds of the pure-doing, and having dwelt there for immemorial years, he who fell from yoga is reborn in a pure and blessed house;

r: aTavA yoginAmeva kule Bavati DImatAm . etadDi durlaBataraM loke janma yadIdfSam .. 42 ..

tr.en: ​ Or he may even be born into a family of wise Yogîs; but such a birth as that is most difficult to obtain in this world.

r: tatra taM budDisaMyogaM laBate pOrvadehikam . yatate ca tato BUyaH saMsidDO kurunandana .. 43 ..

tr.en: There he recovereth the characteristics belonging to this former body, and with these he again laboureth for perfection, O joy of the Kurus.

r: pUrvAByAsena tenEva hriyate hyavaSo'pi saH . jijYAsurapi yogasya SabdabrahmAtivartate .. 44 ..

tr.en: By that former practice he is irresistibly swept away. Only wishing to know yoga, even the seeker after yoga goeth beyond the Brâhmic world;

r: prayatnAdyatamAnastu yogI saMSudDakilbizaH . anekajanmasaMsidDastato yAti parAM gatim .. 45 ..

tr.en: But the Yogî, labouring with assiduity, purified ​ from sin, fully perfected through manifold births, he reacheth the supreme goal.

r: tapasviByo'Diko yogI jYAniByo'pi mato'DikaH . karmiByaScADiko yogI tasmAdyogI BavArjuna .. 46 ..

tr.en: The Yogî is greater than the ascetics; he is thought to be greater than even the wise; the Yogî is greater than the men of action; therefore become thou a Yogî, O Arjuna!

r: yoginAmapi sarvezAM madgatenAntarAtmanA . SradDAvAnBajate yo mAM sa me yuktatamo mataH .. 47 ..

tr.en: And among all Yogîs, he who, full of faith, with the inner Self abiding in Me, adoreth Me, he is considered by Me to be the most completely harmonised.

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . mayyAsaktamanAH pArTa yogaM yuYjanmadASrayaH . asaMSayaM samagraM mAM yaTA jYAsyasi tacCfRu .. 1 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: With the mind clinging to me, O Pârtha, performing yoga, refuged in Me, how thou shalt without doubt know Me to the uttermost, that hear thou.

r: jYAnaM te'haM savijYAnamidaM vakzyAmyaSezataH . yajjYAtvA neha BUyo'nyajjYAtavyamavaSizyate .. 2 ..

tr.en: I will declare to thee this knowledge and wisdom in its completeness, which, having known, there is nothing more here needeth to be known.

r: manuzyARAM sahasrezu kaScidyatati sidDaye . yatatAmapi sidDAnAM kaScinmAM vetti tattvataH .. 3 ..

tr.en: ​ Among thousands of men scarce one striveth for perfection; of the successful strivers scarce one knoweth Me in essence.

r: BUmirApo'nalo vAyuH KaM mano budDireva ca . ahaNkAra itIyaM me BinnA prakftirazwaDA .. 4 ..

tr.en: Earth, water, fire, air, ether, Mind, and Reason also and Egoism —these are the eightfold division of My nature.

r: apareyamitastvanyAM prakftiM vidDi me parAm . jIvaBUtAM mahAbAho yayedaM DAryate jagat .. 5 ..

tr.en: This the inferior. Know My other nature, the higher, the life-element, O mighty-armed, by which the universe is upheld.

r: etadyonIni BUtAni sarvARItyupaDAraya . ahaM kftsnasya jagataH praBavaH pralayastaTA .. 6 ..

tr.en: ​ Know this to be the womb of all beings. I am the source of the forthgoing of the whole universe and likewise the place of its dissolving.

r: mattaH parataraM nAnyatkiYcidasti DanaYjaya . mayi sarvamidaM protaM sUtre maRigaRA iva .. 7 ..

tr.en: There is naught whatsoever higher than I, O Dhananjaya. All this is threaded on Me, as rows of pearls on a string.

r: raso'hamapsu kOnteya praBA'smi SaSisUryayoH . praRavaH sarvavedezu SabdaH Ke pOruzaM nfzu .. 8 ..

tr.en: I the sapidity in waters, O son of Kuntî, I the radiance in moon and sun; the Word of Power in all the Vedas, sound in ether, and virility in men;

r: puRyo ganDaH pfTivyAM ca tejaScAsmi viBAvasO . jIvanaM sarvaBUtezu tapaScAsmi tapasvizu .. 9 ..

tr.en: The pure fragrance of earths and the bril ​ liance in fire am I; the life in all beings am I, and the austerity in ascetics.

r: bIjaM mAM sarvaBUtAnAM vidDi pArTa sanAtanam . budDirbudDimatAmasmi tejastejasvinAmaham .. 10 ..

tr.en: Know Me, O Pârtha! as the eternal seed of all beings. I am the Reason of the Reason -endowed, the splendour of splendid things am I.

r: balaM balavatAmasmi kAmarAgavivarjitam . DarmAvirudDo BUtezu kAmo'smi BaratarzaBa .. 11 ..

tr.en: And I the strength of the strong, devoid of desire and passion. In beings I am desire not contrary to duty, O Lord of the Bharatas.

r: ye cEva sAttvikA BAvA rAjasAstAmasASca ye . matta eveti tAnvidDi na tvahaM tezu te mayi .. 12 ..

tr.en: The natures that are harmonious, active, slothful, these know as from Me; not I in them, but they in me.

r: triBirguRamayErBAvEreBiH sarvamidaM jagat . mohitaM nABijAnAti mAmeByaH paramavyayam .. 13 ..

tr.en: All this world, deluded by these natures made by the three qualities, knoweth not Me, above these, imperishable.

r: dEvI hyezA guRamayI mama mAyA duratyayA . mAmeva ye prapadyante mAyAmetAM taranti te .. 14 ..

tr.en: This divine illusion of Mine, caused by the qualities, is hard to pierce; they who come to Me, they cross over this illusion.

r: na mAM duzkftino mUQAH prapadyante narADamAH . mAyayA'pahftajYAnA AsuraM BAvamASritAH .. 15..

tr.en: The evil-doing, the deluded, the vilest men, they come not to Me, they whose wisdom is destroyed by illusion, who have embraced the nature of demons.

r: caturviDA Bajante mAM janAH sukftino'rjuna . Arto jijYAsurarTArTI jYAnI ca BaratarzaBa .. 16 ..

tr.en: Fourfold in division are the righteous ones who worship me, O Arjuna; the suffering, the seeker for knowledge, the self-interested and the wise, O Lord of the Bhâratas.

r: tezAM jYAnI nityayukta ekaBaktirviSizyate . priyo hi jYAnino'tyarTamahaM sa ca mama priyaH .. 17 ..

tr.en: Of these the wise, constantly harmonised, worshipping the One, is the best; I am supremely dear to the wise, and he is dear to Me.

r: udArAH sarva evEte jYAnI tvAtmEva me matam . AsTitaH sa hi yuktAtmA mAmevAnuttamAM gatim .. 18 ..

tr.en: Noble are all these, but I hold the wise as verily Myself; he, Self united, is fixed on Me, the highest Path.
