r: bahUnAM janmanAmante jYAnavAnmAM prapadyate . vAsudevaH sarvamiti sa mahAtmA sudurlaBaH .. 19 ..

tr.en: At the close of many births the man full of wisdom cometh unto Me; "Vâsudeva is all." saith he, the Mahâtmâ, very difficult to find.

r: kAmEstEstErhftajYAnAH prapadyante'nyadevatAH . taM taM niyamamAsTAya prakftyA niyatAH svayA .. 20 ..

tr.en: They whose wisdom hath been rent away by desires go forth to other Shining Ones, resorting to various external observances, according to their own natures.

r: yo yo yAM yAM tanuM BaktaH SradDayA'rcitumicCati . tasya tasyAcalAM SradDAM tAmeva vidaDAmyaham .. 21 ..

tr.en: Any devotee who seeketh to worship with faith any such aspect, I verily bestow the unswerving faith of that man.

r: sa tayA SradDayA yuktastasyArADanamIhate . laBate ca tataH kAmAnmayEva vihitAnhi tAn .. 22 ..

tr.en: ​ He endowed with that faith, seeketh the worship of such a one, and from him he obtaineth his desires, I verily decreeing the benefits;

r: antavattu PalaM tezAM tadBavatyalpameDasAm . devAndevayajo yAnti madBaktA yAnti mAmapi .. 23 ..

tr.en: Finite indeed the fruit that belongeth to those who are of small intelligence. To the Shining Ones go the worshippers of the Shining Ones, but my devotees come unto Me.

r: avyaktaM vyaktimApannaM manyante mAmabudDayaH . paraM BAvamajAnanto mamAvyayamanuttamam .. 24 ..

tr.en: Those devoid of Reason think of Me, the unmanifest, as having manifestation, knowing not My supreme nature, imperishable, most excellent.

r: nAhaM prakASaH sarvasya yogamAyAsamAvftaH . mUQo'yaM nABijAnAti loko mAmajamavyayam .. 25 ..

tr.en: ​ Nor am I of all discovered, enveloped in My creation-illusion. This deluded world knoweth Me not, the unborn, the imperishable.

r: vedAhaM samatItAni vartamAnAni cArjuna . BavizyARi ca BUtAni mAM tu veda na kaScana .. 26 ..

tr.en: I know the beings that are past, that are present, that are to come, O Arjuna, but no one knoweth Me.

r: icCAdvezasamutTena dvandvamohena BArata . sarvaBUtAni sammohaM sarge yAnti parantapa .. 27 ..

tr.en: By the delusion of the pairs of opposites, sprung from attraction and repulsion, O Bhârata, all beings walk this universe wholly deluded, O Parantapa.

r: yezAM tvantagataM pApaM janAnAM puRyakarmaRAm . te dvandvamohanirmuktA Bajante mAM dfQavratAH .. 28 ..

tr.en: ​ But those men of pure deeds, in whom sin is come to an end, they, freed from the delusive pairs of opposites, worship Me, steadfast in vows.

r: jarAmaraRamokzAya mAmASritya yatanti ye . te brahma tadviduH kftsnamaDyAtmaM karma cAKilam .. 29 ..

tr.en: They who, refuged in Me, strive for liberation from birth and death, they know the Eternal , the whole Self -knowledge, and all action.

r: sADiBUtADidEvaM mAM sADiyajYaM ca ye viduH . prayARakAle'pi ca mAM te viduryuktacetasaH .. 30 ..

tr.en: They who know Me as the knowledge of the elements, as that of the Shining Ones, and as that of the Sacrifice, they harmonised in mind, know Me verily even in the time of forthgoing.

r: arjuna uvAca . kiM tadbrahma kimaDyAtmaM kiM karma puruzottama . aDiBUtaM ca kiM proktamaDidEvaM kimucyate .. 1 ..

tr.en: Arjuna said: What is that Eternal , what Self -knowledge, what Action, O Purushottama? And what is declared to be the knowledge of the Elements, what is called the knowledge of the Shining Ones?

r: aDiyajYaH kaTaM ko'tra dehe'sminmaDusUdana . prayARakAle ca kaTaM jYeyo'si niyatAtmaBiH .. 2 ..

tr.en: What is the knowledge of Sacrifice in this body, and how, O, Madhusûdana? And how, at the time of forthgoing art Thou known by the Self -controlled?

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . akzaraM brahma paramaM svaBAvo'DyAtmamucyate . BUtaBAvodBavakaro visargaH karmasaMjYitaH .. 3 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: The indestructible, the supreme is the Eternal ; His essential nature is called Self -knowledge; the emanation that causes the birth of beings is named Action;

r: aDiBUtaM kzaro BAvaH puruzaScADidEvatam . aDiyajYo'hamevAtra dehe dehaBftAM vara .. 4 ..

tr.en: Knowledge of the Elements concerns My perishable nature, and knowledge of the Shining Ones concerns the life-giving energy ; the knowledge of Sacrifice tells of Me, as wearing the body, O best of living beings.

r: antakAle ca mAmeva smaranmuktvA kalevaram . yaH prayAti sa madBAvaM yAti nAstyatra saMSayaH .. 5 ..

tr.en: And he who, casting off the body, goeth forth thinking upon Me only at the time of the end, he entereth into My being: there is no doubt of that.

r: yaM yaM vApi smaranBAvaM tyajatyante kalevaram . taM tamevEti kOnteya sadA tadBAvaBAvitaH .. 6 ..

tr.en: Whosoever at the end abandoneth the body, thinking upon any being, to that being only he goeth, O Kaunteya, ever to that conformed in nature.

r: tasmAtsarvezu kAlezu mAmanusmara yuDya ca . mayyarpitamanobudDirmAmevEzyasyasaMSayam .. 7 ..

tr.en: Therefore at all times think upon Me only and fight. With mind and Reason set on Me, without doubt thou shalt come to Me.

r: aByAsayogayuktena cetasA nAnyagAminA . paramaM puruzaM divyaM yAti pArTAnucintayan .. 8 ..

tr.en: With the mind not wandering after aught else, harmonised by continual practice, constantly meditating, O Pârtha, one goeth to the Spirit supreme, divine.

r: kaviM purARamanuSAsitAramaRoraRIyAMsamanusmaredyaH . sarvasya DAtAramacintyarUpamAdityavarRaM tamasaH parastAt .. 9 ..

tr.en: He who thinketh upon the Ancient, the Omniscient, the All-Ruler, minuter than the minute, the supporter of all, of form unimaginable, refulgent as the sun beyond the darkness,

r: prayARakAle manasA'calena BaktyA yukto yogabalena cEva . BruvormaDye prARamAveSya samyak sa taM paraM puruzamupEti divyam .. 10 ..

tr.en: In the time of forthgoing, with unshaken mind, fixed in devotion, by the power of yoga drawing together his life-breath in the centre of the two eyebrows, he goeth to this Spirit, supreme, divine.

r: yadakzaraM vedavido vadanti viSanti yadyatayo vItarAgAH . yadicCanto brahmacaryaM caranti tatte padaM saNgraheRa pravakzye .. 11 ..

tr.en: That which is declared indestructible by the Veda-knowers, that which the controlled and passion-free enter, that desiring which Brahmacharya is performed, that path I will declare to thee with brevity.

r: sarvadvArARi saMyamya mano hfdi niruDya ca . mUrDnyADAyAtmanaH prARamAsTito yogaDAraRAm .. 12 ..

tr.en: All the gates closed, the mind confined in the heart, the life-breath fixed in his own head, concentrated by yoga,

r: omityekAkzaraM brahma vyAharanmAmanusmaran . yaH prayAti tyajandehaM sa yAti paramAM gatim .. 13 ..

tr.en: "Aum!" the one syllabled Eternal , reciting, thinking upon Me, he who goeth forth, abandoning the body, he goeth on the highest path.

r: ananyacetAH satataM yo mAM smarati nityaSaH . tasyAhaM sulaBaH pArTa nityayuktasya yoginaH .. 14 ..

tr.en: He who constantly thinketh upon Me, not thinking ever of another, of him I am easily reached, O Pârtha, of this ever-harmonised Yogî.

r: mAmupetya punarjanma duHKAlayamaSASvatam . nApnuvanti mahAtmAnaH saMsidDiM paramAM gatAH .. 15 ..

tr.en: Having come to Me, these Mahâtmâs come not again to birth, the place of pain, non-eternal; they have gone to the highest bliss.

r: AbrahmaBuvanAllokAH punarAvartino'rjuna . mAmupetya tu kOnteya punarjanma na vidyate .. 16 ..

tr.en: The worlds, beginning with the world of Brahmâ, they come and go, O Arjuna; but he who cometh unto Me, O Kaunteya, he knoweth birth no more.

r: sahasrayugaparyantamaharyadbrahmaRo viduH . rAtriM yugasahasrAntAM te'horAtravido janAH .. 17 ..

tr.en: The people who know the day of Brahmâ, a thousand ages in duration, and the night a thousand ages in ending, they know day and night.

r: avyaktAdvyaktayaH sarvAH praBavantyaharAgame . rAtryAgame pralIyante tatrEvAvyaktasaMjYake .. 18 ..

tr.en: From the unmanifested all the manifested stream forth at the coming of day; at the coming of night they dissolve, even in That called the unmanifested.

r: BUtagrAmaH sa evAyaM BUtvA BUtvA pralIyate . rAtryAgame'vaSaH pArTa praBavatyaharAgame .. 19 ..

tr.en: This multitude of beings, going forth repeatedly, is dissolved at the coming of night: by ordination, O Pârtha, it streams forth at the coming of day.

r: parastasmAttu BAvo'nyo'vyakto'vyaktAtsanAtanaH . yaH sa sarvezu BUtezu naSyatsu na vinaSyati .. 20 ..
avyakto'kzara ityuktastamAhuH paramAM gatim . yaM prApya na nivartante tadDAma paramaM mama .. 21 ..

tr.en: That unmanifested, "the Indestructible," It is called; It is named the highest Path. They who reach It return not. That is My supreme abode.

r: puruzaH sa paraH pArTa BaktyA laByastvananyayA . yasyAntaHsTAni BUtAni yena sarvamidaM tatam .. 22 ..

tr.en: He, the highest Spirit, O Pârtha, may be reached by unswerving devotion to Him alone, in whom all beings abide, by whom all This is pervaded.

r: yatra kAle tvanAvfttimAvfttiM cEva yoginaH . prayAtA yAnti taM kAlaM vakzyAmi BaratarzaBa .. 23 ..

tr.en: That time wherein going forth Yogîs return ​ not, and also that wherein going forth they return, that time shall I declare to thee, O prince of the Bhâratas.

r: agnirjyotirahaH SuklaH zaRmAsA uttarAyaRam . tatra prayAtA gacCanti brahma brahmavido janAH .. 24 ..

tr.en: Fire, light, day-time, the bright fortnight, the six months of the northern path —then, going forth, the men who know the Eternal go to the Eternal .

r: DUmo rAtristaTA kfzRaH zaRmAsA dakziRAyanam . tatra cAndramasaM jyotiryogI prApya nivartate .. 25 ..

tr.en: Smoke, night-time, the dark fortnight also, the six months of the southern path —then the Yogî, obtaining the moonlight, returneth.

r: SuklakfzRe gatI hyete jagataH SASvate mate . ekayA yAtyanAvfttimanyayA''vartate punaH .. 26 ..

tr.en: ​ Light and darkness, these are thought to be the world's everlasting paths; by the one he goeth who returneth not, by the other he who returneth again.

r: nEte sftI pArTa jAnanyogI muhyati kaScana . tasmAtsarvezu kAlezu yogayukto BavArjuna .. 27 ..

tr.en: Knowing these paths, O Pârtha, the Yogi is nowise perplexed. Therefore in all times be firm in yoga, O Arjuna.

r: vedezu yajYezu tapaHsu cEva dAnezu yatpuRyaPalaM pradizwam . atyeti tatsarvamidaM viditvA yogI paraM sTAnamupEti cAdyam .. 28 ..

tr.en: The fruit of meritorious deeds, attached in the Vedas to sacrifices, to austerities, and also to almsgiving, the Yogî passeth all these by having known this, and goeth to the supreme and ancient Seat.

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . idaM tu te guhyatamaM pravakzyAmyanasUyave . jYAnaM vijYAnasahitaM yajjYAtvA mokzyase'SuBAt .. 1 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: To thee, the uncarping, verily shall I declare this profoundest Secret, wisdom with knowledge combined, which, having known, thou shalt be freed from evil.

r: rAjavidyA rAjaguhyaM pavitramidamuttamam . pratyakzAvagamaM DarmyaM susuKaM kartumavyayam .. 2 ..

tr.en: Kingly Science, kingly Secret, supreme Purifier, this; intuitional, according to righteousness, very easy to perform, imperishable.

r: aSraddaDAnAH puruzA DarmasyAsya parantapa . aprApya mAM nivartante mftyusaMsAravartmani .. 3 ..

tr.en: Men without faith in this knowledge, O ​ Parantapa, not reaching Me, return to the paths of this world of death.

r: mayA tatamidaM sarvaM jagadavyaktamUrtinA . matsTAni sarvaBUtAni na cAhaM tezvavasTitaH .. 4 ..

tr.en: By Me all this world is pervaded in My unmanifested aspect; all beings have root in Me, I am not rooted in them.

r: na ca matsTAni BUtAni paSya me yogamESvaram . BUtaBfnna ca BUtasTo mamAtmA BUtaBAvanaH .. 5 ..

tr.en: Nor have beings root in Me; behold My sovereign Yoga! The support of beings, yet not rooted in beings, My Self their efficient cause.

r: yaTA''kASasTito nityaM vAyuH sarvatrago mahAn . taTA sarvARi BUtAni matsTAnItyupaDAraya .. 6 ..

tr.en: As the mighty air everywhere moving is rooted in the Ether, so all beings rest rooted in Me—thus know thou.

r: sarvaBUtAni kOnteya prakftiM yAnti mAmikAm . kalpakzaye punastAni kalpAdO visfjAmyaham .. 7 ..

tr.en: All beings, O Kaunteya, enter my lower nature at the end of a world-age; at the beginning of a world-age again I emanate them.

r: prakftiM svAmavazwaBya visfjAmi punaH punaH . BUtagrAmamimaM kftsnamavaSaM prakftervaSAt .. 8 ..

tr.en: Hidden in Nature, which is mine own, I emanate again and again all this multitude of beings, helpless, by the force of Nature .

r: na ca mAM tAni karmARi nibaDnanti DanaYjaya . udAsInavadAsInamasaktaM tezu karmasu .. 9 ..

tr.en: Nor do these works bind me, O Dhananjaya, enthroned on high unattached to actions.

r: mayA'DyakzeRa prakftiH sUyate sacarAcaram . hetunA'nena kOnteya jagadviparivartate .. 10 ..

tr.en: Under Me as supervisor, Nature sends forth ​ the moving and unmoving: because of this, O Kaunteya, the universe revolves.

r: avajAnanti mAM mUQA mAnuzIM tanumASritam . paraM BAvamajAnanto mama BUtamaheSvaram .. 11 ..

tr.en: The foolish disregard Me, when clad in human semblance, ignorant of My supreme nature, the great Lord of beings;

r: moGASA moGakarmARo moGajYAnA vicetasaH . rAkzasImAsurIM cEva prakftiM mohinIM SritAH .. 12 ..

tr.en: Empty of hope, empty of deeds, empty of wisdom, senseless, partaking of the deceitful, brutal and demoniacal nature.

r: mahAtmAnastu mAM pArTa dEvIM prakftimASritAH . Bajantyananyamanaso jYAtvA BUtAdimavyayam .. 13 ..

tr.en: Verily the Mahâtmâs, O Partha, partaking of My divine nature, worship with unwavering ​ mind, having known Me, the imperishable source of beings.

r: satataM kIrtayanto mAM yatantaSca dfQavratAH . namasyantaSca mAM BaktyA nityayuktA upAsate .. 14 ..
jYAnayajYena cApyanye yajanto mAmupAsate . ekatvena pfTaktvena bahuDA viSvatomuKam .. 15 ..

tr.en: Others also, sacrificing with the sacrifice of wisdom, worship Me as the One and the Manifold everywhere present.

r: ahaM kraturahaM yajYaH svaDA'hamahamOzaDam . mantro'hamahamevAjyamahamagnirahaM hutam .. 16 ..

tr.en: I the ablation; I the sacrifice; I the ancestral offering; I the fire-giving herb; the mantram I; I also the butter; I the fire; the burnt-offering I;

r: pitA'hamasya jagato mAtA DAtA pitAmahaH . vedyaM pavitramoNkAra fk sAma yajureva ca .. 17 ..

tr.en: I the Father of this universe, the Mother, the Supporter, the Grandsire, the Holy one to be known, the Word of Power, and also the Rik, Sâma, and Yajur,

r: gatirBartA praBuH sAkzI nivAsaH SaraRaM suhft . praBavaH pralayaH sTAnaM niDAnaM bIjamavyayam .. 18 ..

tr.en: The Path, Husband, Lord, Witness, Abode, Shelter, Lover, Origin, Dissolution, Foundation, house, Seed imperishable.

r: tapAmyahamahaM varzaM nigfhRAmyutsfjAmi ca . amftaM cEva mftyuSca sadasaccAhamarjuna .. 19 ..

tr.en: I give heat; I hold back and send forth the rain; immortality and also death, being and non-being am I, Arjuna.

r: trEvidyA mAM somapAH pUtapApAH yajYErizwvA svargatiM prArTayante . te puRyamAsAdya surendralokamaSnanti divyAndivi devaBogAn .. 20 ..

tr.en: The knowers of the three, the Soma-drinkers, the purified from sin, worshipping Me with sacrifice, pray of Me the way to heaven; they, ascending to the holy world of the Ruler of the Shining Ones, eat in heaven the divine feasts of the Shining Ones.

r: te taM BuktvA svargalokaM viSAlam kzIRe puRye martyalokaM viSanti . evaM trayIDarmamanuprapannAH gatAgataM kAmakAmA laBante .. 21 ..

tr.en: They, having enjoyed the spacious heaven-world, their holiness withered, come back to ​ this world of death. Following the virtues enjoined by the three, desiring desires, they obtain the transitory.

r: ananyAScintayanto mAM ye janAH paryupAsate . tezAM nityABiyuktAnAM yogakzemaM vahAmyaham .. 22 ..

tr.en: To those men who worship Me alone thinking of no other, to those ever harmonious, I bring full security.

r: ye'pyanyadevatABaktA yajante SradDayA'nvitAH . te'pi mAmeva kOnteya yajantyaviDipUrvakam .. 23 ..

tr.en: Even the devotees of other Shining Ones, who worship full of faith, they also worship Me, O son of Kuntî, though contrary to the ancient rule.

r: ahaM hi sarvayajYAnAM BoktA ca praBureva ca . na tu mAmaBijAnanti tattvenAtaScyavanti te .. 24 ..

tr.en: I am indeed the enjoyer of all sacrifices and ​ also the Lord, but they know Me not in Essence, and hence they fall.

r: yAnti devavratA devAn pitFnyAnti pitfvratAH . BUtAni yAnti BUtejyA yAnti madyAjino'pi mAm .. 25 ..

tr.en: They who worship the Shining Ones go to the Shining Ones; to the Ancestors go the Ancestor-worshippers; to the Elements go those who sacrifice to Elementals; but My worshippers come unto Me.

r: patraM puzpaM PalaM toyaM yo me BaktyA prayacCati . tadahaM BaktyupahftamaSnAmi prayatAtmanaH .. 26 ..

tr.en: He who offereth to Me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit, water, that I accept from the striving self, offered as it is with devotion.

r: yatkarozi yadaSnAsi yajjuhozi dadAsi yat . yattapasyasi kOnteya tatkuruzva madarpaRam .. 27 ..

tr.en: Whatsoever thou doest, whatsoever thou eatest, ​ whatsoever thou offerest, whatsoever thou givest, whatsoever thou doest of austerity, O Kaunteya, do thou that as an offering unto Me.

r: SuBASuBaPalErevaM mokzyase karmabanDanEH . saMnyAsayogayuktAtmA vimukto mAmupEzyasi .. 28 ..

tr.en: Thus shalt thou be liberated from the bonds of action, yielding good and evil fruits; thyself harmonised by the yoga of renunciation, thou shalt come unto Me when set free.

r: samo'haM sarvaBUtezu na me dvezyo'sti na priyaH . ye Bajanti tu mAM BaktyA mayi te tezu cApyaham .. 29 ..

tr.en: The same am I to all beings; there is none hateful to Me nor dear. They verily who worship Me with devotion, they are in Me, and I also in them.

r: api cetsudurAcAro Bajate mAmananyaBAk . sADureva sa mantavyaH samyagvyavasito hi saH .. 30 ..

tr.en: Even if the most sinful worship Me, with un ​ divided heart, he too must be accounted righteous, for he hath rightly resolved;

r: kzipraM Bavati DarmAtmA SaSvacCAntiM nigacCati . kOnteya pratijAnIhi na me BaktaH praRaSyati .. 31 ..

tr.en: Speedily he becometh dutiful and goeth to eternal peace; O Kaunteya, know thou for certain that My devotee perisheth never.

r: mAM hi pArTa vyapASritya ye'pi syuH pApayonayaH . striyo vESyAstaTA SUdrAste'pi yAnti parAM gatim .. 32 ..

tr.en: They who take refuge with Me, O Partha, though of the womb of sin, women, Vaishyas, even Shûdras, they also tread the highest path.

r: kiM punarbrAhmaRAH puRyA BaktA rAjarzayastaTA . anityamasuKaM lokamimaM prApya Bajasva mAm .. 33 ..

tr.en: How much rather then holy Brâhmanas and ​ devoted royal saints; having obtained this transient joyless world, worship thou Me.

r: manmanA Bava madBakto madyAjI mAM namaskuru . mAmevEzyasi yuktvEvamAtmAnaM matparAyaRaH .. 34 ..

tr.en: On Me fix thy mind, be devoted to Me; sacrifice to Me; prostrate thyself before Me; harmonised thus in the Self , thou shalt come unto Me, having Me as thy supreme goal.

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . BUya eva mahAbAho SfRu me paramaM vacaH . yatte'haM prIyamARAya vakzyAmi hitakAmyayA .. 1 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: Again, O mighty-armed, hear thou My supreme word, that, desiring thy welfare, I will declare to thee who art beloved.

r: na me viduH suragaRAH praBavaM na maharzayaH . ahamAdirhi devAnAM maharzIRAM ca sarvaSaH .. 2 ..

tr.en: The multitude of the Shining Ones, or the great Rishis, know not my forthcoming, for I am the beginning of all the Shining Ones and the great Rishis.

r: yo mAmajamanAdiM ca vetti lokamaheSvaram . asammUQaH sa martyezu sarvapApEH pramucyate .. 3 ..

tr.en: He who knoweth Me, unborn, beginningless, the great Lord of the world, he among mortals without delusion, is liberated from all sin.

r: budDirjYAnamasammohaH kzamA satyaM damaH SamaH . suKaM duHKaM Bavo'BAvo BayaM cABayameva ca .. 4 ..

tr.en: Reason, wisdom, non-illusion, forgiveness, truth, self-restraint, calmness, pleasure, pain, existence, non-existence, fear, and also courage

r: ahiMsA samatA tuzwistapo dAnaM yaSo'yaSaH . Bavanti BAvA BUtAnAM matta eva pfTagviDAH .. 5 ..

tr.en: Harmlessness, equanimity, content, austerity, almsgiving, fame and obloquy are the various characteristics of beings issuing from Me.

r: maharzayaH sapta pUrve catvAro manavastaTA . madBAvA mAnasA jAtA yezAM loka imAH prajAH .. 6 ..

tr.en: ​ The seven great Rishis, the ancient Four, and also the Manus, were born of My nature, and mind; of them this race was generated.

r: etAM viBUtiM yogaM ca mama yo vetti tattvataH . so'vikampena yogena yujyate nAtra saMSayaH .. 7 ..

tr.en: He who knows in essence that sovereignty and yoga of Mine, he is harmonised by unfaltering yoga; there is no doubt thereof.

r: ahaM sarvasya praBavo mattaH sarvaM pravartate . iti matvA Bajante mAM buDA BAvasamanvitAH .. 8 ..

tr.en: I am the Generator of all; all evolves from Me; understanding thus, the wise adore Me in rapt emotion.

r: maccittA madgataprARA boDayantaH parasparam . kaTayantaSca mAM nityaM tuzyanti ca ramanti ca .. 9 ..

tr.en: ​ Mindful of Me, their life hidden in Me, illumining each other, ever conversing about Me, they are content and joyful.

r: tezAM satatayuktAnAM BajatAM prItipUrvakam . dadAmi budDiyogaM taM yena mAmupayAnti te .. 10 ..

tr.en: To these, ever harmonious, worshipping in love, I give the yoga of discrimination by which they come unto Me.

r: tezAmevAnukampArTamahamajYAnajaM tamaH . nASayAmyAtmaBAvasTo jYAnadIpena BAsvatA .. 11 ..

tr.en: Out of pure compassion for them, dwelling within their Self , I destroy the ignorance-born darkness by the shining lamp of wisdom.

r: arjuna uvAca . paraM brahma paraM DAma pavitraM paramaM BavAn . puruzaM SASvataM divyamAdidevamajaM viBum .. 12 ..

tr.en: Arjuna said: Thou art the supreme Eternal , the supreme Abode, the supreme Purity, eternal divine man, primeval Deity, unborn, the Lord!

r: AhustvAmfzayaH sarve devarzirnAradastaTA . asito devalo vyAsaH svayaM cEva bravIzi me .. 13 ..

tr.en: All the Rishis have thus acclaimed Thee, as also the divine Rishi, Nârada; so Asita, Devala, and Vyâsa; and now Thou Thyself tellest it me.

r: sarvametadftaM manye yanmAM vadasi keSava . na hi te BagavanvyaktiM vidurdevA na dAnavAH .. 14 ..

tr.en: All this I believe true that Thou sayest to me, O Keshava. Thy manifestation, O Blessed Lord, neither Shining Ones nor Dânavas comprehend.

r: svayamevAtmanA''tmAnaM vetTa tvaM puruzottama . BUtaBAvana BUteSa devadeva jagatpate .. 15 ..

tr.en: Thyself indeed knowest Thyself by Thyself, O Purushottama; Source of beings, Lord of beings, Shining One of Shining Ones, Ruler of the world!

r: vaktumarhasyaSezeRa divyA hyAtmaviBUtayaH . yABirviBUtiBirlokAnimAMstvaM vyApya tizWasi .. 16 ..

tr.en: Deign to tell without reserve of Thine own divine glories, by which glories Thou remainest, pervading these worlds.

r: kaTaM vidyAmahaM yogiMstvAM sadA paricintayan . kezu kezu ca BAvezu cintyo'si BagavanmayA .. 17 ..

tr.en: How may I know thee, O Yogi, by constant meditation? In what, in what aspects art Thou to be thought of by me, O blessed Lord?

r: vistareRAtmano yogaM viBUtiM ca janArdana . BUyaH kaTaya tfptirhi SfRvato nAsti me'mftam .. 18 ..

tr.en: ​ In detail tell me again of Thy yoga and glory, O Janardana; for me there is never satiety in hearing thy life-giving words.

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . hanta te kaTayizyAmi divyA hyAtmaviBUtayaH . prADAnyataH kuruSrezWa nAstyanto vistarasya me .. 19 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: Blessed be thou! I will declare to thee My divine glory by its chief characteristics, O best of the Kurus; there is no end to details of Me.

r: ahamAtmA guqAkeSa sarvaBUtASayasTitaH . ahamAdiSca maDyaM ca BUtAnAmanta eva ca .. 20 ..

tr.en: I, O Gudakesha, am the Self , seated in the heart of all beings; I am the beginning, the middle, and also the end of all beings.

r: AdityAnAmahaM vizRurjyotizAM raviraMSumAn . marIcirmarutAmasmi nakzatrARAmahaM SaSI .. 21 ..

tr.en: Of the Adityas I am Vishnu; of radiances the glorious sun; I am Marîchi of the Maruts; of the asterisms the Moon am I.

r: vedAnAM sAmavedo'smi devAnAmasmi vAsavaH . indriyARAM manaScAsmi BUtAnAmasmi cetanA .. 22 ..

tr.en: Of the Vedas I am the Sâma-Veda; I am Vâsava of the Shining Ones; and of the senses I am the mind ; I am of living beings the intelligence .

r: rudrARAM SaNkaraScAsmi vitteSo yakzarakzasAm . vasUnAM pAvakaScAsmi meruH SiKariRAmaham .. 23 ..

tr.en: And of the Rudras Shañkara am I; Vittesha of the Yakshas and Râkshasas ; and of the Vasus I am Pâvaka; Meru of high mountains am I.

r: puroDasAM ca muKyaM mAM vidDi pArTa bfhaspatim . senAnInAmahaM skandaH sarasAmasmi sAgaraH .. 24 ..

tr.en: And know Me, O Pârtha, of household priests the chief, Brihaspati: of generals I am Skanda; of lakes I am the ocean.

r: maharzIRAM BfgurahaM girAmasmyekamakzaram . yajYAnAM japayajYo'smi sTAvarARAM himAlayaH .. 25 ..

tr.en: Of the great Rishis Bhṛigu; of speech I am the one syllable ; of sacrifices I am the sacrifice of silent repetitions ; of immovable things the Himâlaya.

r: aSvatTaH sarvavfkzARAM devarzIRAM ca nAradaH . ganDarvARAM citraraTaH sidDAnAM kapilo muniH .. 26 ..

tr.en: Asvattha of all tree; and of divine Rishis Nârada; of Gandharvas Chitraratha; of the perfected the Muni Kapila.

r: uccEHSravasamaSvAnAM vidDi mAmamftodBavam . ErAvataM gajendrARAM narARAM ca narADipam .. 27 ..

tr.en: Uchchaishravas of horses know me, nectar-born ; Airâvata of lordly elephants, and of men the Monarch.

r: AyuDAnAmahaM vajraM DenUnAmasmi kAmaDuk . prajanaScAsmi kandarpaH sarpARAmasmi vAsukiH .. 28 ..

tr.en: Of weapons I am the thunderbolt; of cows I am Kâmadhuk; I am Kandarpa of the progenitors; of serpents Vâsuki am I.

r: anantaScAsmi nAgAnAM varuRo yAdasAmaham . pitFRAmaryamA cAsmi yamaH saMyamatAmaham .. 29 ..

tr.en: And I am Ananta of Nâgas , Varuna of sea-dwellers I; and of ancestors Aryaman; Yama of governors am I.

r: prahlAdaScAsmi dEtyAnAM kAlaH kalayatAmaham . mfgARAM ca mfgendro'haM vEnateyaSca pakziRAm .. 30 ..

tr.en: And I am Prahlâda of Daityas; of calculators Time am I; and of wild beasts I the imperial beast; and Vainateya of birds.

r: pavanaH pavatAmasmi rAmaH SastraBftAmaham . JazARAM makaraScAsmi srotasAmasmi jAhnavI .. 31 ..
sargARAmAdirantaSca maDyaM cEvAhamarjuna . aDyAtmavidyA vidyAnAM vAdaH pravadatAmaham .. 32 ..

tr.en: Of creations the beginning and the ending, and also the middle am I, O Arjuna. Of sciences the science concerning the Self ; the speech of orators I.

r: akzarARAmakAro'smi dvandvaH sAmAsikasya ca . ahamevAkzayaH kAlo DAtA'haM viSvatomuKaH .. 33 ..

tr.en: Of letters the letter A I am, and the duality of a compound ; I also everlasting Time; I the Supporter, whose face turns everywhere.

r: mftyuH sarvaharaScAhamudBavaSca BavizyatAm . kIrtiH SrIrvAkca nArIRAM smftirmeDA DftiH kzamA .. 34 ..

tr.en: And all-devouring Death am I, and the origin of all to come; and of feminine qualities, fame, prosperity, speech, memory, intelligence, constancy, forgiveness.

r: bfhatsAma taTA sAmnAM gAyatrI CandasAmaham . mAsAnAM mArgaSIrzo'hamftUnAM kusumAkaraH .. 35 ..

tr.en: Of hymns also Brihatsâman; Gâyatrî of metres am I; of months I am Mârgasîrsha; of seasons the flowery.

r: dyUtaM CalayatAmasmi tejastejasvinAmaham . jayo'smi vyavasAyo'smi sattvaM sattvavatAmaham .. 36 ..

tr.en: I am the gambling of the cheat, and the splendour of splendid things I; I am victory, I am determination, and the truth of the truthful I.

r: vfzRInAM vAsudevo'smi pARqavAnAM DanaYjayaH . munInAmapyahaM vyAsaH kavInAmuSanA kaviH .. 37 ..

tr.en: Of the Vṛishnis Vâsudeva am I; of the Pândavas Dhananjaya; of the Sages also I am Vyâsa; of poets Ushanâ the Bard.

r: daRqo damayatAmasmi nItirasmi jigIzatAm . mOnaM cEvAsmi guhyAnAM jYAnaM jYAnavatAmaham .. 38 ..

tr.en: Of rulers I am the sceptre; of those that seek victory I am statesmanship; and of secrets I am also silence; the knowledge of knowers am I.

r: yaccApi sarvaBUtAnAM bIjaM tadahamarjuna . na tadasti vinA yatsyAnmayA BUtaM carAcaram .. 39 ..

tr.en: And whatsoever is the seed of all beings, that am I, O Arjuna; nor is there aught, moving or unmoving, that may exist bereft of Me.

r: nAnto'sti mama divyAnAM viBUtInAM parantapa . eza tUddeSataH prokto viBUtervistaro mayA .. 40 ..

tr.en: There is no end of My divine powers, O Parantapa. What has been declared is illustrative of My infinite glory.

r: yadyadviBUtimatsattvaM SrImadUrjitameva vA . tattadevAvagacCa tvaM mama tejoM'SasamBavam .. 41 ..

tr.en: Whatsoever is glorious, good, beautiful, and mighty, understand thou that to go forth from a fragment of My splendour.

r: aTavA bahunEtena kiM jYAtena tavArjuna . vizwaByAhamidaM kftsnamekAMSena sTito jagat .. 42 ..

tr.en: But what is the knowledge of all these details to thee, O Arjuna? Having pervaded this whole universe with one fragment of Myself, I remain.

r: arjuna uvAca . madanugrahAya paramaM guhyamaDyAtmasaMjYitam . yattvayoktaM vacastena moho'yaM vigato mama .. 1 ..

tr.en: Arjuna said: This word of the supreme Secret concerning the Self, Thou hast spoken out of compassion; by this my delusion is taken away.

r: BavApyayO hi BUtAnAM SrutO vistaraSo mayA . tvattaH kamalapatrAkza mAhAtmyamapi cAvyayam .. 2 ..

tr.en: The production and destruction of beings have been heard by me in detail from Thee, O Lotus-eyed, and also Thy imperishable greatness.

r: evametadyaTA''tTa tvamAtmAnaM parameSvara . drazwumicCAmi te rUpamESvaraM puruzottama .. 3 ..

tr.en: O supreme Lord, even as Thou describest ​ Thyself, O best of beings, I desire to see Thy Form omnipotent.

r: manyase yadi tacCakyaM mayA drazwumiti praBo . yogeSvara tato me tvaM darSayAtmAnamavyayam .. 4 ..

tr.en: If Thou thinkest that by me It can be seen, O Lord, Lord of Yoga, then show me Thine imperishable Self.

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . paSya me pArTa rUpARi SataSo'Ta sahasraSaH . nAnAviDAni divyAni nAnAvarRAkftIni ca .. 5 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: Behold, O Pârtha, a Form of Me, a hundredfold, a thousandfold, various in kind, divine, various in colours and shapes.

r: paSyAdityAnvasUnrudrAnaSvinO marutastaTA . bahUnyadfzwapUrvARi paSyAScaryARi BArata .. 6 ..

tr.en: Behold the Âdityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, ​ the two Ashvins and also the Maruts ; behold many marvels never seen ere this, O Bhârata.

r: ihEkasTaM jagatkftsnaM paSyAdya sacarAcaram . mama dehe guqAkeSa yaccAnyaddrazwumicCasi .. 7 ..

tr.en: Here, to-day, behold the whole universe, movable and immovable, standing in one in My body, O Gudâkesha, with aught else thou desirest to see.

r: na tu mAM Sakyase drazwumanenEva svacakzuzA . divyaM dadAmi te cakzuH paSya me yogamESvaram .. 8 ..
saYjaya uvAca . evamuktvA tato rAjan mahAyogeSvaro hariH . darSayAmAsa pArTAya paramaM rUpamESvaram .. 9 ..

tr.en: Sanjaya said: Having thus spoken, O King, the great Lord of Yoga, Hari, showed to Pârtha His supreme Form as Lord.

r: anekavaktranayanamanekAdButadarSanam . anekadivyABaraRaM divyAnekodyatAyuDam .. 10 ..

tr.en: With many mouths and eyes, with many visions of marvel, with many divine ornaments, with many upraised divine weapons;

r: divyamAlyAmbaraDaraM divyaganDAnulepanam . sarvAScaryamayaM devamanantaM viSvatomuKam .. 11 ..

tr.en: Wearing divine necklaces and vestures, anointed with divine unguents, the God all-marvellous, boundless, with face turned everywhere.

r: divi sUryasahasrasya BavedyugapadutTitA . yadi BAH sadfSI sA syAdBAsastasya mahAtmanaH .. 12 ..

tr.en: If the splendour of a thousand suns were to ​ blaze out together in the sky, that might resemble the glory of that Mahâtman.

r: tatrEkasTaM jagatkftsnaM praviBaktamanekaDA . apaSyaddevadevasya SarIre pARqavastadA .. 13 ..

tr.en: There Pândava beheld the whole universe, divided into manifold parts, standing in one in the body of the Deity of Deities.

r: tataH sa vismayAvizwo hfzwaromA DanaYjayaH . praRamya SirasA devaM kftAYjaliraBAzata .. 14 ..

tr.en: Then he, Dhananjaya, overwhelmed with astonishment, his hair upstanding, bowed down his head to the Shining One, and with joined palms spake.

r: arjuna uvAca . paSyAmi devAMstava deva dehe sarvAMstaTA BUtaviSezasaNGAn . brahmARamISaM kamalAsanasTamfzIMSca sarvAnuragAMSca divyAn .. 15 ..

tr.en: Arjuna said: Within Thy Form, O God, the Gods I see, All grades of beings with distinctive marks; Brahma, the Lord, upon His lotus-throne, The Rishis all, and Serpents, the Divine.

r: anekabAhUdaravaktranetram paSyAmi tvAM sarvato'nantarUpam . nAntaM na maDyaM na punastavAdim paSyAmi viSveSvara viSvarUpa .. 16 ..

tr.en: With mouths, eyes, arms, breasts multitudinous, I see Thee everywhere, unbounded Form. Beginning, middle, end, nor source of Thee, Infinite Lord, infinite Form, I find;

r: kirIwinaM gadinaM cakriRaM ca tejorASiM sarvato dIptimantam . paSyAmi tvAM durnirIkzyaM samantAd dIptAnalArkadyutimaprameyam .. 17 ..

tr.en: Shining, a mass of splendour everywhere, With discus, mace, tiara, I behold: Blazing as fire, as sun dazzling the gaze, From all sides in the sky, immeasurable.

r: tvamakzaraM paramaM veditavyam tvamasya viSvasya paraM niDAnam . tvamavyayaH SASvataDarmagoptA sanAtanastvaM puruzo mato me .. 18 ..

tr.en: Lofty beyond all thought, unperishing, Thou treasure-house supreme, all-immanent; Eternal Dharma's changeless Guardian, Thou; As immemorial Man I think of Thee.

r: anAdimaDyAntamanantavIrya- manantabAhuM SaSisUryanetram . paSyAmi tvAM dIptahutASavaktram svatejasA viSvamidaM tapantam .. 19 ..

tr.en: Nor source, nor midst, nor end; infinite force, Unnumbered arms, the sun and moon Thine eyes I see Thy face, as sacrificial fire Blazing, its splendour burneth up the worlds.

r: dyAvApfTivyoridamantaraM hi vyAptaM tvayEkena diSaSca sarvAH . dfzwvA'dButaM rUpamugraM tavedam lokatrayaM pravyaTitaM mahAtman .. 20 ..

tr.en: By Thee alone are filled the earth, the heavens, And all the regions that are stretched between; The triple worlds sink down, O mighty One, Before Thine awful manifested Form.

r: amI hi tvAM surasaNGA viSanti kecidBItAH prAYjalayo gfRanti . svastItyuktvA maharzisidDasaNGAH stuvanti tvAM stutiBiH puzkalABiH .. 21 ..

tr.en: To Thee the troops of Suras enter in, Some with joined palms in awe invoking Thee; Banded Maharshis, Siddhas, cry: "All hail"! Chanting Thy praises with resounding songs.

r: rudrAdityA vasavo ye ca sADyAH viSve'SvinO marutaScozmapASca . ganDarvayakzAsurasidDasaNGAH vIkzante tvAM vismitAScEva sarve .. 22 ..

tr.en: Rudras, Vasus, Sâdhyas and Adityas, Vishvas, the Ashvins, Maruts, Ushmapas, Gandharvas, Yakshas, Siddhas, Asuras, In wondering multitudes beholding Thee.

r: rUpaM mahatte bahuvaktranetram mahAbAho bahubAhUrupAdam . bahUdaraM bahudaMzwrAkarAlam dfzwvA lokA pravyaTitAstaTA'ham .. 23 ..

tr.en: Thy mighty Form, with many mouths and eyes, Long armed, with thighs and feet innumerate, Vast-bosomed, set with many fearful teeth, The worlds see terror-struck, as also I.

r: naBaH spfSaM dIptamanekavarRam vyAttAnanaM dIptaviSAlanetram . dfzwvA hi tvAM pravyaTitAntarAtmA DftiM na vindAmi SamaM ca vizRo .. 24 ..

tr.en: Radiant, Thou touchest heaven, rainbow-hued, With opened mouths and shining vast-orbed eyes. My inmost self is quaking, having seen, My strength is withered, Vishnu, and my peace.

r: daMzwrAkarAlAni ca te muKAni dfzwvEva kAlAnalasanniBAni . diSo na jAne na laBe ca Sarma prasIda deveSa jagannivAsa .. 25 ..

tr.en: Like Time's destroying flames I see Thy teeth, Upstanding, spread within expanded jaws; Nought know I anywhere, no shelter find; Mercy, O God! re of all the worlds!

r: amI ca tvAM DftarAzwrasya putrAH sarve sahEvAvanipAlasaNGEH . BIzmo droRaH sUtaputrastaTA'sO sahAsmadIyErapi yoDamuKyEH .. 26 ..

tr.en: The sons of Dhṛitarâshtra, and with them The multitude of all these kings of earth, Bhîshma, and Drona, Sûta's royal son, And all the noblest warriors of our hosts,

r: vaktrARi te tvaramARA viSanti daMzwrAkarAlAni BayAnakAni . kecidvilagnA daSanAntarezu saMdfSyante cUrRitEruttamANgEH .. 27 ..

tr.en: Into Thy gaping mouths they hurrying rush, Tremendous-toothed and terrible to see; Some caught within the gaps between Thy teeth Are seen, their heads to powder crushed and ground.

r: yaTA nadInAM bahavo'mbuvegAH samudramevABimuKA dravanti . taTA tavAmI naralokavIrAH viSanti vaktrARyaBivijvalanti .. 28 ..

tr.en: As river-floods impetuously rush, Hurling their waters into ocean's lap, So fling themselves into Thy flaming mouths, In haste, these mighty men, these lords of earth.

r: yaTA pradIptaM jvalanaM pataNgAH viSanti nASAya samfdDavegAH . taTEva nASAya viSanti lokA- stavApi vaktrARi samfdDavegAH .. 29 ..

tr.en: As moths with quickened speed will headlong fly Into a flaming light, to fall destroyed, So also these, in haste precipitate, Enter within Thy mouths destroyed to fall.

r: lelihyase grasamAnaH samantA- llokAnsamagrAnvadanErjvaladBiH . tejoBirApUrya jagatsamagram BAsastavogrAH pratapanti vizRo .. 30 ..

tr.en: On every side, all-swallowing, fiery-tongued, Thou lickest up mankind, devouring all; The glory filleth space: the universe Is burning, Vishnu, with Thy blazing rays.

r: AKyAhi me ko BavAnugrarUpo namo'stu te devavara prasIda . vijYAtumicCAmi BavantamAdyam na hi prajAnAmi tava pravfttim .. 31 ..

tr.en: Reveal Thy Self ; what awful Form art Thou? I worship Thee! Have mercy, God supreme! Thine inner Being I am fain to know; This Thy forth-streaming Life bewilders me.

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . kAlo'smi lokakzayakftpravfdDo lokAnsamAhartumiha pravfttaH . fte'pi tvAM na Bavizyanti sarve ye'vasTitAH pratyanIkezu yoDAH .. 32 ..

tr.en: Time am I, laying desolate the world, Made manifest on earth to slay mankind! Not one of all these warriors ranged for strife Escapeth death; thou shalt alone survive.

r: tasmAttvamuttizWa yaSo laBasva jitvA SatrUnBuNkzva rAjyaM samfdDam . mayEvEte nihatAH pUrvameva nimittamAtraM Bava savyasAcin .. 33 ..

tr.en: Therefore stand up! win for thyself renown, Conquer thy foes, enjoy the wealth filled realm, By Me they are already overcome, Be thou the outward cause, left-handed one.

r: droRaM ca BIzmaM ca jayadraTaM ca karRaM taTA'nyAnapi yoDavIrAn . mayA hatAMstvaM jahi mA vyaTizWAH yudDyasva jetAsi raRe sapatnAn .. 34 ..

tr.en: Drona and Bhîshma and Jayadratha, Karna, and all the other warriors here, Are slain by Me. Destroy them fearlessly. Fight! thou shalt crush thy rivals in the field.

r: saYjaya uvAca . etacCrutvA vacanaM keSavasya kftAYjalirvepamAnaH kirIwI . namaskftvA BUya evAha kfzRam sagadgadaM BItaBItaH praRamya .. 35 ..

tr.en: Sanjaya said: Having heard these words of Keshava, he who weareth a diadem, with joined palms, quaking ​ and prostrating himself, spake again to Krishna, stammering with fear, casting down his face.

r: arjuna uvAca . sTAne hfzIkeSa tava prakIrtyA jagatprahfzyatyanurajyate ca . rakzAMsi BItAni diSo dravanti sarve namasyanti ca sidDasaNGAH .. 36 ..

tr.en: Arjuna said: Hrishîkesha! in Thy magnificence Rightly the world rejoiceth, hymning Thee; The Râkshasas to every quarter fly In fear; the hosts of Siddhas prostrate fall.

r: kasmAcca te na nameranmahAtman garIyase brahmaRo'pyAdikartre . ananta deveSa jagannivAsa tvamakzaraM sadasattatparaM yat .. 37 ..

tr.en: How should they otherwise, O loftiest Self! First Cause! Brahmâ Himself less great than Thou. Infinite, God of Gods, home of all worlds, Unperishing, Sat, Asat, That supreme!

r: tvamAdidevaH puruzaH purARastvamasya viSvasya paraM niDAnam . vettA'si vedyaM ca paraM ca DAma tvayA tataM viSvamanantarUpa .. 38 ..

tr.en: First of the Gods, most ancient Man Thou art. Supreme receptacle of all that lives; Knower and known, the dwelling-place on high; In Thy vast Form the universe is spread.

r: vAyuryamo'gnirvaruRaH SaSANkaH prajApatistvaM prapitAmahaSca . namo namaste'stu sahasrakftvaH punaSca BUyo'pi namo namaste .. 39 ..

tr.en: Thou art Vâyu and Yama, Agni, moon, Varuna, Father, Grandsire of all; Hail, hail to Thee! a thousand times all hail! Hail unto Thee! again, again all hail!

r: namaH purastAdaTa pfzWataste namo'stu te sarvata eva sarva . anantavIryAmitavikramastvam sarvaM samApnozi tato'si sarvaH .. 40 ..

tr.en: Prostrate in front of Thee, prostrate behind; Prostrate on every side to Thee, O All. In power boundless, measureless in strength, Thou holdest all: then Thou Thyself art All.

r: saKeti matvA prasaBaM yaduktam he kfzRa he yAdava he saKeti . ajAnatA mahimAnaM tavedam mayA pramAdAtpraRayena vApi .. 41 ..

tr.en: If, thinking Thee but friend, importunate, O Krishna! or O Yâdava! O friend! I cried, unknowing of Thy majesty, And careless in the fondness of my love;

r: yaccAvahAsArTamasatkfto'si vihAraSayyAsanaBojanezu . eko'TavA'pyacyuta tatsamakzam tatkzAmaye tvAmahamaprameyam .. 42 ..

tr.en: If jesting I irreverence showed to Thee, At play, reposing, sitting or at meals, Alone, O sinless One, or with my friends, Forgive my error, O Thou boundless One.

r: pitA'si lokasya carAcarasya tvamasya pUjyaSca gururgarIyAn . na tvatsamo'styaByaDikaH kuto'nyo lokatraye'pyapratimapraBAvaH .. 43 ..

tr.en: Father of worlds, of all that moves and stands, Worthier of reverence than the Guru's self, There is none like to Thee. Who passeth Thee? Pre-eminent Thy power in all the worlds.

r: tasmAtpraRamya praRiDAya kAyam prasAdaye tvAmahamISamIqyam . piteva putrasya saKeva saKyuH priyaH priyAyArhasi deva soQum .. 44 ..

tr.en: Therefore I fall before Thee; with my body I worship as it fitting; bless Thou me. As father with the son, as friend with friend, With the beloved as lover, bear with me.

r: adfzwapUrvaM hfzito'smi dfzwvA Bayena ca pravyaTitaM mano me . tadeva me darSaya deva rUpam prasIda deveSa jagannivAsa .. 45 ..

tr.en: I have seen that which none hath seen before, My heart is glad, yet faileth me for fear; Show me, O God, Thine other Form again— Mercy, O God of Gods, home of all worlds—

r: kirIwinaM gadinaM cakrahastamicCAmi tvAM drazwumahaM taTEva . tenEva rUpeRa caturBujena sahasrabAho Bava viSvamUrte .. 46 ..

tr.en: Diademed, mace and discus in Thy hand. Again I fain would see Thee as before; Put on again Thy four-armed shape, O Lord, O thousand-armed, of forms innumerate.

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . mayA prasannena tavArjunedam rUpaM paraM darSitamAtmayogAt . tejomayaM viSvamanantamAdyam yanme tvadanyena na dfzwapUrvam .. 47 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: Arjuna, by My favour thou hast seen, This loftiest Form by yoga's self revealed! Radiant, all-penetrating, endless, first, That none except thyself hath ever seen.

r: na vedayajYADyayanErna dAnErna ca kriyABirna tapoBirugrEH . evaMrUpaH Sakya ahaM nfloke drazwuM tvadanyena kurupravIra .. 48 ..

tr.en: Nor sacrifice, nor Vedas, alms, nor works, Nor sharp austerity, nor study deep, Can win the vision of this Form for man, Foremost of Kurus, thou alone hast seen.

r: mA te vyaTA mA ca vimUQaBAvo dfzwvA rUpaM GoramIdfNmamedam . vyapetaBIH prItamanAH punastvam tadeva me rUpamidaM prapaSya .. 49 ..

tr.en: Be not bewildered, be thou not afraid, Because thou hast beheld this awful Form; Cast fear away, and let thy heart rejoice; Behold again Mine own familiar shape.

r: saYjaya uvAca . ityarjunaM vAsudevastaToktvA svakaM rUpaM darSayAmAsa BUyaH . ASvAsayAmAsa ca BItamenam BUtvA punaH sOmyavapurmahAtmA .. 50 ..

tr.en: Sanjaya said: Vâsudeva, having thus spoken to Arjuna, again manifested His own Form, and consoled the terrified one, the Mahâtman again assuming a gentle form.

r: arjuna uvAca . dfzwvedaM mAnuzaM rUpaM tava sOmyaM janArdana . idAnImasmi saMvfttaH sacetAH prakftiM gataH .. 51 ..

tr.en: Arjuna said: Beholding again Thy gentle human Form, O Janârdana, I am now collected, and am restored to my own nature.

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . sudurdarSamidaM rUpaM dfzwavAnasi yanmama . devA apyasya rUpasya nityaM darSanakANkziRaH .. 52 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: This Form of Mine beholden by thee is very hard to see. Verily the Shining Ones ever long to behold this form.

r: nAhaM vedErna tapasA na dAnena na cejyayA . Sakya evaMviDo drazwuM dfzwavAnasi mAM yaTA .. 53 ..

tr.en: Nor can I be seen as thou hast seen Me by the Vedas, nor by austerities, nor by alms, or by offerings;

r: BaktyA tvananyayA Sakya ahamevaMviDo'rjuna . jYAtuM drazwuM ca tattvena pravezwuM ca parantapa .. 54 ..

tr.en: But by devotion to Me alone I may thus be perceived, Arjuna, and known and seen in essence, and entered, O Parantapa.

r: matkarmakfnmatparamo madBaktaH saNgavarjitaH . nirvEraH sarvaBUtezu yaH sa mAmeti pARqava .. 55 ..

tr.en: He who doeth actions for Me, whose supreme good I am, My devotee, freed from attachment without hatred of any being, he cometh unto Me, O Pândava.

r: arjuna uvAca . evaM satatayuktA ye BaktAstvAM paryupAsate . ye cApyakzaramavyaktaM tezAM ke yogavittamAH .. 1 ..

tr.en: Arjuna said: Those devotees who ever harmonised worship Thee, and those also who worship the Indestructible, the Unmanifested, whether of these is the more learned in yoga?

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . mayyAveSya mano ye mAM nityayuktA upAsate . SradDayA parayopetAste me yuktatamA matAH .. 2 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: They who with mind fixed on Me ever harmonised worship Me, with faith supreme endowed, these, in My opinion, are best in yoga.

r: ye tvakzaramanirdeSyamavyaktaM paryupAsate . sarvatragamacintyaM ca kUwasTamacalaM Druvam .. 3 ..

tr.en: They who worship the Indestructible, the Ineffable, the unmanifested, Omnipresent, and Unthinkable, the Unchanging, Immutable, Eternal,

r: saMniyamyendriyagrAmaM sarvatra samabudDayaH . te prApnuvanti mAmeva sarvaBUtahite ratAH .. 4 ..

tr.en: Restraining and subduing the senses, regarding everything equally, in the welfare of all rejoicing, these also come unto Me.

r: kleSo'DikatarastezAmavyaktAsaktacetasAm . avyaktA hi gatirduHKaM dehavadBiravApyate .. 5 ..

tr.en: The difficulty of those whose minds are set on the Unmanifested is greater; for the path of the Unmanifested is hard for the embodied to reach.

r: ye tu sarvARi karmARi mayi saMnyasya matparAH . ananyenEva yogena mAM DyAyanta upAsate .. 6 ..

tr.en: Those verily who, renouncing all actions in Me and intent on Me, worship meditating on Me, with whole-hearted yoga,

r: tezAmahaM samudDartA mftyusaMsArasAgarAt . BavAmi na cirAtpArTa mayyAveSitacetasAm .. 7 ..

tr.en: These I speedily lift up from the ocean of death and existence, O Pârtha, their minds being fixed on Me.

r: mayyeva mana ADatsva mayi budDiM niveSaya . nivasizyasi mayyeva ata UrDvaM na saMSayaH .. 8 ..

tr.en: Place thy mind in me, into Me let thy Reason enter; then without doubt thou shalt abide in Me hereafter.

r: aTa cittaM samADAtuM na Saknozi mayi sTiram . aByAsayogena tato mAmicCAptuM DanaYjaya .. 9 ..

tr.en: And if thou art not able firmly to fix thy mind ​ on Me, then by the yoga of practice seek to reach Me, O Dhananjaya.

r: aByAse'pyasamarTo'si matkarmaparamo Bava . madarTamapi karmARi kurvansidDimavApsyasi .. 10 ..

tr.en: If also thou art not equal to constant practice, be intent on My service; performing actions for My sake, thou shalt attain perfection.

r: aTEtadapyaSakto'si kartuM madyogamASritaH . sarvakarmaPalatyAgaM tataH kuru yatAtmavAn .. 11 ..

tr.en: If even to do this thou hast not strength, then, taking refuge in union with Me, renounce all fruit of action with the self controlled.

r: Sreyo hi jYAnamaByAsAjjYAnAdDyAnaM viSizyate . DyAnAtkarmaPalatyAgastyAgAcCAntiranantaram .. 12 ..

tr.en: Better indeed is wisdom than constant-practice; than wisdom, meditation is better; ​ than meditation, renunciation of the fruit of action; on renunciation follows peace.

r: advezwA sarvaBUtAnAM mEtraH karuRa eva ca . nirmamo nirahaNkAraH samaduHKasuKaH kzamI .. 13 ..

tr.en: He who beareth no ill-will to any being, friendly and compassionate, without attachment and egoism, balanced in pleasure and pain, and forgiving,

r: santuzwaH satataM yogI yatAtmA dfQaniScayaH . mayyarpitamanobudDiryo me BaktaH sa me priyaH .. 14 ..

tr.en: Ever content, harmonious, with the self-controlled, resolute, with mind and Reason dedicated to Me, he, My devotee, is dear to Me.

r: yasmAnnodvijate loko lokAnnodvijate ca yaH . harzAmarzaBayodvegErmukto yaH sa ca me priyaH .. 15 ..

tr.en: ​ He from whom the world doth not shrink away, who doth not shrink away from the world, freed from the anxieties of joy, anger, and fear, he is dear to me.

r: anapekzaH Sucirdakza udAsIno gatavyaTaH . sarvAramBaparityAgI yo madBaktaH sa me priyaH .. 16 ..

tr.en: He who wants nothing, is pure, expert, passionless, untroubled, renouncing every undertaking, he, My devotee, is dear to Me.

r: yo na hfzyati na dvezwi na Socati na kANkzati . SuBASuBaparityAgI BaktimAnyaH sa me priyaH .. 17 ..

tr.en: He who neither loveth nor hateth, nor grieveth, nor desireth, renouncing good and evil, full of devotion, he is dear to Me.

r: samaH SatrO ca mitre ca taTA mAnapamAnayoH . SItozRasuKaduHKezu samaH saNgavivarjitaH .. 18 ..

tr.en: ​ Alike to foe and friend, and also in fame and ignominy, alike in cold and heat, pleasures and pains, destitute of attachment,

r: tulyanindAstutirmOnI santuzwo yenakenacit . aniketaH sTiramatirBaktimAnme priyo naraH .. 19 ..

tr.en: Taking equally praise and reproach, silent, wholly content with what cometh, homeless, firm in mind, full of devotion, that man is dear to Me.

r: ye tu DarmyAmftamidaM yaToktaM paryupAsate . SraddaDAnA matparamA BaktAste'tIva me priyAH .. 20 ..

tr.en: They verily who partake of this life-giving wisdom as taught herein, endued with faith, I their supreme Object, devotees, they are surpassingly dear to Me.

r: arjuna uvAca . prakftiM puruzaM cEva kzetraM kzetrajYameva ca . etadveditumicCAmi jYAnaM jYeyaM ca keSava .. 1 ..

tr.en: Arjuna said: Matter and Spirit, even the Field and the Knower of the Field, wisdom and that which ought to be known, these I fain would learn, O Keshava.

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . idaM SarIraM kOnteya kzetramityaBiDIyate . etadyo vetti taM prAhuH kzetrajYa iti tadvidaH .. 2 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: This body, son of Kuntî, is called the Field; that which knoweth it is called the Knower of the Field by the Sages.

r: kzetrakzetrajYayorjYAnaM yattajjYAnaM mataM mama .. 3 ..

tr.en: Understand Me as the Knower of the Field in all Fields, O Bhârata. Wisdom as to the Field and the Knower of the Field, that in My opinion is the wisdom.

r: sa ca yo yatpraBAvaSca tatsamAsena me SfRu .. 4 ..

tr.en: What that Field is and of what nature, how modified, and whence it is, and what He is and what His powers, hear that now briefly from Me.

r: brahmasUtrapadEScEva hetumadBirviniScitEH .. 5 ..

tr.en: Rishis have sung in manifold ways, in many various chants, and in decisive Brahma-sûtra verses full of reasonings.

r: indriyARi daSEkaM ca paYca cendriyagocarAH .. 6 ..

tr.en: The great Elements, Individuality , Reason , and also the unmanifested, the ten senses and the one, and the five pastures of the senses ;

r: etatkzetraM samAsena savikAramudAhftam .. 7 ..

tr.en: Desire, aversion, pleasure, pain, combination , intelligence, firmness; these, briefly described, constitute the Field and its modifications.

r: AcAryopAsanaM SOcaM sTEryamAtmavinigrahaH .. 8 ..

tr.en: Humility, unpretentiousness, harmlessness, ​ forgiveness, rectitude, service of the teacher, purity, steadfastness, self-control.

r: janmamftyujarAvyADiduHKadozAnudarSanam .. 9 ..

tr.en: Dispassion towards the objects of the senses, and also absence of egoism, insight into the pain and evil of birth, death, old age and sickness,

r: nityaM ca samacittatvamizwAnizwopapattizu .. 10 ..

tr.en: Unattachment, absence of self-identification with son, wife or home, and constant balance of mind in wished-for and unwished-for events,

r: viviktadeSasevitvamaratirjanasaMsadi .. 11 ..

tr.en: Unflinching devotion to Me by yoga, without ​ other objects, resort to sequestered places, absence of enjoyment in the company of men,

r: etajjYAnamiti proktamajYAnaM yadato'nyaTA .. 12 ..

tr.en: Constancy in the wisdom of the Self, understanding of the object of essential wisdom; that is declared to be the Wisdom; all against it is ignorance.

r: anAdimatparaM brahma na sattannAsaducyate .. 13 ..

tr.en: I will declare that which ought to be known, that which being known immortality is enjoyed—the beginningless supreme Eternal , called neither being nor non-being.

r: sarvataH Srutimalloke sarvamAvftya tizWati .. 14 ..

tr.en: Everywhere That hath hands and feet, ​ everywhere eyes, heads, and mouths; all-hearing, He dwelleth in the world, enveloping all,

r: asaktaM sarvaBfccEva nirguRaM guRaBoktf ca .. 15 ..

tr.en: Shining with all sense-faculties without any senses; unattached supporting everything and free from qualities enjoying qualities;

r: sUkzmatvAttadavijYeyaM dUrasTaM cAntike ca tat .. 16 ..

tr.en: Without and within all beings, immovable and also movable; by reason of His subtlety imperceptible; at hand and far away is That .

r: BUtaBartf ca tajjYeyaM grasizRu praBavizRu ca .. 17 ..

tr.en: Not divided amid beings, and yet seated ​ distributively; that is to be known as the supporter of beings; He devours and He generates.

r: jYAnaM jYeyaM jYAnagamyaM hfdi sarvasya DizWitam .. 18 ..

tr.en: That , the Light of all lights, is said to be beyond darkness; Wisdom, the Object of Wisdom, by Wisdom to be reached, seated in the hearts of all.

r: madBakta etadvijYAya madBAvAyopapadyate .. 19 ..

tr.en: Thus the Field, Wisdom and the Object of Wisdom, have been briefly told. My devotee, thus knowing, enters into My Being.

r: vikArAMSca guRAMScEva vidDi prakftisaMBavAn .. 20 ..

tr.en: ​ Know thou that Matter and Spirit are both without beginning; and know thou also that modifications and qualities are all Matter -born.

r: puruzaH suKaduHKAnAM Boktftve heturucyate .. 21 ..

tr.en: Matter is called the cause of the generation of causes and effects; Spirit is called the cause of the enjoyment of pleasure and pain.

r: kAraRaM guRasaNgo'sya sadasadyonijanmasu .. 22 ..

tr.en: Spirit seated in Matter useth the qualities born of Matter ; attachment to the qualities is the cause of his births in good and evil wombs.

r: paramAtmeti cApyukto dehe'sminpuruzaH paraH .. 23 ..

tr.en: ​ Supervisor and permitter, supporter, enjoyer, the great Lord, and also the supreme Self ; thus is styled in this body the supreme Spirit.

r: sarvaTA vartamAno'pi na sa BUyo'BijAyate .. 24 ..

tr.en: He who thus knoweth Spirit and Matter with its qualities, in whatsoever condition he may be, he shall not be born again.

r: anye sANKyena yogena karmayogena cApare .. 25 ..

tr.en: Some by meditation behold the Self in the self by the Self ; others by the Sânkhya Yoga, and others by the Yoga of Action;

r: te'pi cAtitarantyeva mftyuM SrutiparAyaRAH .. 26 ..

tr.en: Others also, ignorant of this, having heard of it ​ from others, worship; and these also cross beyond death, adhering to what they had heard.

r: kzetrakzetrajYasaMyogAttadvidDi BaratarzaBa .. 27 ..

tr.en: Whatsoever creature is born immobile or mobile, know thou, O best of the Bhâratas, that it is from the union between the Field and the Knower of the Field.

r: vinaSyatsvavinaSyantaM yaH paSyati sa paSyati .. 28 ..

tr.en: Seated equally in all beings, the supreme Lord, unperishing within the perishing—he who thus seeth, he seeth.

r: na hinastyAtmanA''tmAnaM tato yAti parAM gatim .. 29 ..

tr.en: Seeing indeed everywhere the same Lord equally dwelling, he doth not destroy the Self , and thus treads the highest Path.

r: yaH paSyati taTA''tmAnamakartAraM sa paSyati .. 30 ..

tr.en: He who seeth that Matter verily performeth all actions, and that the Self is actionless, he seeth.

r: tata eva ca vistAraM brahma saMpadyate tadA .. 31 ..

tr.en: When he perceiveth the diversified existence of beings as rooted in One, and spreading forth from it, then he reacheth the Eternal

r: SarIrasTo'pi kOnteya na karoti na lipyate .. 32 ..

tr.en: Being beginningless and without qualities , the imperishable supreme Self , though seated in the body, O Kaunteya, worketh not nor is affected.

r: sarvatrAvasTito dehe taTA''mA nopalipyate .. 33 ..

tr.en: As the omnipresent ether is not affected, by reason of its subtlety, so seated everywhere in the body the Self is not affected.

r: kzetraM kzetrI taTA kftsnaM prakASayati BArata .. 34 ..

tr.en: As the one sun illumineth the whole earth, so the Lord of the Field illumineth the whole Field, O Bhârata.

r: BUtaprakftimokzaM ca ye viduryAnti te param .. 35 ..

tr.en: They who by the eyes of Wisdom perceive this difference between the Field and the Knower of the Field, and the liberation of beings from Matter they go to the Supreme.

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . paraM BUyaH pravakzyAmi jYAnAnAM jYAnamuttamam . yajjYAtvA munayaH sarve parAM sidDimito gatAH .. 1 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: I will again proclaim that supreme Wisdom, of all wisdom the best, which having known, all the Sages have gone hence to the supreme Perfection.

r: idaM jYAnamupASritya mama sADarmyamAgatAH . sarge'pi nopajAyante pralaye na vyaTanti ca .. 2 ..

tr.en: Having taken refuge in this Wisdom and being assimilated to My own nature, they are not re-born even in the emanation of a universe, nor are disquieted in the dissolution.

r: mama yonirmahadbrahma tasmin garBaM daDAmyaham . samBavaH sarvaBUtAnAM tato Bavati BArata .. 3 ..

tr.en: ​ My womb is the great Eternal ; in that I place the germ; thence cometh the birth of all beings, O Bhârata.

r: sarvayonizu kOnteya mUrtayaH saMBavanti yAH . tAsAM brahma mahadyonirahaM bIjapradaH pitA .. 4 ..

tr.en: In whatsoever wombs mortals are produced, O Kaunteya, the great Eternal is their womb, I their generating father.

r: sattvaM rajastama iti guRAH prakftisaMBavAH . nibaDnanti mahAbAho dehe dehinamavyayam .. 5 ..

tr.en: Harmony, Motion, Inertia, such are the qualities , Matter -born; they bind fast in the body, O great-armed one, the indestructible dweller in the body.

r: tatra sattvaM nirmalatvAtprakASakamanAmayam . suKasaNgena baDnAti jYAnasaNgena cAnaGa .. 6 ..

tr.en: Of these Harmony from its stainlessness, ​ luminous and healthy, bindeth by the attachment to bliss and the attachment to wisdom, O sinless one.

r: rajo rAgAtmakaM vidDi tfzRAsaNgasamudBavam . tannibaDnAti kOnteya karmasaNgena dehinam .. 7 ..

tr.en: Motion, the passion nature, know thou, is the source of attachment and thirst for life, O Kaunteya, that bindeth the dweller in the body by the attachment to action.

r: tamastvajYAnajaM vidDi mohanaM sarvadehinAm . pramAdAlasyanidrABistannibaDnAti BArata .. 8 ..

tr.en: But Inertia, know thou, born of unwisdom, is the deluder of all dwellers in the body; that bindeth by heedlessness, indolence and sloth, O Bharata .

r: sattvaM suKe saYjayati rajaH karmaRi BArata . jYAnamAvftya tu tamaH pramAde saYjayatyuta .. 9 ..

tr.en: Harmony attacheth to bliss, Motion to action ​ O Bharata . Inertia, verily, having shrouded wisdom, attacheth on the contrary to heedlessness.

r: rajastamaScABiBUya sattvaM Bavati BArata . rajaH sattvaM tamaScEva tamaH sattvaM rajastaTA .. 10 ..

tr.en: Now Harmony prevaileth, having overpowered Motion and Inertia, O Bhârata; now Motion, having overpowered Harmony and Inertia; and now Inertia, having overpowered Harmony and Motion.

r: sarvadvArezu dehe'sminprakASa upajAyate . jYAnaM yadA tadA vidyAdvivfdDaM sattvamityuta .. 11 ..

tr.en: When the wisdom-light streameth forth from all the gates of the body, then it may be known that Harmony is increasing.

r: loBaH pravfttirAraMBaH karmaRAmaSamaH spfhA . rajasyetAni jAyante vivfdDe BaratarzaBa .. 12 ..

tr.en: Greed, outgoing energy, undertaking of actions, ​ restlessness, desire—these are born of the increase of Motion, O best of the Bhâratas.

r: aprakASo'pravfttiSca pramAdo moha eva ca . tamasyetAni jAyante vivfdDe kurunandana .. 13 ..

tr.en: Darkness, stagnation and heedlessness and also delusion—these are born of the increase of Inertia, O joy of the Kurus.

r: yadA sattve pravfdDe tu pralayaM yAti dehaBft . tadottamavidAM lokAnamalAnpratipadyate .. 14 ..

tr.en: If Harmony verily prevaileth when the embodied goeth to dissolution, then he goeth forth to the spotless worlds of the great Sages.

r: rajasi pralayaM gatvA karmasaNgizu jAyate . taTA pralInastamasi mUQayonizu jAyate .. 15 ..

tr.en: Having gone to dissolution in Motion, he is born among those attached to action; if dissolved in Inertia, he is born in the wombs of the senseless.

r: karmaRaH sukftasyAhuH sAttvikaM nirmalaM Palam . rajasastu PalaM duHKamajYAnaM tamasaH Palam .. 16 ..

tr.en: It is said the fruit of a good action is harmonious and spotless; verily the fruit of Motion is pain, and the fruit of Inertia unwisdom

r: sattvAtsaYjAyate jYAnaM rajaso loBa eva ca . pramAdamohO tamaso Bavato'jYAnameva ca .. 17 ..

tr.en: From Harmony wisdom is born, and also greed from Motion; heedlessness and delusion are of Inertia and also unwisdom.

r: UrDvaM gacCanti sattvasTA maDye tizWanti rAjasAH . jaGanyaguRavfttisTA aDo gacCanti tAmasAH .. 18 ..

tr.en: They rise upwards who are settled in Harmony; the Active dwell in the mid-most place: the Inert go downwards, enveloped in the vilest

r: nAnyaM guReByaH kartAraM yadA drazwA'nupaSyati . guReByaSca paraM vetti madBAvaM so'DigacCati .. 19 ..

tr.en: When the Seer perceiveth no agent other than the qualities , and knoweth That which is higher than the qualities, he entereth into My Nature.

r: guRAnetAnatItya trIndehI dehasamudBavAn . janmamftyujarAduHKErvimukto'mftamaSnute .. 20 ..

tr.en: When the dweller in the body hath crossed over these three qualities, whence all bodies have been produced, liberated from birth, death, old age and sorrow, he drinketh the nectar of immortality .

r: arjuna uvAca . kErliNgEstrInguRAnetAnatIto Bavati praBo . kimAcAraH kaTaM cEtAMstrInguRAnativartate .. 21 ..

tr.en: Arjuna said: What are the marks of him who hath crossed over the three qualities , O Lord? How acteth he, and how doth he go beyond these three qualities ?

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . prakASaM ca pravfttiM ca mohameva ca pARqava . na dvezwi saMpravfttAni na nivfttAni kANkzati .. 22 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: He, O Pândava, who hateth not radiance, nor outgoing energy, nor even delusion, when present, nor longeth after them, absent;

r: udAsInavadAsIno guREryo na vicAlyate . guRA vartanta ityeva yo'vatizWati neNgate .. 23 ..

tr.en: He who, seated as a neutral, is unshaken by the qualities ; who, saying, "The qualities revolve," standeth apart immovable.

r: samaduHKasuKaH svasTaH samalozwASmakAYcanaH . tulyapriyApriyo DIrastulyanindAtmasaMstutiH .. 24 ..

tr.en: Balanced in pleasure and pain, self-reliant, to whom a lump of earth, a rock and gold are alike, the same to loved and unloved, firm, the same in censure and in praise,

r: mAnApamAnayostulyastulyo mitrAripakzayoH . sarvAraMBaparityAgI guRAtItaH sa ucyate .. 25 ..

tr.en: The same in honour and ignominy, the same to friend and foe, abandoning all undertakings—he is said to have crossed over the qualities.

r: mAM ca yo'vyaBicAreRa Baktiyogena sevate . sa guRAnsamatItyEtAn brahmaBUyAya kalpate .. 26 ..

tr.en: And he who serveth Me exclusively by the Yoga of devotion, he, crossing beyond the qualities, he is fit to become the Eternal .

r: brahmaRo hi pratizWA'hamamftasyAvyayasya ca . SASvatasya ca Darmasya suKasyEkAntikasya ca .. 27 ..

tr.en: For I am the abode of the Eternal , and of the indestructible nectar of immortality, of immemorial righteousness, and of unending bliss.

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . UrDvamUlamaDaHSAKamaSvatTaM prAhuravyayam . CandAMsi yasya parRAni yastaM veda sa vedavit .. 1 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: With roots above, branches below, the Asvattha is said to be indestructible; the leaves of it are hymns; he who knoweth it is a Veda-knower.

r: aDaScorDvaM prasftAstasya SAKAH guRapravfdDA vizayapravAlAH . aDaSca mUlAnyanusantatAni karmAnubanDIni manuzyaloke .. 2 ..

tr.en: Downwards and upwards spread the branches of it, nourished by the qualities ; the objects of the senses its buds; and its roots grow ​ downwards, the bonds of action in the world of men.

r: na rUpamasyeha taTopalaByate nAnto na cAdirna ca saMpratizWA . aSvatTamenaM suvirUQamUlamasaNgaSastreRa dfQena CittvA .. 3 ..

tr.en: Nor here may be acquired knowledge of its form, nor its end, nor its origin, nor its rooting-place; this strongly rooted Asvattha having been cut down by the unswerving weapon of non-attachment,

r: tataH padaM tatparimArgitavyam yasmingatA na nivartanti BUyaH . tameva cAdyaM puruzaM prapadye yataH pravfttiH prasftA purARI .. 4 ..

tr.en: That path beyond may be sought, treading which there is no return. I go indeed to that ​ Primal Man , whence the ancient energy forth-streamed.

r: nirmAnamohA jitasaNgadozAH aDyAtmanityA vinivfttakAmAH . dvandvErvimuktAH suKaduHKasaMjYE- rgacCantyamUQAH padamavyayaM tat .. 5 ..

tr.en: Without pride and delusion, victorious over the vice of attachment, dwelling constantly in the Self , desire pacified, liberated from the pairs of opposites known as pleasure and pain, they tread, undeluded, that indestructible path.

r: na tadBAsayate sUryo na SaSANko na pAvakaH . yadgatvA na nivartante tadDAma paramaM mama .. 6 ..

tr.en: Nor doth the sun lighten there, nor moon, nor fire; having gone thither they return not; that is My supreme abode.

r: mamEvAMSo jIvaloke jIvaBUtaH sanAtanaH . manaHzazWAnIndriyARi prakftisTAni karzati .. 7 ..

tr.en: A portion of Mine own Self, transformed in the world of life into an immortal Spirit, draweth round itself the senses of which the mind is the sixth, veiled in matter .

r: SarIraM yadavApnoti yaccApyutkrAmatISvaraH . gfhitvEtAni saMyAti vAyurganDAnivASayAt .. 8 ..

tr.en: When the Lord acquireth a body and when He abandoneth it, He seizeth these and goeth with them, as the wind takes fragrances from their retreats

r: SrotraM cakzuH sparSanaM ca rasanaM GrARameva ca . aDizWAya manaScAyaM vizayAnupasevate .. 9 ..

tr.en: Enshrined in the ear, the eye, the touch, the taste and the smell, and in the mind also, He enjoyeth the objects of the senses

r: utkrAmantaM sTitaM vApi BuYjAnaM vA guRAnvitam . vimUQA nAnupaSyanti paSyanti jYAnacakzuzaH .. 10 ..

tr.en: The deluded do not perceive (Him) when He departeth or stayeth or enjoyeth, swayed by the qualities ; the wisdom-eyed perceive.

r: yatanto yoginaScEnaM paSyantyAtmanyavasTitam . yatanto'pyakftAtmAno nEnaM paSyantyacetasaH .. 11 ..

tr.en: Yogîs also, struggling, perceive Him, established in the Self ; but though struggling, the unintelligent perceive Him not, their selves untrained.

r: yadAdityagataM tejo jagadBAsayate'Kilam . yaccandramasi yaccAgnO tattejo vidDi mAmakam .. 12 ..

tr.en: That splendour issuing from the sun that enlighteneth the whole world, that which is in the moon and in fire, that splendour know as from Me.

r: gAmAviSya ca BUtAni DArayAmyahamojasA . puzRAmi cOzaDIH sarvAH somo BUtvA rasAtmakaH .. 13 ..

tr.en: Permeating the soil, I support beings by my vital energy, and having become the delicious Soma I nourish all plants.

r: ahaM vESvAnaro BUtvA prARinAM dehamASritaH . prARApAnasamAyuktaH pacAmyannaM caturviDam .. 14 ..

tr.en: I, having become the Fire of Life , take possession of the bodies of breathing things, and united with the life-breaths , I digest the four kinds of food.

r: sarvasya cAhaM hfdi sannivizwo mattaH smftirjYAnamapohanaM ca . vedESca sarvErahameva vedyo vedAntakfdvedavideva cAham .. 15 ..

tr.en: ​ And I am seated in the hearts of all, and from Me memory and wisdom and their absence. And that which is to be known in all the Vedas am I; and I indeed the Veda-knower and the author of the Vedanta.

r: dvAvimO puruzO loke kzaraScAkzara eva ca . kzaraH sarvARi BUtAni kUwasTo'kzara ucyate .. 16 ..

tr.en: There are two Energies in this world, the destructible and the indestructible; the destructible is all beings, the unchanging is called the indestructible.

r: uttamaH puruzastvanyaH paramAtmetyudAhftaH . yo lokatrayamAviSya biBartyavyaya ISvaraH .. 17 ..

tr.en: The highest Energy is verily Another, declared as the Supreme Self , He who, pervading all, sustaineth the three worlds, the indestructible Lord.

r: yasmAtkzaramatIto'hamakzarAdapi cottamaH . ato'smi loke vede ca praTitaH puruzottamaH .. 18 ..

tr.en: Since I excel the destructible, and am more excellent also than the indestructible, in the world and in the Veda I am proclaimed the Supreme Spirit.

r: yo mAmevamasaMmUQo jAnAti puruzottamam . sa sarvavidBajati mAM sarvaBAvena BArata .. 19 ..

tr.en: He who undeluded knoweth Me thus as the Supreme Spirit , he, all-knowing, worshippeth Me with his whole being, O Bhârata.

r: iti guhyatamaM SAstramidamuktaM mayA'naGa . etad‌buDvA budDimAn syAtkftakftyaSca BArata .. 20 ..

tr.en: Thus by Me this most secret teaching hath been told O sinless one. This known, he hath become illuminated and hath finished his work, O Bhârata.

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . aBayaM sattvasaMSudDirjYAnayogavyavasTitiH . dAnaM damaSca yajYaSca svADyAyastapa Arjavam .. 1 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: Fearlessness, cleanness of life, steadfastness in the Yoga of wisdom, almsgiving, self-restraint and sacrifice and study of the Scriptures, austerity and straightforwardness,

r: ahiMsA satyamakroDastyAgaH SAntirapESunam . dayA BUtezvaloluptvaM mArdavaM hrIracApalam .. 2 ..

tr.en: Harmlessness, truth, absence of wrath, renunciation, peacefulness, absence of crookedness, compassion to living beings, uncovetousness, mildness, modesty, absence of fickleness,

r: tejaH kzamA DftiH SOcamadroho nAtimAnitA . Bavanti sampadaM dEvImaBijAtasya BArata .. 3 ..

tr.en: ​ Vigour, forgiveness, fortitude, purity, absence of envy and pride—these are his who is born with the divine properties, O Bhârata.

r: damBo darpo'BimAnaSca kroDaH pAruzyameva ca . ajYAnaM cABijAtasya pArTa sampadamAsurIm .. 4 ..

tr.en: Hypocrisy, arrogance and conceit, wrath and also harshness and unwisdom are his who is born, O Pârtha, with demoniacal properties.

r: dEvI sampadvimokzAya nibanDAyAsurI matA . mA SucaH sampadaM dEvImaBijAto'si pARqava .. 5 ..

tr.en: The divine properties are deemed to be for liberation, the demoniacal for bondage. Grieve not, thou art born with divine properties, O Pândava.

r: dvO BUtasargO loke'smindEva Asura eva ca . dEvo vistaraSaH prokta AsuraM pArTa me SfRu .. 6 ..

tr.en: ​ Twofold is the animal creation in this world, the divine and the demoniacal: the divine hath been described at length: hear from Me, O Pârtha, the demoniacal.

r: pravfttiM ca nivfttiM ca janA na vidurAsurAH . na SOcaM nApi cAcAro na satyaM tezu vidyate .. 7 ..

tr.en: Demoniacal men know neither right energy nor right abstinence; nor purity, nor even propriety, nor truth is in them.

r: asatyamapratizWaM te jagadAhuranISvaram . aparasparasaMBUtaM kimanyatkAmahEtukam .. 8 ..

tr.en: "The universe is without truth, without basis," they say, "without a God ; brought about by mutual union, and caused by lust and nothing else."

r: etava dfzwimavazwaBya nazwAtmAno'lpabudDayaH . praBavantyugrakarmARaH kzayAya jagato'hitAH .. 9 ..

tr.en: ​ Holding this view, these ruined selves of small understanding , of fierce deeds, come forth as enemies for the destruction of the world.

r: kAmamASritya duzpUraM damBamAnamadAnvitAH . mohAd‌gfhItvA'sadgrAhAnpravartante'SucivratAH .. 10 ..

tr.en: Surrendering themselves to insatiable desires, possessed with vanity, conceit and arrogance, holding evil ideas through delusion, they engage in action with impure resolves.

r: cintAmaparimeyAM ca pralayAntAmupASritAH . kAmopaBogaparamA etAvaditi niScitAH .. 11 ..

tr.en: Giving themselves over to unmeasured thought whose end is death, regarding the gratification of desires as the highest, feeling sure that this is all,

r: ASApASaSatErbadDAH kAmakroDaparAyaRAH . Ihante kAmaBogArTamanyAyenArTasaYcayAn .. 12 ..

tr.en: Held in bondage by a hundred ties of expectation, given over to lust and anger, they strive to obtain by unlawful means hoards of wealth for sensual enjoyments.

r: idamadya mayA labDamimaM prApsye manoraTam . idamastIdamapi me Bavizyati punarDanam .. 13 ..

tr.en: "This to-day by me hath been won, that purpose I shall gain; this wealth is mine already, and also this shall be mine in future.

r: asO mayA hataH Satrurhanizye cAparAnapi . ISvaro'hamahaM BogI sidDo'haM balavAnsuKI .. 14 ..

tr.en: "I have slain this enemy, and others also I shall slay. I am the Lord, I am the enjoyer, I am perfect, powerful, happy;

r: AQyo'BijanavAnasmi ko'nyo'sti sadfSo mayA . yakzye dAsyAmi modizya ityajYAnavimohitAH .. 15 ..

tr.en: ​ "I am wealthy, well-born; what other is there that is like unto me? I will sacrifice, I will give alms, I will rejoice." Thus deluded by unwisdom,

r: anekacittaviBrAntA mohajAlasamAvftAH . prasaktAH kAmaBogezu patanti narake'SucO .. 16 ..

tr.en: Bewildered by numerous thoughts, enmeshed in the web of delusion, addicted to the gratification of desire, they fall downwards into a foul hell.

r: AtmasaMBAvitAH stabDA DanamAnamadAnvitAH . yajante nAmayajYEste damBenAviDipUrvakam .. 17 ..

tr.en: Self-glorifying, stubborn, filled with the pride and intoxication of wealth, they perform lip-sacrifices for ostentation, contrary to scriptural ordinance.

r: ahaNkAraM balaM darpaM kAmaM kroDaM ca saMSritAH . mAmAtmaparadehezu pradvizanto'ByasUyakAH .. 18 ..

tr.en: ​ Given over to egoism, power, insolence, lust and wrath, these malicious ones hate Me in the bodies of others and in their own.

r: tAnahaM dvizataH krUrAnsaMsArezu narADamAn . kzipAmyajasramaSuBAnAsurIzveva yonizu .. 19 ..

tr.en: These haters, evil, pitiless, vilest among men in the world, I ever throw down into demoniacal wombs.

r: AsurIM yonimApannA mUQA janmani janmani . mAmaprApyEva kOnteya tato yAntyaDamAM gatim .. 20 ..

tr.en: Cast into demoniacal wombs, deluded birth after birth, attaining not to Me, O Kaunteya, they sink into the lowest depths.

r: triviDaM narakasyedaM dvAraM nASanamAtmanaH . kAmaH kroDastaTA loBastasmAdetattrayaM tyajet .. 21 ..

tr.en: Triple is the gate of this hell, destructive of the self—lust, wrath, and greed; therefore let man renounce these three.

r: etErvimuktaH kOnteya tamodvArEstriBirnaraH . AcaratyAtmanaH Sreyastato yAti parAM gatim .. 22 ..

tr.en: A man liberated from these three gates of darkness, O son of Kunti, accomplisheth his own welfare, and thus reacheth the highest goal.

r: yaH SAstraviDimutsfjya vartate kAmakArataH . na sa sidDimavApnoti na suKaM na parAM gatim .. 23 ..

tr.en: He who, having cast aside the ordinances of the Scriptures, followeth the promptings of desire, attaineth not to perfection, nor happiness, nor the highest goal.

r: tasmAcCAstraM pramARaM te kAryAkAryavyavasTitO . jYAtvA SAstraviDAnoktaM karma kartumihArhasi .. 24 ..

tr.en: Therefore let the Scriptures be thy authority, in determining what ought to be done, or what ought not to be done. Knowing what hath been ​ declared by the ordinances of the Scriptures, thou oughtest to work in this world.

r: arjuna uvAca . ye SAstraviDimutsfjya yajante SradDayA'nvitAH . tezAM nizWA tu kA kfzRa sattvamAho rajastamaH .. 1 ..

tr.en: Arjuna said: Those that sacrifice full of faith, but casting aside the ordinances of the Scriptures, what is verily their condition, O Krishna? Is it one of Purity, Passion, or Darkness ?

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . triviDA Bavati SradDA dehinAM sA svaBAvajA . sAttvikI rAjasI cEva tAmasI ceti tAM SfRu .. 2 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: Threefold is by nature the inborn faith of the ​ embodied—pure, passionate, and dark. Hear thou of these.

r: sattvAnurUpA sarvasya SradDA Bavati BArata . SradDAmayo'yaM puruzo yo yacCradDaH sa eva saH .. 3 ..

tr.en: The faith of each is shaped to his own nature, O Bhârata. The man consists of his faith ; that which his faith is, he is even that.

r: yajante sAttvikA devAnyakzarakzAMsi rAjasAH . pretAnBUtagaRAMScAnye yajante tAmasA janAH .. 4 ..

tr.en: Pure men worship the Gods; the passionate the gnomes and giants ; the others, the dark folk, worship ghosts and troops of nature-spirits .

r: aSAstravihitaM GoraM tapyante ye tapo janAH . damBAhaNkArasaMyuktAH kAmarAgabalAnvitAH .. 5 ..

tr.en: The men who perform severe austerities, unenjoined by the Scriptures, wedded to vanity and egoism, impelled by the force of their desires and passions,

r: karSayantaH SarIrasTaM BUtagrAmamacetasaH . mAM cEvAntaHSarIrasTaM tAnvidDyAsuraniScayAn .. 6 ..

tr.en: Unintelligent, tormenting the aggregated elements forming the body, and Me also, seated in the inner body, know these demoniacal in their resolves.

r: AhArastvapi sarvasya triviDo Bavati priyaH . yajYastapastaTA dAnaM tezAM BedamimaM SfRu .. 7 ..

tr.en: The food also which is dear to each is threefold, as also sacrifice, austerity and almsgiving. Hear thou the distinction of these.

r: AyuHsattvabalArogyasuKaprItivivarDanAH . rasyAH snigDAH sTirA hfdyA AhArAH sAttvikapriyAH .. 8 ..

tr.en: The foods that augment vitality, energy, vigour, health, joy and cheerfulness, delicious, bland, substantial and agreeable, are dear to the pure.

r: kaw‌vamlalavaRAtyuzRatIkzRarUkzavidAhinaH . AhArA rAjasasyezwA duHKaSokAmayapradAH .. 9 ..

tr.en: The passionate desire foods that are bitter, sour, saline, over-hot, pungent, dry and burning and which produce pain, grief and sickness.

r: yAtayAmaM gatarasaM pUti paryuzitaM ca yat . ucCizwamapi cAmeDyaM BojanaM tAmasapriyam .. 10 ..

tr.en: That which is stale and flat, putrid and corrupt, leavings also and unclean, is the food dear to the dark.

r: aPalAkANkziBiryajYo viDidfzwoya ijyate . yazwavyameveti manaH samADAya sa sAttvikaH .. 11 ..

tr.en: ​ The sacrifice which is offered by men without desire for fruit, as enjoined by the ordinances, under the firm belief that sacrifice is a duty, that is pure.

r: aBisanDAya tu PalaM damBArTamapi cEva yat . ijyate BarataSrezWa taM yajYaM vidDi rAjasam .. 12 ..

tr.en: The sacrifice offered with a view verily to fruit, and also indeed for self-glorification, O best of the Bhâratas; know thou that to be of passion.

r: viDihInamasfzwAnnaM mantrahInamadakziRam . SradDAvirahitaM yajYaM tAmasaM paricakzate .. 13 ..

tr.en: The sacrifice contrary to the ordinances, without distributing food, devoid of words of power and without gifts , empty of faith, is said to be of darkness.

r: devadvijaguruprAjYapUjanaM SOcamArjavam . brahmacaryamahiMsA ca SArIraM tapa ucyate .. 14 ..

tr.en: ​ Worship given to the Gods, to the twice-born, to the teachers and to the wise, purity, straightforwardness, continence and harmlessness, are called the austerity of the body.

r: anudvegakaraM vAkyaM satyaM priyahitaM ca yat . svADyAyAByasanaM cEva vANmayaM tapa ucyate .. 15 ..

tr.en: Speech causing no annoyance, truthful, pleasant and beneficial, the practice of the study of the Scriptures, are called the austerity of speech.

r: manaHprasAdaH sOmyatvaM mOnamAtmavinigrahaH . BAvasaMSudDirityetattapo mAnasamucyate .. 16 ..

tr.en: Mental happiness, equilibrium, silence, self-control, purity of nature—these are called the austerity of the mind .

r: SradDayA parayA taptaM tapastattriviDaM narEH . aPalAkANkziBiryuktEH sAttvikaM paricakzate .. 17 ..

tr.en: ​ This threefold austerity, performed by men with the utmost faith, without desire for fruit, harmonised, is said to be pure.

r: satkAramAnapUjArTaM tapo damBena cEva yat . kriyate tadiha proktaM rAjasaM calamaDruvam .. 18 ..

tr.en: The austerity which is practised with the object of gaining respect, honour and worship, and for ostentation, is said to be of passion, unstable and fleeting.

r: mUQagrAheRAtmano yatpIqayA kriyate tapaH . parasyotsAdanArTaM vA tattAmasamudAhftam .. 19 ..
dAtavyamiti yaddAnaM dIyate'nupakAriRe . deSe kAle ca pAtre ca taddAnaM sAttvikaM smftam .. 20 ..

tr.en: ​ That alms given to one who does nothing in return, believing that a gift ought to be made in a fit place and time to a worthy person, that alms is accounted pure.

r: yattu pratyupakArArTaM PalamuddiSya vA punaH . dIyate ca pariklizwaM taddAnaM rAjasaM smftam .. 21 ..

tr.en: That given with a view to receiving in return, or looking for fruit again, or grudgingly, that alms is accounted of passion.
