r: adeSakAle yaddAnamapAtreByaSca dIyate . asatkftamavajYAtaM tattAmasamudAhftam .. 22 ..

tr.en: That alms given at unfit place and time, and to unworthy persons, disrespectfully and contemptuously, that is declared of darkness.

r: oM tatsaditi nirdeSo brahmaRastriviDaH smftaH . brAhmaRAstena vedASca yajYASca vihitAH purA .. 23 ..

tr.en: " Aum Tat Sat ," this has been considered to be the threefold designation of the Eternal . By ​ that were ordained of old Brâhmanas, Vedas and sacrifices.

r: tasmAdomityudAhftya yajYadAnatapaHkriyAH . pravartante viDAnoktAH satataM brahmavAdinAm .. 24 ..

tr.en: Therefore with the pronunciation of " Aum " the acts of sacrifice, gift and austerity as laid down in the ordinances are always commenced by the knowers of the Eternal .

r: tadityanaBisanDAya PalaM yajYatapaHkriyAH . dAnakriyASca viviDAH kriyante mokzakANkziBiH .. 25 ..

tr.en: With the pronunciation of " Tat " and without aiming at fruit are performed the various acts of sacrifice, austerity and gift, by those desiring liberation.

r: sadBAve sADuBAve ca sadityetatprayujyate . praSaste karmaRi taTA sacCabdaH pArTa yujyate .. 26 ..

tr.en: " Sat " is used in the sense of reality and ​ goodness; likewise, O Pârtha, the word " Sat " is used in the sense of a good work.

r: yajYe tapasi dAne ca sTitiH saditi cocyate . karma cEva tadarTIyaM sadityevABiDIyate .. 27 ..

tr.en: Steadfastness in sacrifice, austerity and gift is also called " Sat ", and action for the sake of the Supreme is also named " Sat ."

r: aSradDayA hutaM dattaM tapastaptaM kftaM ca yat . asadityucyate pArTa na ca tatpretya no iha .. 28 ..

tr.en: Whatsoever is wrought without faith, oblation, gift, austerity, or other deed, "Asat" it is called, O Pârtha; it is nought, here or hereafter.

r: arjuna uvAca . saMnyAsasya mahAbAho tattvamicCAmi veditum . tyAgasya ca hfzIkeSa pfTakkeSinizUdana .. 1 ..

tr.en: Arjuna said: I desire, O mighty-armed, to know severally the essence of renunciation, O Hrishîkesha, and of relinquishment , O Keshinishûdana .

r: SrIBagavAnuvAca . kAmyAnAM karmaRAM nyAsaM saMnyAsaM kavayo viduH . sarvakarmaPalatyAgaM prAhustyAgaM vicakzaRAH .. 2 ..

tr.en: The Blessed Lord said: Sages have known as renunciation the renouncing of works with desire; the relinquishing of the fruit of all actions is called relinquishment by the wise.

r: tyAjyaM dozavadityeke karma prAhurmanIziRaH . yajYadAnatapaH karma na tyAjyamiti cApare .. 3 ..

tr.en: "Action should be relinquished as an evil," declare some thoughtful men; "acts of sacrifice, gift and austerity should not be relinquished," say others.

r: niScayaM SfRu me tatra tyAge Baratasattama . tyAgo hi puruzavyAGra triviDaH samprakIrtitaH .. 4 ..

tr.en: Hear my conclusions as to that relinquishment, O best of the Bhâratas; since relinquishment, O tiger of men, has been explained as threefold.

r: yajYadAnatapaH karma na tyAjyaM kAryameva tat . yajYo dAnaM tapaScEva pAvanAni manIziRAm .. 5 ..

tr.en: Acts of sacrifice, gift and austerity should not be relinquished, but should be performed; ​ sacrifice, gift and also austerity are the purifiers of the intelligent.

r: etAnyapi tu karmARi saNgaM tyaktvA PalAni ca . kartavyAnIti me pArTa niScitaM matamuttamam .. 6 ..

tr.en: But even these actions should be done leaving aside attachment and fruit, O Pârtha; that is my certain and best belief.

r: niyatasya tu saMnyAsaH karmaRo nopapadyate . mohAttasya parityAgastAmasaH parikIrtitaH .. 7 ..

tr.en: Verily renunciation of actions that are prescribed is not proper; the relinquishment thereof from delusion is said to be of darkness.

r: duHKamityeva yatkarma kAyakleSaBayAttyajet . sa kftvA rAjasaM tyAgaM nEva tyAgaPalaM laBet .. 8 ..

tr.en: He who relinquisheth an action from fear of physical suffering, saying "Painful," thus performing a passionate relinquishment, obtaineth not the fruit of relinquishment.

r: kAryamityeva yatkarma niyataM kriyate'rjuna . saNgaM tyaktvA PalaM cEva sa tyAgaH sAttviko mataH .. 9 ..

tr.en: He who performeth a prescribed action, saying, "it ought to be done," O Arjuna, relinquishing attachment and also fruit, that relinquishment is regarded as pure.

r: na dvezwyakuSalaM karma kuSale nAnuzajjate . tyAgI sattvasamAvizwo meDAvI CinnasaMSayaH .. 10 ..

tr.en: The relinquisher pervaded by purity, intelligent and with doubts cut away, hateth not unpleasurable action nor is attached to pleasurable.

r: na hi dehaBftA SakyaM tyaktuM karmARyaSezataH . yastu karmaPalatyAgI sa tyAgItyaBiDIyate .. 11 ..

tr.en: Nor indeed can embodied beings completely relinquish action; verily he who relinquisheth the fruit of action, he is said to be a relinquisher.

r: anizwamizwaM miSraM ca triviDaM karmaRaH Palam . BavatyatyAginAM pretya na tu saMnyAsinAM kvacit .. 12 ..

tr.en: Good, evil and mixed—threefold is the fruit of action hereafter for the non-relinquisher; but there is none ever for the renouncer.

r: paYcEtAni mahAbAho kAraRAni niboDa me . sANKye kftAnte proktAni sidDaye sarvakarmaRAm .. 13 ..

tr.en: These five causes, O mighty-armed, learn of Me as declared in the Sâñkhya system for the accomplishment of all actions:

r: aDizWAnaM taTA kartA karaRaM ca pfTagviDam . viviDASca pfTakcezwA dEvaM cEvAtra paYcamam .. 14 ..
SarIravAN‌manoBiryatkarma prAraBate naraH . nyAyyaM vA viparItaM vA paYcEte tasya hetavaH .. 15 ..

tr.en: ​ Whatever action a man performeth by his body, speech and mind, whether right or the reverse, these five are the cause thereof.

r: tatrEvaM sati kartAramAtmAnaM kevalaM tu yaH . paSyatyakftabudDitvAnna sa paSyati durmatiH .. 16 ..

tr.en: That being so, he verily who—owing to untrained Reason —looketh on his Self , which is isolated, as the actor, he of perverted intelligence, seeth not.

r: yasya nAhaMkfto BAvo budDiryasya na lipyate . hatvA'pi sa imA~llokAnna hanti na nibaDyate .. 17 ..

tr.en: He who is free from the egoistic notion, whose Reason is not affected, though he slay these peoples, he slayeth not, nor is bound.

r: iti SrImadBagavadgItAsUpanizatsu brahmavidyAyAM yogaSAstre SrIkfzRArjunasaMvAde saMnyAsayogo nAmAzwAdaSo'DyAyaH ..18..

tr.en: Knowledge, the knowable and the knower, ​ the threefold impulse to action; the organ, the action, the actor, the threefold constituents of action.

r: jYAnaM karma ca kartA ca triDEva guRaBedataH . procyate guRasaNKyAne yaTAvacCfRu tAnyapi .. 19 ..

tr.en: Knowledge, action and actor in the category of qualities are also said to be severally threefold, from the difference of qualities ; hear thou duly these also.

r: sarvaBUtezu yenEkaM BAvamavyayamIkzate . aviBaktaM viBaktezu tajjYAnaM vidDi sAttvikam .. 20 ..

tr.en: That by which one indestructible Being is seen in all beings, inseparate in the separated, know thou that knowledge as pure.

r: pfTaktvena tu yajjYAnaM nAnABAvAnpfTagviDAn . vetti sarvezu BUtezu tajjYAnaM vidDi rAjasam .. 21 ..

tr.en: But that knowledge which regardeth the ​ several manifold existences in all beings as separate, that knowledge know thou as of passion;

r: yattu kftsnavadekasmin kArye saktamahEtukam . atattvArTavadalpaM ca tattAmasamudAhftam .. 22 ..

tr.en: While that which clingeth to each one thing as if it were the whole, without reason, without grasping the reality, narrow, that is declared to be dark.

r: niyataM saNgarahitamarAgadvezataH kftam . aPalaprepsunA karma yattatsAttvikamucyate .. 23 ..

tr.en: An action which is ordained, done by one undesirous of fruit, devoid of attachment, without love or hate, that is called pure.

r: yattu kAmepsunA karma sAhaNkAreRa vA punaH . kriyate bahulAyAsaM tadrAjasamudAhftam .. 24 ..

tr.en: But that action that is done by one longing for ​ desires, or again with egoism, or with much effort, that is declared to be passionate.

r: anubanDaM kzayaM hiMsAmanapekzya ca pOruzam . mohAdAraByate karma yattattAmasamucyate .. 25 ..

tr.en: The action undertaken from delusion, without regard to capacity and consequences—loss and injury to others—that is declared to be dark.

r: muktasaNgo'nahaMvAdI DftyutsAhasamanvitaH . sidDyasidDyornirvikAraH karttA sAttvika ucyate .. 26 ..

tr.en: Liberated from attachment, not egoistic, endued with firmness and confidence, unchanged by success or failure, that actor is called pure.

r: rAgI karmaPalaprepsurlubDo hiMsAtmako'SuciH . harzaSokAnvitaH kartA rAjasaH parikIrtitaH .. 27 ..

tr.en: Impassioned, desiring to obtain the fruit of actions, greedy, harmful, impure, moved by joy and sorrow, such an actor is pronounced passionate.

r: ayuktaH prAkftaH stabDaH SaWo nEzkftiko'lasaH . vizAdI dIrGasUtrI ca kartA tAmasa ucyate .. 28 ..

tr.en: Discordant, vulgar, stubborn, cheating, malicious, indolent, despairful, procrastinating, that actor is called dark.

r: budDerBedaM DfteScEva guRatastriviDaM SfRu . procyamAnamaSezeRa pfTaktvena DanaYjaya .. 29 ..

tr.en: The division of Reason and of firmness also, threefold according to the qualities , hear thou related, unreservedly and severally, O Dhananjaya.

r: pravfttiM ca nivfttiM ca kAryAkArye BayABaye . banDaM mokzaM ca yA vetti budDiH sA pArTa sAttvikI .. 30 ..

tr.en: That which knoweth energy and abstinence, what ought to be done and what ought not to be done, fear and fearlessness, bondage and liberation, that Reason is pure, O Pârtha.

r: yayA DarmamaDarmaM ca kAryaM cAkAryameva ca . ayaTAvatprajAnAti budDiH sA pArTa rAjasI .. 31 ..

tr.en: That by which one understandeth away Right and Wrong and also what ought to be done and what ought not to be done, that Reason, O Pârtha, is passionate.

r: aDarmaM Darmamiti yA manyate tamasA vftA . sarvArTAn viparItAMSca budDiH sA pArTa tAmasI .. 32 ..
DftyA yayA DArayate manaHprARendriyakriyAH . yogenAvyaBicAriRyA DftiH sA pArTa sAttvikI .. 33 ..

tr.en: The unwavering firmness by which, through Yoga, one restraineth the activity of the mind , ​ of the life breaths and of the sense-organs, that firmness, O Pârtha, is pure.

r: yayA tu DarmakAmArTAn DftyA DArayate'rjuna . prasaNgena PalAkANkzI DftiH sA pArTa rAjasI .. 34 ..

tr.en: But the firmness, O Arjuna, by which, from attachment desirous of fruit, one holdeth fast duty , desire and wealth, that firmness, O Pârtha, is passionate.

r: yayA svapnaM BayaM SokaM vizAdaM madameva ca . na vimuYcati durmeDA DftiH sA pArTa tAmasI .. 35 ..

tr.en: That by which one from stupidity doth not abandon sleep, fear, grief, despair, and also vanity, that firmness, O Pârtha, is dark.

r: suKaM tvidAnIM triviDaM SfRu me BaratarzaBa . aByAsAdramate yatra duHKAntaM ca nigacCati .. 36 ..

tr.en: And now the threefold kinds of pleasure hear ​ thou from Me, O bull of the Bhâratas. That in which one by practice rejoiceth, and which putteth an end to pain;

r: yattadagre vizamiva pariRAme'mftopamam . tatsuKaM sAttvikaM proktamAtmabudDiprasAdajam .. 37 ..

tr.en: Which at first is as venom but in the end is as nectar; that pleasure is said to be pure, born of the blissful knowledge of the Self .

r: vizayendriyasaMyogAdyattadagre'mftopamam . pariRAme vizamiva tatsuKaM rAjasaM smftam .. 38 ..

tr.en: That which from the union of the senses with their objects at first is as nectar, but in the end is like venom, that pleasure is accounted passionate.

r: yadagre cAnubanDe ca suKaM mohanamAtmanaH . nidrAlasyapramAdotTaM tattAmasamudAhftam .. 39 ..

tr.en: That pleasure which both at first and afterwards is delusive of the self, arising from sleep, ​ indolence and heedlessness, that is declared dark.

r: na tadasti pfTivyAM vA divi devezu vA punaH . sattvaM prakftijErmuktaM yadeBiH syAttriBirguREH .. 40 ..

tr.en: There is not an entity, either on the earth or again in heaven among the Shining Ones, that is liberated from these three qualities, born of Matter .

r: brAhmaRakzatriyaviSAM SUdrARAM ca parantapa . karmARi praviBaktAni svaBAvapraBavErguREH .. 41 ..

tr.en: Of Brâhmanas, Kshattriyas, Vaishyas and Shûdras, O Parantapa, the duties have been distributed, according to the qualities born of their own natures.

r: Samo damastapaH SOcaM kzAntirArjavameva ca . jYAnaM vijYAnamAstikyaM brahmakarma svaBAvajam .. 42 ..

tr.en: ​ Serenity, self-restraint, austerity, purity, forgiveness and also uprightness, wisdom, knowledge, belief in God, are the Brâhmana duty , born of his own nature.

r: SOryaM tejo DftirdAkzyaM yudDe cApyapalAyanam . dAnamISvaraBAvaSca kzAtraM karma svaBAvajam .. 43 ..

tr.en: Prowess, splendour, firmness, dexterity, and also not flying from battle, generosity, the nature of a ruler, are the Kshattriya duty , born of his own nature.

r: kfzigOrakzyavARijyaM vESyakarma svaBAvajam . paricaryAtmakaM karma SUdrasyApi svaBAvajam .. 44 ..

tr.en: Ploughing, protection of kine, and trade are the Vaishya duty , born of his own nature. Action of the nature of service is the Shûdra duty, born of his own nature.

r: sve sve karmaRyaBirataH saMsidDiM laBate naraH . svakarmanirataH sidDiM yaTA vindati tacCfRu .. 45 ..

tr.en: Man reacheth perfection by each being intent on his own duty . Listen thou how perfection is won by him who is intent on his own duty .

r: yataH pravfttirBUtAnAM yena sarvamidaM tatam . svakarmaRA tamaByarcya sidDiM vindati mAnavaH .. 46 ..

tr.en: He from whom is the emanation of beings, by Whom all This is pervaded, by worshipping Him in his own duty a man winneth perfection.

r: SreyAn svaDarmo viguRaH paraDarmAtsvanuzWitAt . svaBAvaniyataM karma kurvannApnoti kilbizam .. 47 ..

tr.en: Better is one's own duty though destitute of merits than the well-executed duty of another. ​ He who doeth the duty laid down by his own nature incurreth not sin.

r: sahajaM karma kOnteya sadozamapi na tyajet . sarvAramBA hi dozeRa DUmenAgnirivAvftAH .. 48 ..

tr.en: Congenital duty , O son of Kunti, though defective, ought not to be abandoned. All undertakings indeed are clouded by defects as fire by smoke.

r: asaktabudDiH sarvatra jitAtmA vigataspfhaH . nEzkarmyasidDiM paramAM saMnyAsenADigacCati .. 49 ..

tr.en: He whose Reason is everywhere unattached, the self-subdued, dead to desires, he goeth by renunciation to the supreme perfection of freedom from obligation.

r: sidDiM prApto yaTA brahma taTA''pnoti niboDa me . samAsenEva kOnteya nizWA jYAnasya yA parA .. 50 ..

tr.en: How he who hath attained perfection obtaineth the Eternal , that highest state of wisdom, learn thou from Me only succinctly, O Kaunteya.

r: budDyA viSudDayA yukto DftyA''tmAnaM niyasya ca . SabdAdInvizayAMstyaktvA rAgadvezO vyudasya ca .. 51 ..

tr.en: United to this Reason, purified, controlling the self by firmness, having abandoned sound and the other objects of the senses, having laid aside passion and malice,

r: viviktasevI laGvASI yatavAkkAyamAnasaH . DyAnayogaparo nityaM vErAgyaM samupASritaH .. 52 ..

tr.en: Dwelling in solitude, abstemious, speech, body and mind subdued, constantly fixed in meditation and yoga , taking refuge in dispassion,

r: ahaNkAraM balaM darpaM kAmaM kroDaM parigraham . vimucya nirmamaH SAnto brahmaBUyAya kalpate .. 53 ..

tr.en: Having cast aside egoism, violence, arrogance, desire, wrath, covetousness, selfless and peaceful—he is fit to become the Eternal .

r: brahmaBUtaH prasannAtmA na Socati na kANkzati . samaH sarvezu BUtezu madBaktiM laBate parAm .. 54 ..

tr.en: Becoming the Eternal , serene in the Self , he neither grieveth nor desireth; the same to all beings, he obtaineth supreme devotion unto Me.

r: BaktyA mAmaBijAnAti yAvAnyaScAsmi tattvataH . tato mAM tattvato jYAtvA viSate tadanantaram .. 55 ..

tr.en: By devotion he knoweth Me in essence, who and what I am; having thus known Me in essence he forthwith entereth into the Supreme.

r: sarvakarmARyapi sadA kurvARo madvyapASrayaH . matprasAdAdavApnoti SASvataM padamavyayam .. 56 ..

tr.en: ​ Though ever performing all actions, taking refuge in Me, by My grace he obtaineth the eternal indestructible abode.

r: cetasA sarvakarmARi mayi saMnyasya matparaH . budDiyogamupASritya maccittaH satataM Bava .. 57 ..

tr.en: Renouncing mentally all works in Me, intent on Me, resorting to the yoga of discrimination , have thy thought ever on Me.

r: maccittaH sarvadurgARi matprasAdAttarizyasi . aTa cettvamahaNkArAnna Srozyasi vinaNkzyasi .. 58 ..

tr.en: Thinking on Me, thou shalt overcome all obstacles by My grace: but if from egoism thou wilt not listen, thou shalt be destroyed utterly.

r: yadahaNkAramASritya na yotsya iti manyase . miTyEza vyavasAyaste prakftistvAM niyokzyati .. 59 ..

tr.en: Entrenched in egoism, thou thinkest, "I will ​ not fight;" to no purpose thy determination; nature will constrain thee.

r: svaBAvajena kOnteya nibadDaH svena karmaRA . kartuM necCasi yanmohAtkarizyasyavaSo'pi tat .. 60 ..

tr.en: O son of Kuntî, bound by thine own duty born of thine own nature, that which from delusion thou desirest not to do, even that helplessly thou shalt perform.

r: ISvaraH sarvaBUtAnAM hfddeSe'rjuna tizWati . BrAmayansarvaBUtAni yantrArUQAni mAyayA .. 61 ..

tr.en: The Lord dwelleth in the hearts of all beings, O Arjuna, by His illusive Power causing all beings to revolve, as though mounted on a potter's wheel.

r: tameva SaraRaM gacCa sarvaBAvena BArata . tatprasAdAtparAM SAntiM sTAnaM prApsyasi SASvatam .. 62 ..

tr.en: Flee unto Him for shelter with all thy being, O Bhârata; by His grace thou shalt obtain supreme peace, the everlasting dwelling-place.

r: iti te jYAnamAKyAtaM guhyAd‌guhyataraM mayA . vimfSyEtadaSezeRa yaTecCasi taTA kuru .. 63 ..

tr.en: Thus hath wisdom, more secret than secrecy itself, been declared unto thee by Me; having reflected on it fully, then act thou as thou listest.

r: sarvaguhyatamaM BUyaH SfRu me paramaM vacaH . izwo'si me dfQamiti tato vakzyAmi te hitam .. 64 ..

tr.en: Listen thou again to My supreme word, most secret of all; beloved art thou of Me, and steadfast of heart, therefore will I speak for thy benefit.

r: manmanA Bava madBakto madyAjI mAM namaskuru . mAmevEzyasi satyaM te pratijAne priyo'si me .. 65 ..

tr.en: Merge thy mind in Me, be my devotee, sacrifice to Me, prostrate thyself before Me, thou shalt come even to Me. I pledge thee My troth; thou art dear to Me.

r: sarvaDarmAnparityajya mAmekaM SaraRaM vraja . ahaM tvAM sarvapApeByo mokzayizyAmi mA SucaH .. 66 ..

tr.en: Abandoning all duties come unto Me alone for shelter; sorrow not, I will liberate thee from all sins.

r: idaM te nAtapaskAya nABaktAya kadAcana . na cASuSrUzave vAcyaM na ca mAM yo'ByasUyati .. 67 ..

tr.en: Never is this to be spoken by thee to anyone who is without asceticism, nor without devotion, nor to one who desireth not to listen, nor yet to him who speaketh evil of Me.

r: ya idaM paramaM guhyaM madBaktezvaBiDAsyati . BaktiM mayi parAM kftvA mAmevEzyatyasaMSayam .. 68 ..

tr.en: He who shall declare this supreme secret among My devotees, having shown the highest devotion for Me, without doubt he shall come to Me.

r: na ca tasmAnmanuzyezu kaScinme priyakfttamaH . BavitA na ca me tasmAdanyaH priyataro Buvi .. 69 ..

tr.en: Nor is there any among men who performeth dearer service to Me than he, nor any other shall be more beloved by Me on earth than he.

r: aDyezyate ca ya imaM DarmyaM saMvAdamAvayoH . jYAnayajYena tenAhamizwaH syAmiti me matiH .. 70 ..

tr.en: And he who shall study this sacred dialogue of ours, by him I shall be worshipped with the sacrifice of wisdom. Such is My mind.

r: SradDAvAnanasUyaSca SfRuyAdapi yo naraH . so'pi muktaH SuBAMllokAnprApnuyAtpuRyakarmaRAm .. 71 ..

tr.en: The man also who, full of faith, merely heareth it unreviling, even he, freed from evil, obtaineth the radiant worlds of the righteous.

r: kaccidetacCrutaM pArTa tvayEkAgreRa cetasA . kaccidajYAnasammohaH praRazwaste DanaYjaya .. 72 ..

tr.en: ​ Hath this been heard, O son of Prithâ, with one-pointed mind? Has thy delusion, caused by unwisdom, been destroyed, O Dhananjaya?

r: arjuna uvAca . nazwo mohaH smUtirlabDA tvatprasAdAnmayA'cyuta . sTito'smi gatasandehaH karizye vacanaM tava .. 73 ..

tr.en: Arjuna said: Destroyed is my delusion. I have gained knowledge through Thy grace, O Immutable one. I am firm, my doubts have fled away. I will do according to Thy word.

r: saYjaya uvAca . ityahaM vAsudevasya pArTasya ca mahAtmanaH . saMvAdamimamaSrOzamadButaM romaharzaRam .. 74 ..

tr.en: Sanjaya said: I heard this marvellous dialogue of Vâsudeva, and of the great-souled Partha, causing my hair to stand on end.

r: vyAsaprasAdAcCrutavAnetad guhyamahaM param . yogaM yogeSvarAtkfzRAtsAkzAtkaTayataH svayam .. 75 ..

tr.en: By the favour of Vyâsa I listened to this secret and supreme yoga from the Lord of Yoga, Krishna Himself, speaking before mine eyes.

r: rAjansaMsmftya saMsmftya saMvAdamimamadButam . keSavArjunayoH puRyaM hfzyAmi ca muhurmuhuH .. 76 ..

tr.en: O King, remembering, remembering this marvellous and holy dialogue between Keshava and Arjuna, I rejoice again and again.

r: tacca saMsmftya saMsmftya rUpamatyadButaM hareH . vismayo me mahAn rAjan hfzyAmi ca punaH punaH .. 77 ..

tr.en: Remembering, remembering, also that most marvellous form of Hari, great is my wonder, O King. I rejoice, again and again.

r: yatra yogeSvaraH kfzRo yatra pArTo DanurDaraH . tatra SrIrvijayo BUtirDruvA nItirmatirmama .. 78 ..

tr.en: Wherever is Krishna, Yoga's Lord, wherever ​ is Pârtha, the archer, assured are there prosperity, victory and happiness. So I think.
